name: Work Order - WIP
data:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<!--
================================================================================
  REPORT: Work Order / WIP
  PATH:   Manufacturing/Work_Order_WIP.htm
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Production floor status report. Groups in-progress Work Orders under their
  parent Manufacture Order, surfaces step-by-step completion from
  woinstruction, the current pick status (worst-of summary across the WO's
  pickitems), the WO's calendar category, and the live WIP inventory value
  (parts already picked into WIP at part.avgCost). Each WO row expands to
  the raw-material woitem lines so the floor lead can see what's been
  consumed vs target. MO-level % rolls up qty-weighted from its WOs.
================================================================================
-->
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <title>Work Order / WIP - Fishbowl BI</title>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />

  <!-- Moment.js — fb-lib's Common.formatDate uses moment to format
       dates against the install's DateFormatShort (e.g. dd/MM/yyyy
       for AU). Without it the fallback returns YYYY-MM-DD which
       reads wrong for non-US installs. Must load BEFORE fb-lib so
       its formatDate sees `typeof moment === 'function'`. -->
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/moment.js/2.29.4/moment.min.js"></script>

  <!-- Shared Fishbowl BI lib — inlined by Fishbowl from the saved "fb-lib"
       script. Source of truth: scripts/fb-lib.js. Must come BEFORE the
       fb-styles directive so the FBLib namespace is defined for any
       inline code below, and before this report's inline script tag
       at the bottom of body. -->
  <script>
    {% Script fb-lib %}
  </script>

  <!-- Shared chrome: fb-styles. -->
  <style>
    {% Style fb-styles %}
  </style>

  <style>
    html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 0;
      font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }
    /* Body reserves bottom space for the fb-lib debug drawer. The drawer
       itself is fixed-bottom; --debug-drawer-h is set by the observer
       in init() and changes as the drawer opens/closes. */
    body {
      padding-bottom: var(--debug-drawer-h, 0px);
      transition: padding-bottom 0.12s ease;
    }
    .wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100vh; }

    /* fb-drawer body grid (matches Core_Dashboard_Template). fb-styles
       supplies the drawer chrome; these classes lay out grouped fields. */
    .fb-grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px 22px; align-items: flex-start; }
    .fb-group { flex: 1 1 220px; min-width: 220px; }
    .fb-group-title {
      font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #475569; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
      padding-bottom: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .fb-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .fb-field label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #475569; }
    .ds-btn { padding: 7px 13px; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 7px;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; background: #fff; cursor: pointer;
      font-family: inherit; font-weight: 600; color: #334155; }
    .ds-btn:hover { background: #f1f5f9; }
    .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary); color: #fff; border-color: var(--color-primary); }
    .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-dark); }
    .ds-btn-admin { background: #fef3c7; border-color: #f59e0b; color: #7c2d12; margin-right: 6px; }
    .ds-lock-badge { background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; border: 1px solid #f59e0b;
      padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 7px; font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 14px; }

    /* ── KPI BAR ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    #kpiBar {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr));
      gap: 10px; padding: 10px 16px; background: #f1f5f9;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .kpi {
      background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 8px 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px;
      box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.03);
    }
    .kpi-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; color: #64748b; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
    .kpi-value { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #1e293b; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    .kpi-sub   { font-size: 10px; color: #94a3b8; font-weight: 500; }
    .kpi.ok    { border-color: #6ee7b7; } .kpi.ok    .kpi-value { color: #047857; }
    .kpi.warn  { border-color: #fcd34d; } .kpi.warn  .kpi-value { color: #b45309; }
    .kpi.late  { border-color: #fca5a5; } .kpi.late  .kpi-value { color: #b91c1c; }
    .kpi.money { border-color: #93c5fd; } .kpi.money .kpi-value { color: #1d4ed8; }

    /* ── FILTER CHIP STRIP ──────────────────────────────────────── */
    #filtersBar {
      background: white; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 8px 16px;
      flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 14px; align-items: center;
      position: relative; z-index: 30;
    }
    .fl-label {
      font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #64748b; padding: 4px 8px; background: #f1f5f9; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap;
    }
    #filtersBar input[type=text] {
      padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; height: 30px;
      font-size: 12px; color: #374151; background: white; font-family: inherit; min-width: 180px;
    }
    .fl-divider { width: 1px; height: 22px; background: #e2e8f0; flex-shrink: 0; }

    /* ── Multi-select trigger (matches WO_Parts_Availability) ── */
    .ms-container { position: relative; }
    .ms-trigger {
      display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: nowrap; gap: 3px;
      border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 3px 8px;
      background: white; height: 30px; min-width: 180px; overflow: hidden;
      cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px;
    }
    .ms-trigger:hover { border-color: #cbd5e1; }
    .ms-tag {
      background: #dbeafe; color: #1d4ed8; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px;
      font-size: 11px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .ms-tag-x { cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; }
    .ms-placeholder { color: #9ca3af; }
    .ms-dropdown {
      position: absolute; z-index: 500; top: calc(100% + 2px); left: 0;
      min-width: 260px; max-width: 380px; background: white;
      border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 6px;
      box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.13);
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-height: 360px;
    }
    .ms-dropdown.hidden { display: none !important; }
    .ms-search { padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f3f4f6; }
    .ms-search input {
      width: 100%; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 4px;
      padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 12px; outline: none; font-family: inherit;
    }
    .ms-actions { padding: 4px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f3f4f6;
      display: flex; gap: 10px; font-size: 11px; }
    .ms-actions span { color: #3b82f6; cursor: pointer; }
    .ms-actions span:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
    .ms-list { overflow-y: auto; flex: 1; }
    .ms-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 10px;
      cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; }
    .ms-item:hover { background: #eff6ff; }
    .ms-empty { padding: 12px; color: #9ca3af; font-size: 12px; text-align: center; }

    /* ── MAIN TABLE ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    #tableScroll {
      flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow: auto; background: #f8fafc;
    }
    table.wip {
      width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12.5px; background: white;
    }
    table.wip th {
      background: #1e3a5f; color: white; font-weight: 500; font-size: 11px;
      text-align: left; padding: 8px 10px; white-space: nowrap;
      position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 5;
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    }
    table.wip th.nr { text-align: right; }
    /* Clickable sort headers — subtle hover tint, arrow indicator. */
    table.wip th.sortable { cursor: pointer; user-select: none; }
    table.wip th.sortable:hover { background: #264f80; }
    .sort-arrow {
      display: inline-block; min-width: 10px; margin-left: 4px;
      opacity: 0.55; font-size: 9px;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }
    .sort-arrow.active { opacity: 1; }
    table.wip td { padding: 6px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eef2f7; vertical-align: middle; }
    table.wip td.nr { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

    /* MO group header row */
    tr.mo-row td { background: #eff6ff; font-weight: 600; border-top: 2px solid #bfdbfe; }
    tr.mo-row:first-child td { border-top: none; }
    tr.mo-row .twisty { display: inline-flex; width: 14px; height: 14px; margin-right: 6px;
      align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; color: #475569;
      transition: transform 0.12s; user-select: none; }
    tr.mo-row.expanded .twisty { transform: rotate(90deg); }

    /* WO row */
    tr.wo-row td { background: #fff; }
    tr.wo-row:hover td { background: #f8fafc; }
    tr.wo-row.collapsed { display: none; }
    tr.wo-row td.indent { padding-left: 28px; }
    tr.wo-row .twisty { display: inline-flex; width: 12px; height: 12px; margin-right: 4px;
      cursor: pointer; color: #94a3b8; transition: transform 0.12s; user-select: none; }
    tr.wo-row.expanded .twisty { transform: rotate(90deg); }

    /* Sub-detail row */
    tr.sub-row td { background: #f8fafc; padding: 0; }
    tr.sub-row.collapsed { display: none; }
    .sub-detail {
      padding: 10px 12px 12px 56px; border-top: 1px dashed #cbd5e1;
      border-bottom: 1px dashed #cbd5e1; background: #f8fafc;
    }
    .sub-detail h5 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 11px; color: #475569;
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-weight: 700; }
    table.sub {
      width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 11.5px;
      background: white; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden;
    }
    table.sub th {
      background: #f1f5f9; color: #475569; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600;
      padding: 5px 8px; text-align: left; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }
    table.sub th.nr { text-align: right; }
    table.sub td { padding: 5px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f3f4f6; }
    table.sub td.nr { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    table.sub tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
    .sub-loading { padding: 12px; color: #94a3b8; font-size: 11px; font-style: italic; }

    /* Badges & status pills */
    .badge { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 4px;
      font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }
    .b-mo-20 { background: #dbeafe; color: #1e40af; }
    .b-mo-50 { background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; }
    .b-mo-60 { background: #d1fae5; color: #065f46; }
    .b-wo-10 { background: #e5e7eb; color: #374151; }
    .b-wo-30 { background: #dbeafe; color: #1e40af; }
    .b-wo-40 { background: #d1fae5; color: #065f46; }
    .b-pick-10 { background: #e5e7eb; color: #374151; }
    .b-pick-20 { background: #fde68a; color: #92400e; }
    .b-pick-30 { background: #bfdbfe; color: #1e40af; }
    .b-pick-40 { background: #bbf7d0; color: #14532d; }
    .b-late { background: #fee2e2; color: #991b1b; }
    /* Pick column layout — traffic-light dot (availability state)
       followed by one clickable pill per pick (pick number, coloured
       by pick.statusid). flex-align so dot + pills sit on the same
       baseline; .pick-dot has its own tooltip so hovering the dot
       still surfaces the availability breakdown. */
    .pick-summary {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      font-size: 11px; color: #1e293b;
    }
    .pick-dot {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; cursor: help;
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .pick-dot svg { flex-shrink: 0; }
    .pick-pill {
      text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; line-height: 1.4;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      transition: filter 0.12s;
    }
    .pick-pill:hover { filter: brightness(0.93); text-decoration: underline; }
    /* Calendar category pill — matches the .badge family in
       size/radius/font so the MO/WO row's status and category pills
       sit on the same visual baseline. Background + foreground are
       set inline at render time from calcategory.color. */
    .cal-cat {
      display: inline-block; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 4px;
      font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4;
      white-space: nowrap;
      background: #cbd5e1; color: #1e293b;        /* neutral fallback */
    }

    /* Progress bar */
    .pbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-width: 130px; }
    .pbar-track { flex: 1; height: 6px; background: #e2e8f0; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; }
    .pbar-fill { height: 100%; background: #2563eb; transition: width 0.2s; }
    .pbar-fill.ok    { background: #10b981; }
    .pbar-fill.warn  { background: #f59e0b; }
    .pbar-fill.empty { background: #cbd5e1; }
    .pbar-text { font-size: 11px; color: #1e293b; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; min-width: 64px; text-align: right; }

    .row-link { color: #2563eb; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; }
    .row-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
    /* Output cell layout — 2-col grid so all qty pills sit in a
       right-hand sub-column, aligned vertically across every output
       line in the same cell. Left col takes any leftover width and
       holds the part# + description; right col hugs the qty pill so
       the "used / target" digits line up on the right edge. */
    .out-lines {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
      column-gap: 10px; row-gap: 2px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .out-part { line-height: 1.35; min-width: 0; }
    .out-qty {
      justify-self: end;
      padding: 0 5px; border-radius: 4px;
      font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600;
      color: #334155; background: #f1f5f9;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .muted { color: #94a3b8; }
    .empty { padding: 36px; text-align: center; color: #94a3b8; font-style: italic; }

    /* Spinner overlay */
    #loadOverlay { display: none; position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; z-index: 100; color: #475569; font-size: 12px; }
    #loadOverlay.show { display: flex; }
    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
    .spin { animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite; }

    /* Drawer body code blocks. */
    .fb-drawer-body code { background: #f1f5f9; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 12px; }
    .fb-drawer-body ul { margin: 0 0 4px 18px; padding: 0; }

    /* ==============================================================
       FINISH-WO PANEL — lives inside the expanded sub-detail row.
       Layout-only additions. Colour + typography come from existing
       .kpi / .badge / .pick-dot / .fb-grid tokens declared above.
       ============================================================== */
    .finish-banner {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
      padding: 8px 12px; margin-bottom: 10px;
      background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-left-width: 3px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-size: 12px; color: #1e293b;
    }
    /* Colour cue via the .kpi.* modifier applied inline. Border colours
       come from those tokens (.kpi.ok, .kpi.warn, .kpi.late) so we
       don't invent a new palette entry. */
    .finish-banner.kpi.ok    { border-left-color: #6ee7b7; }
    .finish-banner.kpi.warn  { border-left-color: #fcd34d; background: #fffbeb; }
    .finish-banner.kpi.late  { border-left-color: #fca5a5; background: #fef2f2; }
    .finish-banner .fb-summary { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 12px; align-items: center; }
    .finish-banner .fb-step { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 11px; color: #475569; }
    .finish-banner .fb-step .pick-dot { display: inline-flex; }
    .finish-banner .fb-actions { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .finish-banner button.hdr-btn { font-weight: 600; }
    .finish-banner button.hdr-btn.primary {
      background: var(--color-primary); color: #fff; border-color: var(--color-primary);
    }
    .finish-banner button.hdr-btn.primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-dark); border-color: var(--color-primary-dark); }
    .finish-banner button.hdr-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

    /* Blocker list — plain <ul> that inherits font/colour from the
       fb-drawer-body ul rule above. Kept low-contrast so the finish
       button stays the visual anchor. */
    .finish-blocker-list {
      margin: 6px 0 0 20px; padding: 0;
      font-size: 11px; color: #b91c1c;
    }
    .finish-blocker-list li { margin: 2px 0; }
    .finish-blocker-list a.pick-pill { margin-left: 6px; }

    /* Editable qty inputs sit inside the existing table.sub cells so
       the sub-table's font / padding rules already apply. Sizing
       matches #filtersBar input[type=text] (30px h / 4px 8px pad /
       6px radius / 12px font / #e2e8f0 border) but shrunk to fit a
       table cell. Right-aligned + tabular-num to line up with the
       .nr columns. */
    table.sub input[type="number"].qty-edit {
      width: 76px; height: 24px;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 5px;
      font-family: inherit; font-size: 11.5px;
      text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      background: #fff; color: #1e293b;
    }
    table.sub input[type="number"].qty-edit:focus {
      outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(45, 156, 219, 0.15);
    }
    table.sub input[type="number"].qty-edit.qty-dirty {
      border-color: #f59e0b; background: #fffbeb;
    }
    table.sub tr.finish-row-edit td.nr { padding-right: 6px; }
    /* Scrap-location hint under the Scrapped input — shows the
       location the scrap will be routed to when the operator enters
       a qty > 0. Green when the default location has enough stock,
       amber when we'll need a fallback query at Finish time, red
       when nothing in the LG has enough. */
    table.sub .scrap-hint {
      font-size: 10px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      color: #64748b; margin-top: 2px; text-align: right;
      max-width: 180px; margin-left: auto; line-height: 1.3;
      white-space: normal;
    }
    table.sub .scrap-hint.ok   { color: #047857; font-weight: 600; }
    table.sub .scrap-hint.warn { color: #b45309; font-weight: 600; }
    table.sub .scrap-hint.fail { color: #b91c1c; font-weight: 600; }

    /* FG tracking sub-panel — uses existing .fb-grid / .fb-group /
       .fb-field metrics. Only adds a top border to separate from
       the raw-material table. */
    .finish-fg-tracking {
      margin-top: 10px; padding-top: 10px;
      border-top: 1px dashed #cbd5e1;
    }
    .finish-fg-tracking input[type="text"],
    .finish-fg-tracking input[type="date"] {
      width: 100%; height: 30px;
      padding: 4px 8px;
      border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px;
      font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px; color: #374151;
      background: #fff;
    }
    .finish-fg-tracking input:focus {
      outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(45, 156, 219, 0.15);
    }
    .finish-fg-tracking textarea.finish-serial-textarea {
      width: 100%; min-height: 66px;
      padding: 5px 8px;
      border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px;
      font-family: 'Menlo', 'Consolas', 'Courier New', monospace;
      font-size: 11px; color: #1e293b; background: #fff;
      resize: vertical;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }
    .finish-fg-tracking textarea.finish-serial-textarea:focus {
      outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(45, 156, 219, 0.15);
    }
    .finish-fg-tracking textarea.finish-serial-textarea.error {
      border-color: #dc2626; background: #fef2f2;
    }
    .finish-fg-tracking .serial-count {
      font-size: 10.5px; color: #64748b; margin-top: 2px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }
    .finish-fg-tracking .serial-count.error { color: #b91c1c; font-weight: 600; }

    /* Source-tag allocation grid (raw serialized parts). Reuses the
       .ms-list scroll container + .ms-item row metrics so it looks
       like the existing filter dropdowns. */
    .finish-source-alloc {
      margin-top: 10px; padding-top: 10px;
      border-top: 1px dashed #cbd5e1;
    }
    .finish-source-alloc .alloc-part {
      font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #1e293b; margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .finish-source-alloc .alloc-list {
      border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px;
      max-height: 160px; overflow-y: auto; background: #fff;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .finish-source-alloc .alloc-item {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
      padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 12px; color: #334155;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #f3f4f6;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .finish-source-alloc .alloc-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .finish-source-alloc .alloc-item:hover { background: #eff6ff; }
    .finish-source-alloc .alloc-item input { margin: 0; }
    .finish-source-alloc .alloc-item .alloc-meta { color: #64748b; font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    .finish-source-alloc .alloc-note { font-size: 11px; color: #64748b; margin-top: 2px; }

    /* Source-serial summary rows inside the sub-detail — one row per
       serialized pickitem. Sits under the raw-material table. */
    .finish-serial-lines {
      margin-top: 10px; padding-top: 10px;
      border-top: 1px dashed #cbd5e1;
    }
    .finish-serial-lines .fsl-title {
      font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #475569;
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      margin: 0 0 6px 0;
    }
    .finish-serial-lines .fsl-row {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
      padding: 6px 10px; background: #fff;
      border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px;
      margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 12px;
    }
    .finish-serial-lines .fsl-row .fsl-part { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
    .finish-serial-lines .fsl-row .fsl-part strong { color: #1e293b; }
    .finish-serial-lines .fsl-row .fsl-part .muted { color: #94a3b8; margin-left: 6px; }
    .finish-serial-lines .fsl-row .fsl-count {
      font-size: 11px; color: #475569; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }
    .finish-serial-lines .fsl-row .fsl-count.ok { color: #047857; font-weight: 600; }
    .finish-serial-lines .fsl-row .fsl-count.warn { color: #b45309; font-weight: 600; }
    .finish-serial-lines .fsl-row .fsl-count.fail { color: #b91c1c; font-weight: 600; }
    .finish-serial-lines .fsl-row button.ds-btn { padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 11px; }

    /* Serial-selection modal (source parts) — full overlay + centered
       dialog. Backdrop uses .35 opacity so the finish banner stays
       visible-but-dimmed underneath. */
    .serial-modal-backdrop {
      position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.55);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      z-index: 9999;
    }
    .serial-modal {
      background: #fff; border-radius: 8px;
      width: min(560px, 92vw); max-height: 82vh;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.35);
      font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    }
    .serial-modal-head {
      padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
      display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .serial-modal-head h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #1e293b; }
    .serial-modal-head .sm-sub { font-size: 11px; color: #64748b; margin-top: 2px; }
    .serial-modal-close {
      background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 22px; color: #64748b; padding: 0 4px; line-height: 1;
    }
    .serial-modal-close:hover { color: #1e293b; }
    .serial-modal-toolbar {
      padding: 8px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
      display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center;
      font-size: 11px;
    }
    .serial-modal-toolbar input[type=text] {
      flex: 1; padding: 4px 8px;
      border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px;
      font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px; height: 28px;
    }
    .serial-modal-toolbar input[type=text]:focus {
      outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(45, 156, 219, 0.15);
    }
    .serial-modal-toolbar a {
      color: #2563eb; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500;
    }
    .serial-modal-toolbar a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
    .serial-modal-toolbar .sep { color: #cbd5e1; }
    .serial-modal-list {
      flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; user-select: none;
      padding: 4px 0;
    }
    .serial-modal-item {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
      padding: 6px 16px; font-size: 12px; color: #1e293b;
      cursor: pointer; line-height: 1.4;
    }
    .serial-modal-item:hover { background: #f8fafc; }
    .serial-modal-item.selected { background: #dbeafe; }
    .serial-modal-item.selected:hover { background: #bfdbfe; }
    .serial-modal-item .sn {
      font-family: 'Menlo', 'Consolas', 'Courier New', monospace;
      font-weight: 500; flex: 1;
    }
    .serial-modal-item .sn-meta {
      color: #64748b; font-size: 10.5px;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }
    .serial-modal-item input[type="checkbox"] {
      margin: 0; pointer-events: none; flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .serial-modal-item.readonly { cursor: default; }
    .serial-modal-item.readonly.selected { background: #d1fae5; }
    /* Group header inside the combined "view all serials" modal —
       one per source part, sits above its serial rows. */
    .serial-modal-group-head {
      padding: 8px 16px 4px 16px;
      font-size: 11px; color: #475569;
      background: #f8fafc; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
      position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1;
    }
    .serial-modal-group-head:first-child { border-top: none; }
    .serial-modal-group-head strong { color: #1e293b; font-size: 12px; }
    .serial-modal-empty {
      padding: 16px; color: #94a3b8; font-size: 12px;
      text-align: center; font-style: italic;
    }
    .serial-modal-foot {
      padding: 10px 16px; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
      display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .serial-modal-foot .sm-count {
      font-size: 12px; color: #475569;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }
    .serial-modal-foot .sm-count.ok { color: #047857; font-weight: 600; }
    .serial-modal-foot .sm-count.warn { color: #b45309; font-weight: 600; }
    .serial-modal-foot .sm-count.fail { color: #b91c1c; font-weight: 600; }
    .serial-modal-foot .sm-actions { display: flex; gap: 6px; }

    /* FG-serials modal — tabbed layout with a persistent preview
       textarea at the bottom. Reuses the .serial-modal-* chrome for
       the outer shell so the two modals look consistent. */
    .fg-modal-tabs {
      display: flex; gap: 2px;
      padding: 0 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
      background: #f8fafc;
    }
    .fg-modal-tab {
      padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600;
      color: #64748b; background: transparent; border: none;
      border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; cursor: pointer;
      font-family: inherit;
    }
    .fg-modal-tab:hover { color: #1e293b; }
    .fg-modal-tab.active {
      color: var(--color-primary);
      border-bottom-color: var(--color-primary);
    }
    .fg-modal-tab-content {
      padding: 10px 16px 6px 16px;
      border-bottom: 1px dashed #e2e8f0;
    }
    .fg-modal-tab-content .fg-mode-help {
      font-size: 11px; color: #64748b; margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .fg-modal-tab-content .fg-mode-help code {
      background: #f1f5f9; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 3px;
      font-family: 'Menlo', 'Consolas', 'Courier New', monospace;
      font-size: 10.5px;
    }
    .fg-generate-row {
      display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .fg-generate-row label { font-size: 11px; color: #475569; font-weight: 600; }
    .fg-generate-row input[type=text],
    .fg-generate-row input[type=number] {
      padding: 5px 8px;
      border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px;
      font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px; height: 30px;
    }
    .fg-generate-row input[type=text] { min-width: 180px; }
    .fg-generate-row input[type=number] { width: 84px; }
    .fg-generate-row input:focus {
      outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(45, 156, 219, 0.15);
    }
    /* Reuse .serial-modal-list for the raws-picker inside the raws
       tab, but cap it shorter so the persistent preview textarea
       still fits without the modal outgrowing the viewport. */
    .fg-modal-tab-content .serial-modal-list {
      max-height: 200px;
      border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px;
      background: #fff;
    }
    .fg-modal-workarea {
      padding: 10px 16px;
    }
    .fg-modal-workarea > label {
      display: block; margin-bottom: 4px;
      font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #475569;
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }
    .fg-modal-workarea textarea {
      width: 100%; min-height: 120px;
      padding: 6px 8px;
      border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px;
      font-family: 'Menlo', 'Consolas', 'Courier New', monospace;
      font-size: 11px; color: #1e293b; background: #fff;
      resize: vertical; line-height: 1.45;
    }
    .fg-modal-workarea textarea:focus {
      outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(45, 156, 219, 0.15);
    }
    .fg-modal-workarea textarea.dragover {
      border-color: var(--color-primary); background: #eff6ff;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(45, 156, 219, 0.2);
    }
    .fg-modal-workarea .drop-hint {
      font-size: 10.5px; color: #64748b; margin-top: 4px;
    }

    /* Progress ticker inside the banner — steps are inline .badge chips */
    .finish-steps { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .finish-steps .badge { padding: 1px 6px; font-size: 10.5px; }
    .finish-steps .badge.done { background: #d1fae5; color: #065f46; }
    .finish-steps .badge.pending { background: #f1f5f9; color: #64748b; }
    .finish-steps .badge.active { background: #dbeafe; color: #1e40af; }
    .finish-steps .badge.fail { background: #fee2e2; color: #991b1b; }
</style>
</head>
<body>

  <div class="wrap">

    <!-- HEADER -->
    <header>
      <div>
        <h1>Work Order / WIP</h1>
        <p id="statusLine">Initialising…</p>
      </div>
      <div class="hdr-actions">
        <button class="hdr-btn" onclick="loadAll()" title="Reload data">
          <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 4v5h.582m15.356 2A8.001 8.001 0 004.582 9m0 0H9m11 11v-5h-.581m0 0a8.003 8.003 0 01-15.357-2m15.357 2H15"/></svg>
          Refresh
        </button>
        <button class="hdr-btn" onclick="exportCSV()" title="Export as CSV">
          <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 10v6m0 0l-3-3m3 3l3-3m2 8H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414a1 1 0 01.293.707V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z"/></svg>
          CSV
        </button>
        <button class="hdr-btn hdr-btn-icon" id="helpBtn" type="button" onclick="FBLib.Common.toggleDrawer('helpOverlay')" title="Help">
          <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8.228 9c.549-1.165 2.03-2 3.772-2 2.21 0 4 1.343 4 3 0 1.4-1.278 2.575-3.006 2.907-.542.104-.994.54-.994 1.093M12 17h.01M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"/></svg>
        </button>
        <button class="hdr-btn hdr-btn-icon" id="setBtn" type="button" onclick="FBLib.Common.toggleDrawer('setOverlay')" title="Settings">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M19.14 12.94c.04-.31.06-.62.06-.94 0-.32-.02-.63-.06-.94l2.03-1.58a.49.49 0 00.12-.61l-1.92-3.32a.488.488 0 00-.59-.22l-2.39.96a7.03 7.03 0 00-1.62-.94l-.36-2.54a.484.484 0 00-.48-.41h-3.84c-.24 0-.43.17-.47.41l-.36 2.54c-.59.24-1.13.56-1.62.94l-2.39-.96c-.22-.08-.47 0-.59.22L2.74 8.87c-.12.21-.08.47.12.61l2.03 1.58c-.04.31-.06.63-.06.94 0 .32.02.63.06.94l-2.03 1.58a.49.49 0 00-.12.61l1.92 3.32c.12.22.37.29.59.22l2.39-.96c.5.38 1.03.7 1.62.94l.36 2.54c.05.24.24.41.48.41h3.84c.24 0 .44-.17.47-.41l.36-2.54c.59-.24 1.13-.56 1.62-.94l2.39.96c.22.08.47 0 .59-.22l1.92-3.32c.12-.22.07-.47-.12-.61l-2.01-1.58zM12 15.6A3.6 3.6 0 018.4 12 3.6 3.6 0 0112 8.4a3.6 3.6 0 013.6 3.6 3.6 3.6 0 01-3.6 3.6z"/></svg>
        </button>
      </div>
    </header>

    <!-- ================================================================
         SETTINGS — fb-drawer style (sits in the flex flow between
         header and content, per the canonical .fb-drawer pattern). Both
         drawers default to display:none; FBLib.Common.toggleDrawer
         adds the .open class to show.
         ================================================================ -->
    <div id="setOverlay" class="fb-drawer">
      <div class="fb-drawer-head">
        <h2>⚙ Settings</h2>
        <button type="button" class="fb-drawer-close" onclick="FBLib.Common.closeDrawer('setOverlay')" aria-label="Close">×</button>
      </div>
      <div class="fb-drawer-body">
        <div id="dsLockBadge" class="ds-lock-badge" style="display:none;">Locked by admin — your changes won't be saved.</div>
        <div class="fb-grid">
          <div class="fb-group">
            <div class="fb-group-title">Display</div>
            <div class="fb-field">
              <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;">
                <input type="checkbox" id="dsExpanded" onchange="onSettingsChange()" />
                <span>Expand all MOs by default</span>
              </label>
            </div>
            <div class="fb-field">
              <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;">
                <input type="checkbox" id="dsShowFulfilled" onchange="onSettingsChange()" />
                <span>Include fulfilled / closed WOs</span>
              </label>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="fb-group">
            <div class="fb-group-title">Finish behaviour</div>
            <div class="fb-field">
              <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;">
                <input type="checkbox" id="dsAutoApplyFgDefaults" onchange="onSettingsChange()" />
                <span>Auto-apply FG tracking defaults on Finish</span>
              </label>
              <span class="muted" style="font-size:11px; line-height:1.35;">
                Off (default): operator must click <em>Use suggestion</em> for each derived default before Finish will run.
                On: computed defaults (WO# batch, today's date, WO-num serials) commit silently.
                Fishbowl-driven <code>nextValue</code>s always auto-apply either way.
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="fb-group">
            <div class="fb-group-title">Diagnostics</div>
            <div class="fb-field">
              <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;">
                <input type="checkbox" id="dsDebug" onchange="onSettingsChange()" />
                <span>Show debug console</span>
              </label>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div id="dsAdminSection" style="display:none; margin-top:14px; padding-top:14px; border-top: 1px dashed #cbd5e1;">
          <div class="fb-group-title">Admin</div>
          <button type="button" class="ds-btn ds-btn-admin" onclick="publishMaster()">Publish as default for everyone</button>
          <button type="button" class="ds-btn ds-btn-admin" id="dsLockBtn" onclick="toggleUserEditing()">Lock user editing</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="fb-drawer-foot">
        <button type="button" class="ds-btn" onclick="resetSettings()">Reset to defaults</button>
        <button type="button" class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary" onclick="FBLib.Common.closeDrawer('setOverlay')">Done</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- HELP — fb-drawer style -->
    <div id="helpOverlay" class="fb-drawer">
      <div class="fb-drawer-head">
        <h2>📖 How to read this report</h2>
        <button type="button" class="fb-drawer-close" onclick="FBLib.Common.closeDrawer('helpOverlay')" aria-label="Close">×</button>
      </div>
      <div class="fb-drawer-body">
        <div class="fb-grid">
          <div class="fb-group" style="flex:1 1 320px;">
            <div class="fb-group-title">What you're looking at</div>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">One row per <strong>Manufacture Order</strong> (blue header) and one indented row per <strong>Work Order</strong> beneath it. Click an MO chevron to fold its WOs; click a WO chevron to drill into the raw-material lines being consumed.</p>
            <div class="fb-group-title">Progress %</div>
            <ul style="font-size:12px; color:#334155; padding-left:18px; margin:4px 0;">
              <li><strong>WO row:</strong> step-count from <code>woinstruction</code> — completed steps (qtyFulfilled ≥ qtyReady) ÷ total steps.</li>
              <li><strong>MO row:</strong> qty-weighted average of its WOs by <code>wo.qtyTarget</code>.</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
          <div class="fb-group" style="flex:1 1 320px;">
            <div class="fb-group-title">Pick column</div>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">Aggregate of every pick attached via <code>pickitem.woItemId</code>. Badge shows the worst still-open status; the count is <code>finished/total</code>. "No picks" means none have been generated yet.</p>
            <div class="fb-group-title">WIP value KPI</div>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">Sum of <code>tag.qty × partcost.avgCost</code> for tags bound to in-progress WOs via <code>tag.woItemId</code>. Uses avg cost — close approximation for FIFO/LIFO but not layer-accurate.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="fb-group" style="flex:1 1 320px;">
            <div class="fb-group-title">Open requirements KPI</div>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">Value of raw-material <code>woitem</code> lines (typeId=20) not yet fulfilled, at avg cost — money that still needs to flow into WIP.</p>
            <div class="fb-group-title">Cost column</div>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">Running cost of the WO = parts <strong>staged in WIP</strong> (tag.qty × avgCost) + parts <strong>already consumed</strong> (woitem.qtyUsed × avgCost). For a Fulfilled WO (status 40) the WIP portion settles to 0 and this becomes the actual cost. The MO row sums across its WOs. Hover for the staged vs. consumed split.</p>
            <div class="fb-group-title">MO/WO data model</div>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">The output part is read through <code>moitem(typeid=50, parent)</code> → child <code>moitem(typeid=10)</code> → <code>part</code>. <code>wo.moItemId</code> points at the typeid=50 parent. The MO's "finished good" column shows typeid=10 outputs with <code>stagelevel=1</code> (top of the stage tree).</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- KPI BAR -->
    <div id="kpiBar">
      <div class="kpi"      id="kpiMOs"     ><span class="kpi-label">MOs in progress</span><span class="kpi-value">—</span><span class="kpi-sub" id="kpiMOsSub"> </span></div>
      <div class="kpi"      id="kpiWOs"     ><span class="kpi-label">WOs in progress</span><span class="kpi-value">—</span><span class="kpi-sub" id="kpiWOsSub"> </span></div>
      <div class="kpi money" id="kpiWipVal" ><span class="kpi-label">WIP value</span><span class="kpi-value">—</span><span class="kpi-sub">Parts in WIP at avg cost</span></div>
      <div class="kpi money" id="kpiOpenVal"><span class="kpi-label">Open requirements</span><span class="kpi-value">—</span><span class="kpi-sub">Unpicked raw mat. at avg cost</span></div>
      <div class="kpi ok"    id="kpiAvgPct" ><span class="kpi-label">Avg MO completion</span><span class="kpi-value">—</span><span class="kpi-sub">Qty-weighted</span></div>
      <div class="kpi late"  id="kpiLate"   ><span class="kpi-label">Late WOs</span><span class="kpi-value">—</span><span class="kpi-sub">Scheduled date passed</span></div>
      <div class="kpi warn"  id="kpiPicksPending"><span class="kpi-label">Picks pending</span><span class="kpi-value">—</span><span class="kpi-sub">Not yet finished</span></div>
      <div class="kpi"       id="kpiOldest" ><span class="kpi-label">Oldest started</span><span class="kpi-value">—</span><span class="kpi-sub" id="kpiOldestSub"> </span></div>
    </div>

    <!-- FILTER STRIP -->
    <div id="filtersBar">
      <span class="fl-label">Search</span>
      <input type="text" id="searchInput" placeholder="MO# / WO# / part# / description" />
      <span class="fl-divider"></span>

      <span class="fl-label">Sched range</span>
      <select id="dateRangeSel" onchange="onDateRangeChange()" class="ms-trigger" style="min-width:140px; cursor:pointer;">
        <option value="all">All dates</option>
        <option value="overdue">Overdue</option>
        <option value="today">Today</option>
        <option value="next7">Next 7 days</option>
        <option value="next30">Next 30 days</option>
        <option value="thisMonth">This month</option>
        <option value="custom">Custom range…</option>
      </select>
      <span id="customDateInputs" style="display:none; align-items:center; gap:4px;">
        <input type="date" id="dateStart" onchange="onCustomDateChange()" style="height:30px; padding:4px 6px; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:6px; font-size:12px; font-family:inherit;" />
        <span style="color:#94a3b8;">→</span>
        <input type="date" id="dateEnd"   onchange="onCustomDateChange()" style="height:30px; padding:4px 6px; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:6px; font-size:12px; font-family:inherit;" />
      </span>
      <span class="fl-divider"></span>

      <span class="fl-label">Location group</span>
      <div class="ms-container" id="lgMs">
        <div class="ms-trigger" id="lgTrigger" onclick="MS.toggle('lg', event)">
          <span class="ms-placeholder">All</span>
        </div>
        <div class="ms-dropdown hidden" id="lgDropdown" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
          <div class="ms-search"><input type="text" placeholder="Search…" id="lgSearch" oninput="MS.search('lg', this.value)" /></div>
          <div class="ms-actions"><span onclick="MS.selectAll('lg')">Select all</span><span onclick="MS.clear('lg')">Clear</span></div>
          <div class="ms-list" id="lgList"></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <span class="fl-label">Cal category</span>
      <div class="ms-container" id="catMs">
        <div class="ms-trigger" id="catTrigger" onclick="MS.toggle('cat', event)">
          <span class="ms-placeholder">All</span>
        </div>
        <div class="ms-dropdown hidden" id="catDropdown" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
          <div class="ms-search"><input type="text" placeholder="Search…" id="catSearch" oninput="MS.search('cat', this.value)" /></div>
          <div class="ms-actions"><span onclick="MS.selectAll('cat')">Select all</span><span onclick="MS.clear('cat')">Clear</span></div>
          <div class="ms-list" id="catList"></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <span class="fl-divider"></span>
      <span class="fl-label">MO status</span>
      <div class="ms-container" id="mostatMs">
        <div class="ms-trigger" id="mostatTrigger" onclick="MS.toggle('mostat', event)">
          <span class="ms-placeholder">Issued + Partial</span>
        </div>
        <div class="ms-dropdown hidden" id="mostatDropdown" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
          <div class="ms-actions"><span onclick="MS.selectAll('mostat')">Select all</span><span onclick="MS.clear('mostat')">Clear</span></div>
          <div class="ms-list" id="mostatList"></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <span class="fl-label">WO status</span>
      <div class="ms-container" id="wostatMs">
        <div class="ms-trigger" id="wostatTrigger" onclick="MS.toggle('wostat', event)">
          <span class="ms-placeholder">Entered + Started</span>
        </div>
        <div class="ms-dropdown hidden" id="wostatDropdown" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
          <div class="ms-actions"><span onclick="MS.selectAll('wostat')">Select all</span><span onclick="MS.clear('wostat')">Clear</span></div>
          <div class="ms-list" id="wostatList"></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <span class="fl-divider"></span>
      <label class="fl-label" title="Only show WOs whose pick is committed and are not already fulfilled — the WOs you can Finish right now." style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;cursor:pointer;">
        <input type="checkbox" id="finishReadyOnly" onchange="onFinishReadyChange()" style="cursor:pointer;" />
        Ready to finish
      </label>
    </div>

    <!-- TABLE -->
    <div id="tableScroll">
      <div id="loadOverlay">
        <svg class="spin" width="36" height="36" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none">
          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="3"/>
          <path d="M12 2a10 10 0 0 1 10 10" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        </svg>
        <div id="loadMsg">Loading…</div>
      </div>
      <table class="wip" id="wipTable">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th class="sortable" data-sort="date" onclick="onSortClick('date')">
              Sched <span class="sort-arrow" id="sortArrowDate"></span>
            </th>
            <th class="sortable" data-sort="num" onclick="onSortClick('num')">
              MO / WO <span class="sort-arrow" id="sortArrowNum"></span>
            </th>
            <th>Output part</th>
            <th>Status</th>
            <th>Cal category</th>
            <th>Pick</th>
            <th class="nr">Cost</th>
            <th class="nr">Qty</th>
            <th>Steps</th>
            <th class="nr">Progress</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="wipBody">
          <tr><td colspan="10" class="empty">Loading…</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
       Report logic
       ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
  <script>
  (function () {
    'use strict';

    // ── Runtime guard ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (typeof runQuery !== 'function' && typeof runQueryAsync !== 'function') {
      document.body.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:40px;font-family:sans-serif;color:#475569;">' +
        '<h2>Not running inside Fishbowl</h2><p>This report requires the Fishbowl BI environment.</p></div>';
      return;
    }
    if (!window.FBLib || !FBLib.Common || !FBLib.Settings) {
      document.body.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:40px;font-family:sans-serif;color:#b91c1c;">' +
        '<h2>fb-lib not loaded</h2><p>This report needs the saved Script <code>fb-lib</code> to be present on this Fishbowl server. ' +
        'Ask an admin to deploy <code>scripts/fb-lib.js</code> as a Script named <code>fb-lib</code>.</p></div>';
      return;
    }

    // ── Settings init ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Defaults: WO status starts UNFILTERED (empty array = match all
    // WOs under the matching MOs). MO status defaults to "in-progress"
    // (Issued + Partial). Anything else and the user can narrow via
    // the filter chips.
    FBLib.Settings.init({
      userKey:   'cdx.bi.workorderwip.user.v1',
      masterKey: 'cdx.bi.workorderwip.master.v1',
      defaults: {
        v: 1,
        expanded: false,
        showFulfilled: false,
        showDebug: false,
        moStatuses: [20, 50],
        woStatuses: [],          // empty = no WO status filter
        lgIds: [],
        catIds: [],
        // Sort + date-range filter — persisted so the user's last
        // view sticks across reloads. Default: descending by scheduled
        // date (matches the original ORDER BY in the SQL).
        sortKey: 'date',         // 'date' | 'num'
        sortDir: 'desc',         // 'asc'  | 'desc'
        dateRange: 'all',        // 'all'|'overdue'|'today'|'next7'|'next30'|'thisMonth'|'custom'
        dateStart: '',           // YYYY-MM-DD when dateRange = 'custom'
        dateEnd:   '',
        // "Ready to finish" chip — when true, hide WOs that aren't
        // finishable (pick not committed, or already fulfilled). Pure
        // client-side filter applied in render(); no re-query needed.
        finishReadyOnly: false,
        // Auto-apply FG tracking defaults on Finish. When TRUE, any
        // FG tracking def without a parttotracking.nextvalue gets its
        // derived default (WO# batch, today's date, WO-num serial
        // sequence) committed automatically at Finish. When FALSE
        // (safer default), the operator must confirm each derived
        // default per-field before Finish is allowed. Mandatory
        // (nextvalue-driven) defs are always auto-applied — Fishbowl's
        // contract says that value must be used.
        autoApplyFgDefaults: false,
      },
      propFallback: {
        showDebug: { name: 'BI_SHOW_DEBUG', dflt: 'false', parse: function (v) { return v === 'true' || v === true; } }
      }
    });

    // ── Local helpers (fb-lib first, fall back if older library) ──
    var C = FBLib.Common;
    function fmtMoney(v) { try { return C.formatMoney(v); } catch (_) { var n=parseFloat(v); return isNaN(n)?'—':'$'+n.toFixed(2); } }
    function fmtQty(v)   { try { return C.formatQty(v); }   catch (_) { var n=parseFloat(v); return isNaN(n)?'':String(n); } }
    function fmtDate(v)  { try { return C.formatDate(v); }  catch (_) { return String(v||'').slice(0,10); } }
    function escSQL(s)   { try { return C.escSQL(s); }      catch (_) { return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/'/g,"''"); } }
    function esc(s)      { return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/"/g,'"'); }
    function setStatus(m){ var el=document.getElementById('statusLine'); if(el) el.textContent=m; }
    function dbg(m, t)   { try { if (C.DEBUG_MODE) C.debugLog(m, t || 'info'); } catch (_) {} }

    // Generate N sequential serial-number strings from a seed value.
    // Splits the seed on its trailing digit run: prefix + N-digit
    // number → keeps the prefix, increments the number, preserves
    // zero-padding. Seed "SN-001" + count 3 → ["SN-001","SN-002","SN-003"].
    // Seed "12345" + count 2 → ["12345","12346"]. Fallback for seeds
    // with no trailing digits: append "-001", "-002", …. Fishbowl's
    // SaveWorkOrder requires FG serials passed explicitly for a
    // serialised FG (error 4224 otherwise) — we pre-fill the textarea
    // from parttotracking.nextValue so the operator doesn't type them
    // by hand.
    function generateFgSerials(seed, count) {
      var s = String(seed || '');
      var m = s.match(/^(.*?)(\d+)$/);
      var prefix, startNum, pad;
      if (m) {
        prefix = m[1];
        startNum = parseInt(m[2], 10);
        pad = m[2].length;
      } else {
        prefix = s + (s ? '-' : '');
        startNum = 1;
        pad = Math.max(3, String(count).length);
      }
      var out = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        out.push(prefix + String(startNum + i).padStart(pad, '0'));
      }
      return out;
    }

    // How many FG serials Fishbowl actually expects, given a WO.
    // In Fishbowl `wo.qtyTarget` can be the "batch count" (often 1)
    // while the typeid=10 woitem carries the true per-unit output qty
    // that Fishbowl uses for its "Expected: N" serial check. We loaded
    // that as `wo.outputs[0].qty`; use it if present, else fall back
    // to wo.qtyTarget so single-output workflows still work.
    function fgSerialQty(wo) {
      if (wo && wo.outputs && wo.outputs.length) {
        var q = parseFloat(wo.outputs[0].qty) || 0;
        if (q > 0) return q;
      }
      return wo && wo.qtyTarget ? wo.qtyTarget : 0;
    }

    // Parse an FG-serials textarea into an array of trimmed non-empty
    // strings. Splits on newline OR comma so pasted CSV works out of
    // the box — a paste like "6083,1,2,3,…,11" becomes 12 serials
    // instead of one. Same helper is used everywhere serials are
    // counted (renderSerialCountText, onFinishClick, modal counts).
    function parseFgSerials(text) {
      return String(text || '')
        .split(/[\r\n,]+/)
        .map(function (s) { return s.trim(); })
        .filter(Boolean);
    }

    // Effective "Used" qty for a raw-material line — used by the
    // Consumed % display, override-collection, and read-only render.
    // When line.usedInput is null / empty, we fall back to line.target
    // (the Used input's placeholder value the operator saw). This is
    // what lets an operator leave the whole Used column blank and
    // still have Finish consume the target qty rather than 0.
    function effectiveUsedQty(line) {
      if (!line) return 0;
      var v = line.usedInput;
      if (v == null || v === '') return Number(line.target) || 0;
      var n = parseFloat(v);
      return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : (Number(line.target) || 0);
    }
    // Same fallback shape for the Scrapped input — blank falls back
    // to 0 (Scrapped is opt-in; empty means "nothing to scrap").
    function effectiveScrapQty(line) {
      if (!line) return 0;
      var v = line.scrappedInput;
      if (v == null || v === '') return 0;
      var n = parseFloat(v);
      return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
    }

    // ============================================================
    // SCRAP HELPERS — ImportScrapData bridge
    // ============================================================
    // When a raw-material line has a non-zero Scrapped input, Finish
    // routes it through Fishbowl's Import API (ImportScrapData). We:
    //   1. Resolve a Location for the scrap (default location for
    //      the part in the WO's LG; else the next-available tag
    //      location with enough stock).
    //   2. Validate stock at that location >= scrap qty.
    //   3. Fetch the canonical ImportScrapData header once per
    //      Finish (Fishbowl may add columns; we position values by
    //      header name).
    //   4. Build a CSV and POST via runApiRequest('ImportRq', …).
    // The scrap step is interleaved between SavePickRq and
    // SaveWorkOrderRq so any failure surfaces before the WO is
    // marked Fulfilled — the operator can retry after fixing stock.
    //
    // Location format follows the Fishbowl import spec: LG-Location
    // (e.g. "Main-Stock 100"). See Bulk_Scrap_Helper.htm for the
    // canonical pattern; the code below mirrors its transport.
    // ============================================================

    // Cached ImportScrapData column metadata across a single Finish
    // click. Reset per invocation via ensureScrapImportHeader() so a
    // stale header doesn't survive a settings-drawer schema change.
    var _scrapImp = null;
    function ensureScrapImportHeader() {
      if (_scrapImp) return _scrapImp;
      if (typeof runApiRequest !== 'function') {
        throw new Error('Import API (runApiRequest) is not available — cannot scrap without it.');
      }
      var resp = runApiRequest('ImportHeaderRq',
        JSON.stringify({ ImportHeaderRq: { Type: 'ImportScrapData' } }));
      var r = typeof resp === 'string' ? JSON.parse(resp) : resp;
      var header = extractImportHeader(r);
      if (!Array.isArray(header) || !header.length) {
        throw new Error('Could not parse ImportScrapData header: ' + JSON.stringify(r));
      }
      function normHdr(s) { return String(s == null ? '' : s).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, ''); }
      function find(patterns) {
        for (var k = 0; k < patterns.length; k++) {
          var i = header.findIndex(function (h) { return patterns[k].test(normHdr(h)); });
          if (i >= 0) return i;
        }
        return -1;
      }
      var partIdx = find([/^partnumber$/, /^partnum$/, /partnumber/]);
      var locIdx  = find([/^location$/, /^locationname$/]);
      var qtyIdx  = find([/^qty$/, /^quantity$/]);
      var noteIdx = find([/^note$/]);
      var dateIdx = find([/^date$/]);
      if (partIdx < 0) throw new Error('No PartNumber column in ImportScrapData header: ' + header.join(', '));
      if (locIdx  < 0) throw new Error('No Location column in ImportScrapData header: ' + header.join(', '));
      if (qtyIdx  < 0) throw new Error('No Qty column in ImportScrapData header: ' + header.join(', '));
      // Tracking-* columns are matched dynamically per tag's field
      // names / abbreviations (Fishbowl adds one column per active
      // parttracking on any part in the install — Tracking-Lot Number,
      // Tracking-Expiration Date, Tracking-Serial Number, etc.).
      var trackingCols = [];
      header.forEach(function (h, i) {
        if (/^tracking/.test(normHdr(h))) trackingCols.push({ i: i, name: h, norm: normHdr(h) });
      });
      _scrapImp = { header: header, partIdx: partIdx, locIdx: locIdx, qtyIdx: qtyIdx,
                    noteIdx: noteIdx, dateIdx: dateIdx, trackingCols: trackingCols };
      dbg('ImportScrapData header (' + header.length + ' cols, ' +
        trackingCols.length + ' tracking): ' + header.join(', '), 'info');
      return _scrapImp;
    }
    // Fill Tracking-* columns from a tag's fields[] (each {name, abbr, info}).
    // Match strategy: normalise the header + the field name+abbr, then
    // pick the column whose normalised name contains either the field
    // name or abbr. Matches Cycle_Count's fill logic.
    function fillScrapTrackingCols(vals, imp, fields) {
      if (!imp.trackingCols.length || !Array.isArray(fields)) return;
      function normHdr(s) { return String(s == null ? '' : s).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, ''); }
      fields.forEach(function (f) {
        var wantA = normHdr(f.abbr), wantN = normHdr(f.name);
        var col = imp.trackingCols.find(function (c) {
          return (wantN && c.norm.indexOf(wantN) !== -1) || (wantA && c.norm.indexOf(wantA) !== -1);
        });
        if (col && f.info != null && f.info !== '') {
          var val = String(f.info);
          // Fishbowl's CSV importer parses date values against the
          // install's DateFormatShort (e.g. dd/MM/yyyy for AU). Feed
          // it the ISO YYYY-MM-DD from tagtrackingview verbatim and
          // it silently treats the row as missing that tracking
          // field — same as if the column were blank. Route through
          // FBLib.Common.formatDate so the value matches whatever
          // format the server expects.
          if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}([ T]|$)/.test(val)) {
            try { val = C.formatDate(val); } catch (_) { val = val.slice(0, 10); }
          }
          vals[col.i] = val;
        }
      });
    }
    function extractImportHeader(r) {
      // Fishbowl returns the CSV header as a single string or an
      // array of column names. Bulk_Scrap_Helper handles both — we
      // do the same for compatibility.
      var h = r && r.ImportHeaderRs && r.ImportHeaderRs.Header;
      if (h == null) return null;
      if (h && typeof h === 'object' && !Array.isArray(h)) h = h.Row;
      if (typeof h === 'string') return parseCsvLine(h);
      if (Array.isArray(h)) {
        if (h.length === 1 && typeof h[0] === 'string' && h[0].indexOf(',') >= 0) return parseCsvLine(h[0]);
        return h.map(function (x) { return String(x).replace(/^"|"$/g, '').trim(); });
      }
      return null;
    }
    function parseCsvLine(line) {
      var out = [], cur = '', inq = false;
      for (var i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {
        var ch = line[i];
        if (inq) {
          if (ch === '"') { if (line[i + 1] === '"') { cur += '"'; i++; } else inq = false; }
          else cur += ch;
        } else {
          if (ch === '"') inq = true;
          else if (ch === ',') { out.push(cur); cur = ''; }
          else cur += ch;
        }
      }
      out.push(cur);
      return out.map(function (s) { return s.trim(); });
    }
    function csvEsc(v) { return '"' + String(v == null ? '' : v).replace(/"/g, '""') + '"'; }

    // Resolve a scrap location for one raw-material line.
    // Returns:
    //   { locId, lgName, locName, availQty, source: 'default' | 'fallback' }
    // or null if no location in the LG has enough stock to cover
    // the requested scrap qty. Preference (per spec):
    //   1. The part's default location in the WO's LG (pre-loaded
    //      on the line, no query needed here).
    //   2. Any pickable tag location with sufficient stock —
    //      falls back to a query when the default falls short.
    // Note: "same pick location as the original pick" isn't handled
    // here — pick source locations aren't reliably queryable for
    // pending picks, and once committed the pick has already
    // reduced stock at that location. If needed, we can add it as
    // a step-0 preference later.
    async function resolveScrapLocation(line, lgId, scrapQty) {
      var partId = line.partId || null;
      // Step 1 — default location, if it has enough stock.
      if (line.defaultLocId && line.defaultLocName && line.defaultLocAvail >= scrapQty) {
        return {
          locId: line.defaultLocId,
          lgName: line.defaultLgName,
          locName: line.defaultLocName,
          availQty: line.defaultLocAvail,
          source: 'default',
        };
      }
      if (!partId) return null;
      // Step 2 — fallback: next tag location in the LG with enough
      // stock. Ordered by MIN(tag.datecreated) so the oldest
      // location wins (matches FIFO semantics for picking).
      var lgClause = lgId ? "AND l.locationgroupid = " + parseInt(lgId, 10) + " " : '';
      var sql =
        "SELECT * FROM (" +
        "  SELECT l.id AS locid, l.name AS loc_name, lg.name AS lg_name, " +
        "         SUM(GREATEST(t.qty - COALESCE(t.qtycommitted, 0), 0)) AS avail, " +
        "         MIN(t.datecreated) AS oldest " +
        "  FROM tag t " +
        "  JOIN location l ON l.id = t.locationid " +
        "  JOIN locationgroup lg ON lg.id = l.locationgroupid " +
        "  WHERE t.partid = " + parseInt(partId, 10) + " " +
        "    AND t.typeid IN (30, 40) " +
        "    AND l.countedasavailable = 1 " +
        "    AND l.pickable = 1 " +
        "    " + lgClause +
        "  GROUP BY l.id, l.name, lg.name " +
        "  HAVING avail >= " + Number(scrapQty).toFixed(6) + " " +
        "  ORDER BY oldest, l.id " +
        "  LIMIT 1" +
        ") AS wrapped";
      try {
        var rows = await qp(sql);
        if (rows.length) {
          return {
            locId:   parseInt(rows[0].locid, 10) || 0,
            lgName:  rows[0].lg_name || '',
            locName: rows[0].loc_name || '',
            availQty: parseFloat(rows[0].avail) || 0,
            source: 'fallback',
          };
        }
      } catch (e) {
        dbg('resolveScrapLocation query failed: ' + (e && e.message || e), 'warn');
      }
      return null;
    }

    // Allocate the scrap qty across the tags at a specific location.
    // Returns an array of "allocation" entries the caller expands
    // into one or more CSV rows.
    //
    // Non-serial parts (isSerialTracked=false):
    //   FIFO by tag.datecreated. One allocation per tag with its
    //   lot-tracking fields (name/abbr/info from tagtrackingview).
    //   Result: { kind: 'lot', qty, fields[] } per tag.
    //
    // Serial parts (isSerialTracked=true):
    //   Pick N whole units from tags at the location, FIFO by tag
    //   date. Group units by their lot signature (unique combo of
    //   lot-tracking values) so each group emits its own item row
    //   + optional serial-header + one row per unit.
    //   Result: { kind: 'serial-group', qty, fields[], serialFields[],
    //             serials: [{vals: [{ptid, name, value}]}] }.
    //
    // Returns { allocations: [...], covered: bool }.
    async function allocateScrapTags(partId, locId, qtyNeeded, isSerialTracked) {
      if (isSerialTracked) {
        return await allocateScrapSerials(partId, locId, qtyNeeded);
      }
      return await allocateScrapLots(partId, locId, qtyNeeded);
    }

    async function allocateScrapLots(partId, locId, qtyNeeded) {
      var sql =
        "SELECT * FROM (" +
        "  SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.num AS tag_num, " +
        "         GREATEST(t.qty - COALESCE(t.qtycommitted, 0), 0) AS avail, " +
        "         t.datecreated AS date_created, " +
        "         ttv.parttrackingid AS ptid, ttv.name AS tname, " +
        "         ttv.abbr AS tabbr, ttv.info AS tinfo, " +
        "         ttv.infoformatted AS tfmt, ttv.sortorder AS tsort " +
        "  FROM tag t " +
        "  LEFT JOIN tagtrackingview ttv ON ttv.tagid = t.id AND ttv.typeid <> 40 " +
        "  WHERE t.partid = " + parseInt(partId, 10) + " " +
        "    AND t.locationid = " + parseInt(locId, 10) + " " +
        "    AND t.typeid IN (30, 40) " +
        "    AND (t.qty - COALESCE(t.qtycommitted, 0)) > 0 " +
        "  ORDER BY t.datecreated, t.id, ttv.sortorder" +
        ") AS wrapped";
      var rows;
      try { rows = await qp(sql); }
      catch (e) {
        dbg('allocateScrapLots failed: ' + (e && e.message || e), 'warn');
        return { allocations: [], covered: false };
      }
      var byTag = {};
      var order = [];
      rows.forEach(function (r) {
        var id = parseInt(r.tag_id, 10);
        if (!id) return;
        if (!byTag[id]) {
          byTag[id] = {
            tagId: id,
            tagNum: r.tag_num == null ? '' : String(r.tag_num),
            avail: parseFloat(r.avail) || 0,
            fields: [],
          };
          order.push(id);
        }
        if (r.ptid != null && r.tabbr != null) {
          var val = r.tfmt != null ? r.tfmt : (r.tinfo != null ? r.tinfo : '');
          if (typeof val === 'string' && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}[ T]/.test(val)) val = val.slice(0, 10);
          byTag[id].fields.push({ name: r.tname || '', abbr: r.tabbr || '', info: val });
        }
      });
      var remaining = Number(qtyNeeded) || 0;
      var allocations = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < order.length && remaining > 1e-9; i++) {
        var tag = byTag[order[i]];
        if (tag.avail <= 1e-9) continue;
        var take = Math.min(tag.avail, remaining);
        allocations.push({
          kind: 'lot',
          tagId: tag.tagId, tagNum: tag.tagNum,
          qty: take, fields: tag.fields,
        });
        remaining -= take;
      }
      return { allocations: allocations, covered: remaining <= 1e-6 };
    }

    // Serial-tracked scrap: pull per-tag lot fields + per-unit serial
    // values from tagtrackingview + tagserialview (mirrors the
    // Cycle_Count pattern). Then walk uncommitted serials FIFO by
    // tag date, take the first N, and group them by lot signature so
    // each group emits one parent row + optional header + serial rows.
    async function allocateScrapSerials(partId, locId, qtyNeeded) {
      var lotSql =
        "SELECT * FROM (" +
        "  SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.datecreated AS date_created, " +
        "         ttv.parttrackingid AS ptid, ttv.name AS tname, " +
        "         ttv.abbr AS tabbr, ttv.info AS tinfo, " +
        "         ttv.infoformatted AS tfmt, ttv.sortorder AS tsort " +
        "  FROM tag t " +
        "  LEFT JOIN tagtrackingview ttv ON ttv.tagid = t.id AND ttv.typeid <> 40 " +
        "  WHERE t.partid = " + parseInt(partId, 10) + " " +
        "    AND t.locationid = " + parseInt(locId, 10) + " " +
        "    AND t.typeid IN (30, 40) " +
        "    AND (t.qty - COALESCE(t.qtycommitted, 0)) > 0 " +
        "  ORDER BY t.datecreated, t.id, ttv.sortorder" +
        ") AS wrapped_lots";
      var serSql =
        "SELECT * FROM (" +
        "  SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.datecreated AS date_created, " +
        "         s.id AS sid, tsv.parttrackingid AS ptid, " +
        "         tsv.name AS sname, tsv.abbr AS sabbr, " +
        "         tsv.serialnum AS sn, tsv.sortorder AS ssort " +
        "  FROM tag t " +
        "  JOIN serial s ON s.tagid = t.id AND s.committedFlag = 0 " +
        "  JOIN tagserialview tsv ON tsv.serialid = s.id " +
        "  WHERE t.partid = " + parseInt(partId, 10) + " " +
        "    AND t.locationid = " + parseInt(locId, 10) + " " +
        "    AND t.typeid IN (30, 40) " +
        "  ORDER BY t.datecreated, t.id, s.id, tsv.sortorder" +
        ") AS wrapped_serials";
      var lotRows, serRows;
      try {
        lotRows = await qp(lotSql);
        serRows = await qp(serSql);
      } catch (e) {
        dbg('allocateScrapSerials failed: ' + (e && e.message || e), 'warn');
        return { allocations: [], covered: false };
      }
      // Group per tag: fields[] from lotRows.
      var tagLot = {};
      lotRows.forEach(function (r) {
        var id = parseInt(r.tag_id, 10);
        if (!id) return;
        if (!tagLot[id]) tagLot[id] = { tagId: id, fields: [] };
        if (r.ptid != null && r.tabbr != null) {
          var val = r.tfmt != null ? r.tfmt : (r.tinfo != null ? r.tinfo : '');
          if (typeof val === 'string' && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}[ T]/.test(val)) val = val.slice(0, 10);
          tagLot[id].fields.push({ name: r.tname || '', abbr: r.tabbr || '', info: val, ptid: parseInt(r.ptid, 10) });
        }
      });
      // Build unit list — one entry per uncommitted serial, keyed by
      // sid. Also derive the distinct serial-tracking field list
      // (parttrackingid + name + abbr) sorted by tsv.sortorder.
      var units = {};
      var unitOrder = [];
      var serialFieldMap = {};
      serRows.forEach(function (r) {
        var sid = parseInt(r.sid, 10);
        if (!sid) return;
        if (!units[sid]) {
          units[sid] = { sid: sid, tagId: parseInt(r.tag_id, 10) || 0, vals: {} };
          unitOrder.push(sid);
        }
        var ptid = parseInt(r.ptid, 10) || 0;
        if (ptid) {
          units[sid].vals[ptid] = r.sn == null ? '' : String(r.sn);
          if (!serialFieldMap[ptid]) {
            serialFieldMap[ptid] = { ptid: ptid, name: r.sname || '', abbr: r.sabbr || '', sort: r.ssort || 0 };
          }
        }
      });
      var serialFields = Object.keys(serialFieldMap)
        .map(function (k) { return serialFieldMap[k]; })
        .sort(function (a, b) { return (a.sort || 0) - (b.sort || 0); });
      // Take the first N units FIFO by tag date (unitOrder is already
      // ordered by the serSql's t.datecreated → t.id → s.id).
      var need = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(qtyNeeded) || 0));
      if (need === 0) return { allocations: [], covered: true };
      var taken = unitOrder.slice(0, need).map(function (sid) { return units[sid]; });
      if (taken.length < need) {
        return { allocations: [], covered: false };
      }
      // Group taken units by lot signature (unique combo of lot-field
      // values on their source tag). Same-lot units collapse into one
      // scrap item row.
      function lotSig(unit) {
        var lot = tagLot[unit.tagId];
        if (!lot) return '__none__';
        return lot.fields.map(function (f) { return f.ptid + '=' + (f.info || ''); }).join('|');
      }
      var groupsBySig = {};
      var sigOrder = [];
      taken.forEach(function (u) {
        var sig = lotSig(u);
        if (!groupsBySig[sig]) {
          var lot = tagLot[u.tagId];
          groupsBySig[sig] = {
            kind: 'serial-group',
            qty: 0,
            fields: (lot && lot.fields) ? lot.fields.slice() : [],
            serialFields: serialFields.slice(),
            serials: [],
          };
          sigOrder.push(sig);
        }
        groupsBySig[sig].serials.push({
          sid: u.sid,
          vals: serialFields.map(function (f) {
            return { ptid: f.ptid, name: f.name, abbr: f.abbr, value: u.vals[f.ptid] || '' };
          }),
        });
        groupsBySig[sig].qty++;
      });
      var allocations = sigOrder.map(function (s) { return groupsBySig[s]; });
      return { allocations: allocations, covered: true };
    }

    // Build the scrap plan from finishState + resolve every location.
    // Returns { rows, blockers } where rows is the list to import and
    // blockers is a human-readable list of parts that couldn't be
    // resolved. onFinishClick blocks Finish when blockers is non-empty.
    //
    // For non-serial tracked parts, one raw-material scrap gets
    // expanded into multiple CSV rows — one per source tag — so
    // Fishbowl can match the Tracking-* values on the source-side.
    //
    // For serial-tracked parts, the allocator returns one entry per
    // lot signature (group of same-lot units). Each entry emits an
    // item row + optional serial-header + one row per unit — see
    // postScrapImport for the CSV structure.
    async function buildScrapPlan(fs, wo) {
      var out = { rows: [], blockers: [] };
      if (!fs || !fs.lines) return out;
      var lgId = wo && wo.moLgId ? parseInt(wo.moLgId, 10) : 0;
      var note = wo && wo.num ? 'WO ' + wo.num : '';
      for (var i = 0; i < fs.lines.length; i++) {
        var line = fs.lines[i];
        if (line.isLabour) continue;
        var qty = parseFloat(line.scrappedInput) || 0;
        if (qty <= 0) continue;
        // Serial-tracked scrap only supports whole-unit quantities.
        // Fishbowl's serial model has no half-serials, and the CSV
        // format is one row per unit.
        if (line.isSerialTracked && Math.abs(qty - Math.floor(qty)) > 1e-9) {
          out.blockers.push(line.partNum + ': serial-tracked scrap qty must be a whole number (got ' + fmtQty(qty) + ')');
          continue;
        }
        // Manual selection path — if the operator opened the
        // openScrapTrackingModal and picked tags/serials, use their
        // choice verbatim. We still validate: totalQty must match
        // scrapped qty (otherwise the modal was closed on a stale
        // qty, since onFinishLineChange invalidates on qty change).
        var sel = line.scrapSelection;
        if (sel && sel.locId && Math.abs((sel.totalQty || 0) - qty) < 1e-6) {
          var locHdr = sel.lgName + '-' + sel.locName;
          if (sel.kind === 'lot' && Array.isArray(sel.tags)) {
            sel.tags.forEach(function (t) {
              out.rows.push({
                partNum: line.partNum,
                location: locHdr,
                qty: t.qty,
                note: note,
                kind: 'lot',
                fields: t.fields,
                serialFields: null,
                serials: null,
                tagId: t.tagId,
                tagNum: t.tagNum,
                _line: line,
                _locSource: 'manual',
              });
            });
            continue;
          }
          if (sel.kind === 'serial' && Array.isArray(sel.tagsBySig)) {
            sel.tagsBySig.forEach(function (g) {
              out.rows.push({
                partNum: line.partNum,
                location: locHdr,
                qty: g.qty,
                note: note,
                kind: 'serial-group',
                fields: g.fields,
                serialFields: g.serialFields,
                serials: g.serials,
                tagId: null,
                tagNum: '',
                _line: line,
                _locSource: 'manual',
              });
            });
            continue;
          }
        }
        // No usable manual selection — fall back to FIFO auto.
        var loc = await resolveScrapLocation(line, lgId, qty);
        if (!loc || !loc.lgName || !loc.locName) {
          out.blockers.push(line.partNum + ': no location in ' +
            (wo && wo.moLgName ? wo.moLgName : 'this LG') +
            ' has ' + fmtQty(qty) + ' available to scrap');
          continue;
        }
        var alloc = await allocateScrapTags(line.partId, loc.locId, qty, !!line.isSerialTracked);
        if (!alloc.allocations.length || !alloc.covered) {
          var got = alloc.allocations.reduce(function (s, a) { return s + (a.qty || 0); }, 0);
          out.blockers.push(line.partNum + ': stock moved during resolve — ' +
            (got > 0
              ? 'only ' + fmtQty(got) + ' still available at ' + loc.lgName + '-' + loc.locName
              : 'no stock remaining at ' + loc.lgName + '-' + loc.locName));
          continue;
        }
        alloc.allocations.forEach(function (a) {
          out.rows.push({
            partNum: line.partNum,
            location: loc.lgName + '-' + loc.locName,
            qty: a.qty,
            note: note,
            kind: a.kind,                   // 'lot' | 'serial-group'
            fields: a.fields,               // lot-tracking fields for Tracking-* cols
            serialFields: a.serialFields,   // serial-tracking defs (serial-group only)
            serials: a.serials,             // per-unit serial values (serial-group only)
