            tagId: a.tagId,                 // lot only — informational
            tagNum: a.tagNum,
            _line: line,
            _locSource: loc.source,
          });
        });
      }
      return out;
    }

    // POST an ImportRq with the scrap batch. Throws on !=1000 status
    // so the caller can surface the error in the finish banner and
    // leave the WO in a recoverable state (pick was already committed
    // and finished before this step; only the WO save is still to
    // come — see Finisher.prepareFinish for the interleave point).
    function postScrapImport(scrapRows) {
      if (!scrapRows || !scrapRows.length) return { ok: true, count: 0 };
      var imp = ensureScrapImportHeader();
      // Today in local YYYY-MM-DD — used to populate the Date column
      // if Fishbowl asks for one. Matches Bulk_Scrap_Helper's default
      // when the operator hasn't picked a date explicitly.
      var today = (function () {
        var d = new Date();
        var iso = d.getFullYear() + '-' +
          String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' +
          String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
        // Fishbowl's CSV importer parses dates against DateFormatShort
        // (dd/MM/yyyy on AU installs). Format via FBLib.Common so the
        // Date column matches whatever format the server expects.
        try { return C.formatDate(iso); } catch (_) { return iso; }
      })();
      var lines = [ imp.header.map(csvEsc).join(',') ];
      scrapRows.forEach(function (r) {
        // Item row — common to both 'lot' and 'serial-group' kinds.
        var item = imp.header.map(function () { return ''; });
        item[imp.partIdx] = r.partNum;
        item[imp.locIdx]  = r.location;
        item[imp.qtyIdx]  = r.qty;
        if (imp.noteIdx >= 0) item[imp.noteIdx] = r.note;
        if (imp.dateIdx >= 0) item[imp.dateIdx] = today;
        // Tracked parts: source lot-tracking values populate the
        // Tracking-* columns so Fishbowl can match the row to the
        // exact tag. Serial units carry the lot fields from their
        // source tag (all units in a serial-group share the same
        // lot signature by construction).
        if (r.fields && r.fields.length) fillScrapTrackingCols(item, imp, r.fields);
        lines.push(item.map(csvEsc).join(','));
        // Serial-tracked groups: follow the item row with an optional
        // header row (only when more than one serial-tracking type
        // exists — per Fishbowl's spec), then one row per unit with
        // serial values in the leading columns.
        if (r.kind === 'serial-group' && Array.isArray(r.serials) && r.serials.length) {
          var sF = Array.isArray(r.serialFields) ? r.serialFields : [];
          if (sF.length > 1) {
            var head = imp.header.map(function () { return ''; });
            sF.forEach(function (f, i) { head[i] = f.name || f.abbr || ''; });
            lines.push(head.map(csvEsc).join(','));
          }
          r.serials.forEach(function (u) {
            var srow = imp.header.map(function () { return ''; });
            // vals is [{ptid, name, abbr, value}] in serialField order —
            // slot into columns 0..len(sF)-1.
            (u.vals || []).forEach(function (v, i) { srow[i] = v.value == null ? '' : String(v.value); });
            lines.push(srow.map(csvEsc).join(','));
          });
        }
      });
      var payload = { ImportRq: { Type: 'ImportScrapData', Rows: { Row: lines } } };
      dbg('Scrap ImportRq (' + scrapRows.length + ' group(s), ' + (lines.length - 1) + ' data row(s)) → ' +
        scrapRows.map(function (r) {
          var trk = (r.fields || []).map(function (f) { return f.abbr + '=' + f.info; }).join(',');
          var sn = (r.kind === 'serial-group' && r.serials)
            ? ' serials=' + r.serials.length
            : '';
          return r.partNum + '@' + r.location + '×' + r.qty + (trk ? '[' + trk + ']' : '') + sn;
        }).join(' | '), 'info');
      // Surface the full CSV — one line per row — so the operator can
      // inspect exactly what Fishbowl will parse. Includes the header
      // as line 1 so column positions line up with the error messages
      // Fishbowl returns ("Line Number: 2" references lines[1] here).
      // Cache the CSV on window so it's inspectable via the debug
      // drawer OR the finish banner (which includes it in the blocker
      // list on failure) OR by typing `window._lastScrapCsv` into any
      // JS console — belt-and-braces so a broken debug drawer doesn't
      // hide it.
      window._lastScrapCsv = lines.slice();
      dbg('Scrap CSV (' + lines.length + ' line' + (lines.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + '):', 'info');
      lines.forEach(function (line, i) {
        dbg('  [' + i + '] ' + line, 'info');
      });
      var resp = runApiRequest('ImportRq', JSON.stringify(payload));
      var r = !resp ? null : (typeof resp === 'string' ? JSON.parse(resp) : resp);
      var code = r && r.ImportRs ? Number(r.ImportRs.statusCode) : NaN;
      if (code === 1000) return { ok: true, count: scrapRows.length };
      var msg = (r && r.ImportRs && r.ImportRs.statusMessage) ||
                (r && r.ErrorRs && r.ErrorRs.statusMessage) ||
                ('Scrap import failed (status ' + code + '): ' + JSON.stringify(r));
      // Append the CSV to the error message so it shows up in the
      // finish-banner blocker list. Numbered lines match Fishbowl's
      // "Line Number: N" references exactly.
      var csvDump = lines.map(function (l, i) { return '[' + i + '] ' + l; }).join('\n');
      throw new Error(msg + '\n\nCSV posted (' + lines.length + ' lines):\n' + csvDump);
    }

    // ── Query helper ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    function norm(r) {
      if (r == null) return [];
      if (typeof r === 'string') { try { var p = JSON.parse(r); return Array.isArray(p) ? p : []; } catch (_) { return []; } }
      return Array.isArray(r) ? r : [];
    }
    function qp(sql) {
      if (typeof runQueryAsync === 'function') {
        return runQueryAsync(sql).then(norm).catch(function (e) {
          dbg('qp fallback sync: ' + e.message, 'warn');
          return norm(runQuery(sql));
        });
      }
      return Promise.resolve(norm(runQuery(sql)));
    }

    // ── State ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    var state = {
      lgIds:    new Set((FBLib.Settings.resolve('lgIds')    || []).map(String)),
      catIds:   new Set((FBLib.Settings.resolve('catIds')   || []).map(String)),
      moStat:   new Set((FBLib.Settings.resolve('moStatuses') || [20, 50]).map(String)),
      woStat:   new Set((FBLib.Settings.resolve('woStatuses') || []).map(String)),
      search:   '',
      showFulfilled: !!FBLib.Settings.resolve('showFulfilled'),
      defaultExpanded: !!FBLib.Settings.resolve('expanded'),
      // Sort + date-range — restored from saved settings.
      sortKey:   FBLib.Settings.resolve('sortKey') || 'date',
      sortDir:   FBLib.Settings.resolve('sortDir') || 'desc',
      dateRange: FBLib.Settings.resolve('dateRange') || 'all',
      dateStart: FBLib.Settings.resolve('dateStart') || '',
      dateEnd:   FBLib.Settings.resolve('dateEnd')   || '',
      finishReadyOnly: !!FBLib.Settings.resolve('finishReadyOnly'),
      autoApplyFgDefaults: !!FBLib.Settings.resolve('autoApplyFgDefaults'),
      // Reference data
      locationGroups: [],
      calCategories:  [],
      moStatusList:   [],
      woStatusList:   [],
      pickStatusName: {},
      // Result data
      mos: [],          // [{id, num, ...}]
      wosByMo: {},      // moId -> [WOs]
      // Sub-detail cache keyed by woId
      subCache: {},
      // Finish-panel state keyed by woId. Initialised on demand when
      // an eligible WO row is expanded (see Finisher.initState).
      // Shape: { status, lines[], fg{}, allocations{}, blockers[],
      // steps[], lastError }. See Finisher block below.
      finishState: {},
      // KPI snapshot
      kpis: {},
    };

    // ============================================================
    // MULTI-SELECT (lightweight; mirrors WO_Parts_Availability)
    // ============================================================
    var MS = (function () {
      var open = null;
      var configs = {
        lg:     { state: 'lgIds',    listEl: 'lgList',    triggerEl: 'lgTrigger', dropdownEl: 'lgDropdown', placeholder: 'All', items: function(){return state.locationGroups.map(function(x){return {id:String(x.id),label:x.name};});} },
        cat:    { state: 'catIds',   listEl: 'catList',   triggerEl: 'catTrigger', dropdownEl: 'catDropdown', placeholder: 'All', items: function(){return state.calCategories.map(function(x){return {id:String(x.id),label:x.name};});} },
        mostat: { state: 'moStat',   listEl: 'mostatList',triggerEl: 'mostatTrigger', dropdownEl: 'mostatDropdown', placeholder: 'Issued + Partial', items: function(){return state.moStatusList.map(function(x){return {id:String(x.id),label:x.name};});} },
        wostat: { state: 'woStat',   listEl: 'wostatList',triggerEl: 'wostatTrigger', dropdownEl: 'wostatDropdown', placeholder: 'Entered + Started', items: function(){return state.woStatusList.map(function(x){return {id:String(x.id),label:x.name};});} },
      };

      function toggle(key, ev) {
        if (ev) ev.stopPropagation();
        if (open && open !== key) { closeAll(); }
        var dd = document.getElementById(configs[key].dropdownEl);
        if (!dd) return;
        if (dd.classList.contains('hidden')) {
          dd.classList.remove('hidden'); open = key; renderList(key, '');
        } else { dd.classList.add('hidden'); open = null; }
      }
      function closeAll() {
        Object.keys(configs).forEach(function (k) {
          var dd = document.getElementById(configs[k].dropdownEl);
          if (dd) dd.classList.add('hidden');
        });
        open = null;
      }
      document.addEventListener('click', function () { closeAll(); });

      function selSet(key) { return state[configs[key].state]; }
      function renderTrigger(key) {
        var trig = document.getElementById(configs[key].triggerEl);
        if (!trig) return;
        var sel = selSet(key); var items = configs[key].items();
        if (sel.size === 0) {
          trig.innerHTML = '<span class="ms-placeholder">' + esc(configs[key].placeholder) + '</span>';
          return;
        }
        var picked = items.filter(function (it) { return sel.has(it.id); });
        var tags = picked.slice(0, 3).map(function (it) {
          return '<span class="ms-tag">' + esc(it.label) + '<span class="ms-tag-x" onclick="event.stopPropagation();MS.remove(\'' + key + '\',\'' + it.id.replace(/'/g,"'") + '\')">×</span></span>';
        }).join('');
        if (picked.length > 3) tags += '<span class="ms-tag">+' + (picked.length - 3) + '</span>';
        trig.innerHTML = tags;
      }
      function renderList(key, search) {
        var listEl = document.getElementById(configs[key].listEl);
        if (!listEl) return;
        var items = configs[key].items();
        var s = (search || '').toLowerCase();
        if (s) items = items.filter(function (it) { return it.label.toLowerCase().indexOf(s) !== -1; });
        if (!items.length) { listEl.innerHTML = '<div class="ms-empty">No matches</div>'; return; }
        var sel = selSet(key);
        listEl.innerHTML = items.map(function (it) {
          var checked = sel.has(it.id) ? 'checked' : '';
          return '<label class="ms-item"><input type="checkbox" ' + checked + ' onchange="MS.toggleItem(\'' + key + '\',\'' + it.id.replace(/'/g,"'") + '\')">' + esc(it.label) + '</label>';
        }).join('');
      }
      function toggleItem(key, id) {
        var sel = selSet(key);
        if (sel.has(id)) sel.delete(id); else sel.add(id);
        renderTrigger(key); persist(); applyFiltersAndRefresh();
      }
      function remove(key, id) { selSet(key).delete(id); renderTrigger(key); persist(); applyFiltersAndRefresh(); }
      function selectAll(key) { var sel = selSet(key); configs[key].items().forEach(function (it) { sel.add(it.id); }); renderTrigger(key); renderList(key, ''); persist(); applyFiltersAndRefresh(); }
      function clear(key)     { selSet(key).clear(); renderTrigger(key); renderList(key, ''); persist(); applyFiltersAndRefresh(); }
      function search(key, v) { renderList(key, v); }

      function persist() {
        try {
          FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('lgIds',      Array.from(state.lgIds));
          FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('catIds',     Array.from(state.catIds));
          FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('moStatuses', Array.from(state.moStat).map(Number));
          FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('woStatuses', Array.from(state.woStat).map(Number));
          FBLib.Settings.saveUser();
        } catch (_) {}
      }

      function renderAll() { Object.keys(configs).forEach(renderTrigger); }

      return { toggle: toggle, closeAll: closeAll, toggleItem: toggleItem, remove: remove,
               selectAll: selectAll, clear: clear, search: search, renderAll: renderAll };
    })();
    window.MS = MS;

    // ============================================================
    // REFERENCE DATA
    // ============================================================
    function loadReferenceData() {
      return Promise.all([
        qp("SELECT id, name FROM locationgroup WHERE activeFlag = 1 ORDER BY name"),
        // calcategory.parentid = 30 → manufacturing-scoped categories
        // (the wo.calCategoryId filter we expose on the chip strip).
        // Excludes the three system-reserved rows ('Entered', 'Started',
        // 'Fulfilled') that mirror WO status — they sit under parentid 30
        // but aren't user-meaningful as a category filter (the WO status
        // chip already covers them).
        qp("SELECT id, name, color FROM calcategory " +
           "WHERE parentid = 30 AND name NOT IN ('Entered','Started','Fulfilled') " +
           "ORDER BY name"),
        qp("SELECT id, name FROM mostatus ORDER BY id"),
        qp("SELECT id, name FROM wostatus ORDER BY id"),
        qp("SELECT id, name FROM pickstatus ORDER BY id"),
      ]).then(function (results) {
        state.locationGroups = results[0];
        state.calCategories  = results[1];
        state.moStatusList   = results[2];
        state.woStatusList   = results[3];
        var psn = {}; results[4].forEach(function (r) { psn[r.id] = r.name; });
        state.pickStatusName = psn;
      });
    }

    // ============================================================
    // MAIN DATA LOAD
    // ============================================================
    function loadAll() {
      setStatus('Loading…');
      showSpinner(true, 'Loading work orders…');
      var moStatList = setToCsv(state.moStat, '20,50');
      // WO status: only filter when the user has picked something —
      // otherwise show every WO under the matching MOs. Caps was the
      // previous default of '10,30' which silently excluded WOs with
      // status 40 (Fulfilled) and any other state the install uses.
      var woWhere   = state.woStat.size ? ' AND wo.statusid IN (' + setToCsv(state.woStat, '') + ')' : '';
      var lgWhere   = state.lgIds.size  ? ' AND mo.locationGroupId IN (' + setToCsv(state.lgIds, '') + ')' : '';
      var catWhere  = state.catIds.size ? ' AND wo.calCategoryId IN (' + setToCsv(state.catIds, '') + ')' : '';

      // ── Date-range filter on mo.dateScheduled ───────────────────
      // resolveDateRange() returns ISO YYYY-MM-DD bounds (or nulls).
      // We push them into SQL so the database does the narrowing —
      // cheaper than fetching everything and filtering JS-side.
      var dateRange = resolveDateRange();
      var dateWhere = '';
      if (dateRange.start) dateWhere += " AND mo.datescheduled >= '" + dateRange.start + " 00:00:00'";
      if (dateRange.end)   dateWhere += " AND mo.datescheduled <= '" + dateRange.end   + " 23:59:59'";

      // ── ORDER BY driven by sort state. Sched is the natural
      // production-floor sort (earliest due first). MO# is the
      // record-keeping sort. WOs within an MO always order by id
      // so their visual position is stable on every refresh.
      var dir = state.sortDir === 'asc' ? 'ASC' : 'DESC';
      var orderBy;
      if (state.sortKey === 'num') {
        orderBy = ' ORDER BY mo.num ' + dir + ', mo.id ' + dir + ', wo.id';
      } else {
        // `(mo.datescheduled IS NULL) ASC` always sinks null-date rows to
        // the bottom regardless of overall direction (0 before 1).
        orderBy = ' ORDER BY (mo.datescheduled IS NULL) ASC, mo.datescheduled ' + dir +
                  ', mo.id ' + dir + ', wo.id';
      }

      // ── 1. MOs + WOs joined to moitem parent (NO finished-good join)
      // Fishbowl's MO data model is two-layer:
      //   • moitem typeid=50 is the build container ("parent" row). The
      //     WO record points its moItemId at this typeid=50 row, NOT
      //     directly at the finished good.
      //   • moitem typeid=10 is the output (finished good), hung under
      //     the typeid=50 parent via moitem.parentId. ONE WO can produce
      //     MULTIPLE typeid=10 children — joining them here would
      //     cross-product the WO row, so finished goods load in a
      //     separate query (#6 below) and the JS merges by woId.
      //   • moitem typeid=20 rows are raw-material consumption lines.
      // Cross-referenced with WO_Capacity_Planning_Gantt_v3 (lines
      // 2110-2167) and adaptiveair-production-scheduler — same shape.
      var moSql =
        "SELECT mo.id AS moid, mo.num AS monum, mo.statusid AS mostatusid, " +
        "       mo.locationgroupid AS molgid, lg.name AS molgname, " +
        "       mo.datescheduled AS modate, mo.note AS monote, " +
        "       wo.id AS woid, wo.num AS wonum, wo.statusid AS wostatusid, " +
        "       wo.qtyordered AS woqtyordered, wo.qtytarget AS woqtytarget, " +
        "       wo.datescheduled AS wodate, wo.datescheduledtostart AS wostartdate, " +
        "       wo.datestarted AS wostarted, wo.datefinished AS wofinished, " +
        "       wo.calcategoryid AS wocatid, cc.name AS wocatname, cc.color AS wocatcolor, " +
        "       moi.id AS moitemid, " +
        // Fallback finished-good link — the typeid=50 parent moitem
        // sometimes carries the output part directly (moi.partid), and
        // that linkage survives partial-completion / split workflows
        // even when the typeid=10 child moitem gets reparented or
        // removed. Loaded here so a WO whose direct output child was
        // moved during a split still shows its part.
        "       moi.partid AS moipartid, " +
        "       moipart.num AS moipartnum, moipart.description AS moipartdesc " +
        "FROM mo " +
        "JOIN moitem moi ON moi.moid = mo.id AND moi.typeid = 50 " +    // 50 = parent build header
        "JOIN wo ON wo.moitemid = moi.id " +
        "LEFT JOIN part moipart ON moipart.id = moi.partid " +
        "LEFT JOIN locationgroup lg ON lg.id = mo.locationgroupid " +
        "LEFT JOIN calcategory cc ON cc.id = wo.calcategoryid " +
        "WHERE mo.statusid IN (" + moStatList + ") " +
        woWhere + lgWhere + catWhere + dateWhere +
        orderBy;
      dbg('loadAll SQL: ' + moSql.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(), 'info');

      return qp(moSql).then(function (rows) {
        state.mos = [];
        state.wosByMo = {};
        var moById = {};
        // Map<moitemid, wo>  — used by the finished-good join below to
        // attach each child output to its owning WO without re-walking
        // mo.wos for every row.
        var woByMoItemId = {};
        rows.forEach(function (r) {
          var mo = moById[r.moid];
          if (!mo) {
            mo = {
              id: r.moid, num: r.monum, statusId: r.mostatusid,
              lgId: r.molgid, lgName: r.molgname || '',
              dateScheduled: r.modate, note: r.monote || '',
              wos: [],
              // Filled by the finished-good query — array of {partNum, partDesc}
              // for the top-level (stagelevel = 1) outputs.
              finishedGoods: [],
            };
            moById[r.moid] = mo;
            state.mos.push(mo);
            state.wosByMo[r.moid] = mo.wos;
          }
          var wo = {
            id: r.woid, num: r.wonum, statusId: r.wostatusid,
            moItemId: r.moitemid,
            qtyOrdered: parseFloat(r.woqtyordered) || 0,
            qtyTarget:  parseFloat(r.woqtytarget)  || 0,
            dateScheduled: r.wodate, dateStarted: r.wostarted, dateFinished: r.wofinished,
            calCategoryId: r.wocatid, calCategoryName: r.wocatname || '',
            calCategoryColor: r.wocatcolor || '',
            // Filled by the finished-good query — array of {partNum, partDesc}.
            // A WO with two output children gets two entries here; the renderer
            // newline-joins them so the WO stays on one row.
            outputs: [],
            // Fallback part carried on the typeid=50 parent moitem itself.
            // Used when the typeid=10 child output rows are missing (e.g.
            // partial-completion / split created a sibling WO and reparented
            // the original output child). Consumed by the post-load pass
            // below to seed outputs[] when the finished-good query returns
            // nothing for this WO.
            parentPartNum:  r.moipartnum  || '',
            parentPartDesc: r.moipartdesc || '',
            // Denormalised MO fields needed by the WO Finisher engine
            // (avoids re-walking mo.wos to find the LG when finishing a WO).
            // moLgId is used to resolve the FG's default location; moNum
            // feeds the batch-source rule "MO number".
            moLgId: r.molgid || null,
            moLgName: r.molgname || '',
            moNum: r.monum,
            // Filled below
            steps: { done: 0, total: 0 },
            pick:  { state: 'none', items: 0, full: 0, partial: 0, none: 0,
                     committed: 0, finished: 0, short: 0, pickCount: 0 },
            wipValue: 0,        // parts staged into WIP for this WO (current)
            openValue: 0,       // unpicked raw mat. still needed
            consumedValue: 0,   // raw mat. already consumed (woitem.qtyUsed × avgCost)
          };
          mo.wos.push(wo);
          woByMoItemId[r.moitemid] = wo;
        });

        if (state.mos.length === 0) {
          // Reset KPIs to zero (not the initial em-dash) so the bar
          // doesn't read as "still loading". Also run a small diagnostic
          // probe so the status line says WHY the table is empty — is
          // there no in-progress data at all, or are the filters
          // narrowing too much?
          computeKpis();
          render();
          showSpinner(false);
          qp("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM mo WHERE statusid IN (20, 50)").then(function (probe) {
            var n = (probe[0] && parseInt(probe[0].n, 10)) || 0;
            if (n === 0) setStatus('No MOs are currently Issued or Partial in this install.');
            else         setStatus('No MOs match the active filters (' + n + ' in-progress MOs exist — try clearing filters).');
          }).catch(function () { setStatus('No matching MOs / WOs.'); });
          return;
        }

        var woIds = [];
        state.mos.forEach(function (mo) { mo.wos.forEach(function (w) { woIds.push(w.id); }); });

        // ── 2. Step counts from woinstruction ──────────────────────
        // Total = every instruction row attached to the WO (one
        // woinstruction = one step on the build sheet). The earlier
        // pass gated total on qtyReady > 0, which silently dropped
        // instructions that hadn't been staged yet — that's why a WO
        // with 2 instructions was reading "1 / 1".
        //
        // Done = an instruction that has been completed: qtyFulfilled
        // has reached qtyReady AND something was actually fulfilled
        // (qtyFulfilled > 0). A 0/0 instruction is neither in-progress
        // nor done; it's just untouched.
        var stepsSql =
          "SELECT woid, " +
          "  SUM(CASE WHEN qtyfulfilled > 0 AND qtyfulfilled >= qtyready THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS donesteps, " +
          "  COUNT(*) AS totalsteps " +
          "FROM woinstruction WHERE woid IN (" + woIds.join(',') + ") GROUP BY woid";

        // ── 3. Pick summary per WO via pickitem.woItemId ─────────────
        // Pulls EVERY pickitem line attached to a WO so the renderer
        // can compute a traffic-light state from live availability:
        //   • status 5/6   = explicitly Short (no stock)
        //   • status 10/11/20 = pending — check live availability
        //   • status 30   = Committed (parts already pulled to a tag)
        //   • status 40   = Finished (terminal)
        // pickitem.statusid conventions match Items_To_Be_Picked.htm
        // (lines 770-810) and InventoryAvailability.htm (line 994-998).
        var picksSql =
          "SELECT woi.woid AS woid, " +
          "       p.id AS pickid, p.num AS picknum, p.statusid AS pickstatusid, " +
          "       p.locationgroupid AS picklgid, " +
          "       pi.id AS piid, pi.statusid AS pistatusid, " +
          "       pi.qty AS piqty, pi.partid AS pipartid " +
          "FROM pickitem pi " +
          "JOIN woitem woi ON woi.id = pi.woitemid " +
          "JOIN pick p ON p.id = pi.pickid " +
          "WHERE woi.woid IN (" + woIds.join(',') + ")";

        // ── 4. WIP value: tag.qty × partcost.avgCost ─────────────────
        // Tags whose woItemId points at a woitem belonging to one of
        // our in-progress WOs. partcost holds the live avg cost per
        // part — adequate for installs on average costing. Note: this
        // is in the help text for FIFO/LIFO installs.
        var wipSql =
          "SELECT woi.woid AS woid, SUM(t.qty * COALESCE(pc.avgcost, 0)) AS wipval " +
          "FROM tag t " +
          "JOIN woitem woi ON woi.id = t.woitemid " +
          "LEFT JOIN partcost pc ON pc.partid = t.partid " +
          "WHERE woi.woid IN (" + woIds.join(',') + ") " +
          "GROUP BY woi.woid";

        // ── 5. Open requirements + consumed cost on raw-material lines.
        // Two metrics from woitem typeId=20 in one query:
        //   • openVal     = (qtyTarget − qtyUsed) × avgCost  (still to pick)
        //   • consumedVal = qtyUsed × avgCost                (already burned in)
        // Combined with wipValue (parts staged but not yet consumed),
        // wipValue + consumedVal is the WO's running cost — equal to
        // the final actual cost once the WO is Fulfilled because by
        // then wipValue ≈ 0 (every tag has been consumed).
        var openSql =
          "SELECT woi.woid AS woid, " +
          "  SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(woi.qtytarget,0) - COALESCE(woi.qtyused,0), 0) * COALESCE(pc.avgcost, 0)) AS openval, " +
          "  SUM(COALESCE(woi.qtyused, 0) * COALESCE(pc.avgcost, 0)) AS consumedval " +
          "FROM woitem woi " +
          "LEFT JOIN partcost pc ON pc.partid = woi.partid " +
          "WHERE woi.woid IN (" + woIds.join(',') + ") AND woi.typeid = 20 " +
          "GROUP BY woi.woid";

        // ── 6a. WO output parts — direct from woitem typeid=10.
        // This is the WO's OWN configured output line, not the MO's
        // plan. More authoritative than walking moitem via parentid
        // (which breaks after partial-completion splits — the moitem
        // child gets reparented onto the new sibling WO). Zero rows
        // here → the WO has no output line at all; the fallback pass
        // then reads the parent-moitem's partid.
        var woFgSql =
          "SELECT woi.woid AS woid, p.num AS partnum, p.description AS partdesc, " +
          "       woi.qtytarget AS qtytarget, woi.qtyused AS qtyused " +
          "FROM woitem woi " +
          "LEFT JOIN part p ON p.id = woi.partid " +
          "WHERE woi.woid IN (" + woIds.join(',') + ") AND woi.typeid = 10 " +
          "ORDER BY woi.woid, woi.sortid";

        // ── 6b. MO-level finished good(s) — the top-of-the-BOM
        // typeid=10 rows only. Multi-stage MOs also have typeid=50
        // rows for sub-assemblies (each with its own typeid=10
        // children that are effectively raw materials in the MO's
        // top-level view). Filtering only on `typeid=10` OR on
        // `stagelevel=1` still pulls in those sub-stage outputs.
        // The correct filter is to hop through the ROOT typeid=50
        // (the one with `parentid IS NULL`) — same pattern as
        // WO_Capacity_Planning_Gantt_v4 (lines 2379–2387). That
        // guarantees we only surface the MO's actual finished good.
        var moIds = state.mos.map(function (m) { return m.id; });
        var fgSql =
          "SELECT root.moid AS moid, " +
          "       p.num AS partnum, p.description AS partdesc, " +
          "       fg.qtytofulfill AS qtytofulfill, fg.qtyfulfilled AS qtyfulfilled " +
          "FROM moitem root " +
          "JOIN moitem fg ON fg.parentid = root.id AND fg.typeid = 10 " +
          "LEFT JOIN part p ON p.id = fg.partid " +
          "WHERE root.moid IN (" + moIds.join(',') + ") " +
          "  AND root.typeid = 50 AND root.parentid IS NULL " +
          "ORDER BY root.moid, fg.sortidinstruct";

        return Promise.all([qp(stepsSql), qp(picksSql), qp(wipSql), qp(openSql), qp(fgSql), qp(woFgSql)]).then(function (res) {
          // Build index per WO
          var woIndex = {};
          state.mos.forEach(function (mo) { mo.wos.forEach(function (w) { woIndex[w.id] = w; }); });

          res[0].forEach(function (r) {
            var w = woIndex[r.woid]; if (!w) return;
            w.steps.done  = parseInt(r.donesteps,  10) || 0;
            w.steps.total = parseInt(r.totalsteps, 10) || 0;
          });

          res[2].forEach(function (r) {
            var w = woIndex[r.woid]; if (!w) return;
            w.wipValue = parseFloat(r.wipval) || 0;
          });
          res[3].forEach(function (r) {
            var w = woIndex[r.woid]; if (!w) return;
            w.openValue     = parseFloat(r.openval)     || 0;
            w.consumedValue = parseFloat(r.consumedval) || 0;
          });

          // WO output parts — direct from woitem typeid=10 keyed by
          // woid. Multiple rows OK when they're different parts; the
          // renderer stacks each on its own line. Same-part rows get
          // MERGED here (qtyTarget + qtyUsed summed) so a build with
          // two typeid=10 lines for the SAME part (multi-stage output,
          // split lines, etc.) shows one entry with the combined qty.
          res[5].forEach(function (r) {
            var partNum  = r.partnum  || '';
            var partDesc = r.partdesc || '';
            if (!partNum && !partDesc) return;
            var w = woIndex[r.woid];
            if (!w) return;
            var qtyTarget = parseFloat(r.qtytarget) || 0;
            var qtyUsed   = parseFloat(r.qtyused)   || 0;
            var key = partNum || partDesc;
            if (!w._outputByKey) w._outputByKey = {};
            if (w._outputByKey[key]) {
              w._outputByKey[key].qty       += qtyTarget;
              w._outputByKey[key].qtyUsed   += qtyUsed;
            } else {
              var item = { partNum: partNum, partDesc: partDesc, qty: qtyTarget, qtyUsed: qtyUsed };
              w._outputByKey[key] = item;
              w.outputs.push(item);
            }
          });

          // MO-level finished good(s) — moitem typeid=10 + stagelevel=1.
          // Same merge-by-partNum applies: an MO with the same finished
          // good repeated across several stagelevel=1 rows (Fishbowl
          // splits this way when the FG appears in more than one output
          // branch) shows one entry with the summed target/fulfilled.
          res[4].forEach(function (r) {
            var partNum  = r.partnum  || '';
            var partDesc = r.partdesc || '';
            if (!partNum && !partDesc) return;
            var mo = moById[r.moid];
            if (!mo) return;
            var qty      = parseFloat(r.qtytofulfill) || 0;
            var qtyDone  = parseFloat(r.qtyfulfilled) || 0;
            var key = partNum || partDesc;
            if (!mo._fgByKey) mo._fgByKey = {};
            if (mo._fgByKey[key]) {
              mo._fgByKey[key].qty      += qty;
              mo._fgByKey[key].qtyUsed  += qtyDone;
            } else {
              var item = { partNum: partNum, partDesc: partDesc, qty: qty, qtyUsed: qtyDone };
              mo._fgByKey[key] = item;
              mo.finishedGoods.push(item);
            }
          });

          // Fallback pass — for any WO whose woitem typeid=10 line is
          // missing (an unusual state, but possible on partial-completion
          // splits or interrupted MO edits), seed outputs[] from the
          // parent typeid=50 moitem's own partId. Loaded in the main
          // query via `moi.partid`. Leaves outputs[] empty if that link
          // is also null — the renderer shows the em-dash placeholder.
          state.mos.forEach(function (mo) {
            mo.wos.forEach(function (w) {
              if (w.outputs && w.outputs.length) return;
              if (w.parentPartNum || w.parentPartDesc) {
                // qty falls back to the WO's own qtyTarget / qtyOrdered
                // since we've got no per-line breakdown in this branch.
                w.outputs.push({
                  partNum:  w.parentPartNum,
                  partDesc: w.parentPartDesc,
                  qty:      w.qtyTarget  || 0,
                  qtyUsed:  w.qtyOrdered || 0,
                });
              }
            });
          });

          // ── Pick traffic-light: need availability per (partid, lgid)
          // for pickitems that are status 10/11/20 (pending). Tally a
          // distinct (partid, lgid) set from the pickitem rows, then
          // batch-query pickable on-hand minus committed in one shot.
          var pickitemRows = res[1] || [];
          var needAvail = new Map();  // key "partid|lgid" -> {partid, lgid}
          pickitemRows.forEach(function (r) {
            var s = parseInt(r.pistatusid, 10);
            if (s !== 10 && s !== 11 && s !== 20) return; // committed/short/finished don't need lookups
            var key = r.pipartid + '|' + r.picklgid;
            if (!needAvail.has(key)) needAvail.set(key, { partid: r.pipartid, lgid: r.picklgid });
          });

          var availPromise;
          if (needAvail.size === 0) {
            availPromise = Promise.resolve({});
          } else {
            // Reproduce the qty-on-hand calc inline so the TEMPTABLE
            // quantity views aren't pulled in (they'd materialise every
            // tag in the install before applying the WHERE). Stock that
            // can be picked: tag.qty net of committed, in a countable
            // AND pickable location.
            var partIds = [];
            var lgIds   = [];
            needAvail.forEach(function (v) { partIds.push(v.partid); lgIds.push(v.lgid); });
            var partList = Array.from(new Set(partIds)).join(',');
            var lgList   = Array.from(new Set(lgIds)).join(',');
            var availSql =
              "SELECT t.partid AS partid, l.locationgroupid AS lgid, " +
              "       SUM(GREATEST(t.qty - COALESCE(t.qtycommitted, 0), 0)) AS available " +
              "FROM tag t " +
              "JOIN location l ON l.id = t.locationid " +
              "WHERE t.partid IN (" + partList + ") " +
              "  AND l.locationgroupid IN (" + lgList + ") " +
              "  AND t.typeid IN (30, 40) " +
              "  AND l.countedasavailable = 1 " +
              "  AND l.pickable = 1 " +
              "GROUP BY t.partid, l.locationgroupid";
            availPromise = qp(availSql).then(function (rows) {
              var map = {};
              rows.forEach(function (r) { map[r.partid + '|' + r.lgid] = parseFloat(r.available) || 0; });
              return map;
            }).catch(function (err) {
              dbg('availability query failed: ' + err.message, 'warn');
              return {};
            });
          }

          return availPromise.then(function (availByKey) {
            // Aggregate pickitem-level into per-WO traffic-light state.
            // Also dedupe-by-pickid so each pick contributes one entry
            // to the picks[] list the renderer uses to draw pills.
            var woAgg = {};
            pickitemRows.forEach(function (r) {
              var a = woAgg[r.woid];
              if (!a) { a = { items: [], picks: new Map() }; woAgg[r.woid] = a; }
              if (!a.picks.has(r.pickid)) {
                a.picks.set(r.pickid, {
                  id:       r.pickid,
                  num:      r.picknum || '',
                  statusId: parseInt(r.pickstatusid, 10),
                });
              }
              a.items.push({
                statusId: parseInt(r.pistatusid, 10),
                qty:      parseFloat(r.piqty) || 0,
                partId:   r.pipartid,
                lgId:     r.picklgid,
                available: availByKey[r.pipartid + '|' + r.picklgid] || 0,
              });
            });
            Object.keys(woAgg).forEach(function (woid) {
              var w = woIndex[woid]; if (!w) return;
              var a = woAgg[woid];
              w.pick = computePickState(a.items);
              // Sort picks by num so the pill row is stable between
              // renders. Attach to the pick state for renderPickCell.
              var picksList = Array.from(a.picks.values()).sort(function (x, y) {
                return String(x.num).localeCompare(String(y.num), undefined, { numeric: true });
              });
              w.pick.picks = picksList;
              w.pick.pickCount = picksList.length;
            });

            computeKpis();
            render();
            setStatus(state.mos.length + ' MO' + (state.mos.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' loaded.');
            showSpinner(false);
          });
        });
      }).catch(function (err) {
        console.error(err);
        setStatus('Error: ' + (err.message || err));
        dbg('loadAll error: ' + err.message, 'error');
        showSpinner(false);
      });
    }

    // ============================================================
    // KPI COMPUTATION
    // ============================================================
    function woPct(w) {
      if (!w.steps.total) return 0;
      return Math.round(100 * w.steps.done / w.steps.total);
    }
    function moPct(mo) {
      // Qty-weighted average of each WO's step %.
      var num = 0, denom = 0;
      mo.wos.forEach(function (w) {
        var qty = Math.max(0, w.qtyTarget || 0);
        if (qty === 0) return;
        num   += woPct(w) * qty;
        denom += qty;
      });
      if (denom === 0) {
        // Fall back to unweighted average if no qtyTarget anywhere.
        var sum = 0, n = 0;
        mo.wos.forEach(function (w) { sum += woPct(w); n++; });
        return n ? Math.round(sum / n) : 0;
      }
      return Math.round(num / denom);
    }

    function computeKpis() {
      var totalMos = state.mos.length;
      var totalWos = 0, lateWos = 0, picksPending = 0;
      var wipVal = 0, openVal = 0;
      var pctNum = 0, pctDen = 0;
      var oldestStart = null;
      var now = Date.now();

      state.mos.forEach(function (mo) {
        var moQty = 0, moWeightedPct = 0;
        mo.wos.forEach(function (w) {
          totalWos++;
          wipVal  += w.wipValue;
          openVal += w.openValue;
          if (w.dateScheduled && new Date(w.dateScheduled).getTime() < now &&
              (w.statusId === 10 || w.statusId === 30)) lateWos++;
          // "Picks pending" = any WO whose pick state isn't finished or
          // committed — i.e. still needs attention on the floor.
          if (w.pick.items > 0 && w.pick.state !== 'done' && w.pick.state !== 'committed') picksPending++;
          if (w.dateStarted && (!oldestStart || new Date(w.dateStarted) < oldestStart)) {
            oldestStart = new Date(w.dateStarted);
          }
          var qty = Math.max(0, w.qtyTarget || 0);
          moQty += qty;
          moWeightedPct += woPct(w) * qty;
        });
        if (moQty > 0) { pctNum += moWeightedPct; pctDen += moQty; }
      });

      state.kpis = {
        totalMos: totalMos, totalWos: totalWos, lateWos: lateWos, picksPending: picksPending,
        wipVal: wipVal, openVal: openVal,
        avgPct: pctDen > 0 ? Math.round(pctNum / pctDen) : 0,
        oldestStart: oldestStart,
      };
      renderKpis();
    }

    function renderKpis() {
      var k = state.kpis;
      setKpi('kpiMOs',  k.totalMos);
      setKpi('kpiWOs',  k.totalWos);
      setKpi('kpiWipVal',  fmtMoney(k.wipVal));
      setKpi('kpiOpenVal', fmtMoney(k.openVal));
      setKpi('kpiAvgPct',  k.avgPct + '%');
      setKpi('kpiLate',    k.lateWos);
      setKpi('kpiPicksPending', k.picksPending);
      // Oldest started — main value is the days-since count; the
      // sub-line shows the actual date so the rep can see both at a
      // glance ("28d · since 2026-06-02").
      var sub = document.getElementById('kpiOldestSub');
      if (k.oldestStart) {
        var days = Math.floor((Date.now() - k.oldestStart.getTime()) / 86400000);
        setKpi('kpiOldest', days + 'd');
        if (sub) sub.textContent = 'Since ' + fmtDate(k.oldestStart);
      } else {
        setKpi('kpiOldest', '—');
        if (sub) sub.innerHTML = ' ';
      }
    }
    function setKpi(id, val) {
      var el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (!el) return;
      var v = el.querySelector('.kpi-value');
      if (v) v.textContent = (val == null ? '—' : val);
    }

    // ============================================================
    // RENDER MAIN TABLE
    // ============================================================
    function applyFiltersAndRefresh() { loadAll(); }

    function render() {
      var tbody = document.getElementById('wipBody');
      if (!state.mos.length) {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="10" class="empty">No work orders match the current filters.</td></tr>';
        return;
      }

      var search = (state.search || '').toLowerCase();
      var html = [];

      state.mos.forEach(function (mo) {
        // "Ready to finish" chip — hide any WO that either isn't a
        // finish-eligible status or whose pick isn't committed yet.
        // We compute the visible WO list first, then bail on the MO
        // entirely when no WOs survive so the MO header doesn't
        // dangle with no children.
        var visibleWos = state.finishReadyOnly
          ? mo.wos.filter(function (w) {
              return Finisher.isFinishableStatus(w) && Finisher.isPickReady(w);
            })
          : mo.wos;
        if (state.finishReadyOnly && !visibleWos.length) return;

        // Filter MOs by search — match against MO#, MO finished-good
        // part(s), and any contained WO# + WO output part(s). Search
        // scans across the visible WOs only so a search + finish-ready
        // combo doesn't surface MOs whose match lives on a hidden WO.
        if (search) {
          var moFgText = (mo.finishedGoods || []).map(function (o) {
            return (o.partNum || '') + ' ' + (o.partDesc || '');
          }).join(' ');
          var woText = visibleWos.map(function (w) {
            var outs = (w.outputs || []).map(function (o) {
              return (o.partNum || '') + ' ' + (o.partDesc || '');
            }).join(' ');
            return w.num + ' ' + outs;
          }).join(' ');
          var hay = (mo.num + ' ' + (mo.note || '') + ' ' + moFgText + ' ' + woText).toLowerCase();
          if (hay.indexOf(search) === -1) return;
        }

        var pct = moPct(mo);
        var moStatusName = (state.moStatusList.find(function (s) { return s.id === mo.statusId; }) || {}).name || ('Status ' + mo.statusId);
        var moRowId = 'mo-' + mo.id;
        var expanded = state.defaultExpanded ? 'expanded' : '';
        // MO-level cost = sum of its WO costs. Each WO's current cost
        // is wipValue + consumedValue. Once the WO is fulfilled the
        // wipValue settles to 0 and the figure becomes the actual cost.
        var moCost = mo.wos.reduce(function (s, w) {
          return s + (w.wipValue || 0) + (w.consumedValue || 0);
        }, 0);

        // MO header row. 10 cells line up exactly with the WO rows:
        //   1 Sched date    2 MO# + LG    3 Output part(s)    4 Status pill
        //   5 (cal cat — blank on MO)     6 (pick — blank on MO)
        //   7 Cost           8 # WOs      9 (steps — blank on MO)
        //  10 Progress bar
        // Sched date is column 1 so the rep can scan top-to-bottom by
        // earliest-due. Status badge stays in col 4 to colour-align
        // with the WO status pill below it.
        html.push(
          '<tr class="mo-row ' + expanded + '" id="' + moRowId + '" data-moid="' + mo.id + '">' +
            '<td class="muted">' + (mo.dateScheduled ? esc(fmtDate(mo.dateScheduled)) : '') + '</td>' +
            '<td>' +
              '<span class="twisty" onclick="toggleMO(' + mo.id + ')">▶</span>' +
              '<a class="row-link" href="#" onclick="event.preventDefault();openMO(\'' + esc(mo.num) + '\')">' + esc(mo.num) + '</a>' +
              (mo.lgName ? ' <span class="muted">· ' + esc(mo.lgName) + '</span>' : '') +
            '</td>' +
            '<td>' + renderOutputs(mo.finishedGoods) + '</td>' +
            '<td><span class="badge b-mo-' + mo.statusId + '">' + esc(moStatusName) + '</span></td>' +
            '<td></td>' +
            '<td></td>' +
            '<td class="nr" title="' + esc(costTooltip(mo)) + '">' +
              (moCost > 0 ? fmtMoney(moCost) : '<span class="muted">—</span>') +
            '</td>' +
            '<td class="nr muted">' + visibleWos.length + ' WO' + (visibleWos.length === 1 ? '' : 's') +
              (state.finishReadyOnly && visibleWos.length !== mo.wos.length
                ? ' <span class="muted" title="Filtered by Ready to finish">(of ' + mo.wos.length + ')</span>'
                : '') +
            '</td>' +
            '<td></td>' +
            '<td>' + progressBar(pct, 'mo') + '</td>' +
          '</tr>'
        );

        // WO rows
        visibleWos.forEach(function (w) {
          var woStatusName = (state.woStatusList.find(function (s) { return s.id === w.statusId; }) || {}).name || ('Status ' + w.statusId);
          var wopct = woPct(w);
          var stepsText = w.steps.total > 0 ? (w.steps.done + ' / ' + w.steps.total) : '<span class="muted">no steps</span>';
          var pickCell = renderPickCell(w);
          var late = w.dateScheduled && new Date(w.dateScheduled).getTime() < Date.now() && (w.statusId === 10 || w.statusId === 30);
          var visible = state.defaultExpanded ? '' : 'collapsed';

          html.push(
            '<tr class="wo-row ' + visible + '" data-moid="' + mo.id + '" data-woid="' + w.id + '">' +
              '<td class="muted">' + (w.dateScheduled ? esc(fmtDate(w.dateScheduled)) : '') + '</td>' +
              '<td class="indent">' +
                '<span class="twisty" onclick="toggleWO(' + w.id + ')">▶</span>' +
                '<a class="row-link" href="#" onclick="event.preventDefault();openWO(\'' + esc(w.num) + '\')">' + esc(w.num) + '</a>' +
                (late ? ' <span class="badge b-late">Late</span>' : '') +
              '</td>' +
              '<td>' + renderOutputs(w.outputs) + '</td>' +
              '<td><span class="badge b-wo-' + w.statusId + '">' + esc(woStatusName) + '</span></td>' +
              '<td>' + renderCalCat(w) + '</td>' +
              '<td>' + pickCell + '</td>' +
              '<td class="nr" title="' + esc(costTooltip(w)) + '">' + renderCostCell(w) + '</td>' +
              '<td class="nr">' + fmtQty(w.qtyOrdered) + ' / ' + fmtQty(w.qtyTarget) + '</td>' +
              '<td>' + stepsText + '</td>' +
              '<td>' + progressBar(wopct, 'wo') + '</td>' +
            '</tr>' +
            // Sub-detail placeholder row (raw materials, loaded lazily)
            '<tr class="sub-row collapsed" data-sub-for="' + w.id + '">' +
              '<td colspan="10"><div class="sub-detail" id="subDetail-' + w.id + '">' +
                '<div class="sub-loading">Loading raw-material lines…</div>' +
              '</div></td>' +
            '</tr>'
          );
        });
      });

      tbody.innerHTML = html.join('') || '<tr><td colspan="10" class="empty">No work orders match.</td></tr>';
    }

    function progressBar(pct, kind) {
      pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pct || 0));
      var cls = pct === 0 ? 'empty' : (pct >= 100 ? 'ok' : (pct >= 50 ? '' : 'warn'));
      return '<div class="pbar">' +
        '<div class="pbar-track"><div class="pbar-fill ' + cls + '" style="width:' + pct + '%;"></div></div>' +
        '<div class="pbar-text">' + pct + '%</div>' +
      '</div>';
    }

    // Cost cell — running cost of the WO = parts staged in WIP +
    // parts already consumed. For a Fulfilled WO (statusId=40) the
    // wipValue settles to ~0 and the figure equals the actual cost.
    // For in-progress WOs this is the live invested value so far.
    // Tooltip breaks the figure down so the rep can see staged vs.
    // consumed at a glance.
    function renderCostCell(w) {
      var c = (w.wipValue || 0) + (w.consumedValue || 0);
      if (c <= 0) return '<span class="muted">—</span>';
      // Subtle visual distinction between "actual" (fulfilled) and
      // "current" (in-progress) — uses the WO status as the cue.
      var actual = w.statusId === 40;
      return '<span style="font-weight:600;' + (actual ? '' : 'color:#1d4ed8;') + '">'
        + fmtMoney(c) + '</span>';
    }

    // Tooltip used by both WO cells and the MO summary cell. Accepts a
    // WO row OR an MO row — for an MO the totals come from summing
    // each contained WO.
    function costTooltip(node) {
      var wip = 0, used = 0;
      if (node.wos) {
        node.wos.forEach(function (w) { wip += w.wipValue || 0; used += w.consumedValue || 0; });
      } else {
        wip  = node.wipValue || 0;
        used = node.consumedValue || 0;
      }
      var total = wip + used;
      if (total <= 0) return 'No cost recorded yet';
      var lines = [];
      lines.push('Total: ' + fmtMoney(total));
      lines.push('Staged in WIP: ' + fmtMoney(wip));
      lines.push('Consumed: ' + fmtMoney(used));
      if (!node.wos && node.statusId === 40) lines.push('(actual cost — WO fulfilled)');
      return lines.join('\n');
    }

    // Render a list of finished-good outputs as one line per part
    // inside a single table cell. Used for both the MO row (top-level
    // stagelevel=1 outputs) and the WO row (woitem typeid=10 lines).
    // A row with two different outputs renders as two stacked lines.
    // Each line: `PART · description · qtyDone/qtyTarget` where the
    // qty pill on the right shows fulfilment against target. When
    // qty is 0/missing we suppress the pill so short-lived entries
    // (e.g. inactive lines) don't render an ugly empty pill.
    function renderOutputs(list) {
      if (!list || !list.length) return '<span class="muted">—</span>';
      // Two-column grid: left col holds each output's part# + desc,
      // right col holds each output's qty pill. Emitting an empty
      // right-col span for zero-qty rows keeps the grid columns
      // consistent across every line in the cell.
      var cells = list.map(function (o) {
        var target = parseFloat(o.qty)     || 0;
        var used   = parseFloat(o.qtyUsed) || 0;
        var partHtml = '<span class="out-part">' +
          (o.partNum  ? '<strong>' + esc(o.partNum) + '</strong>' : '') +
          (o.partDesc ? ' <span class="muted">· ' + esc(o.partDesc) + '</span>' : '') +
        '</span>';
        var qtyHtml = target > 0
          ? '<span class="out-qty" title="Fulfilled / Target">' +
              fmtQty(used) + ' / ' + fmtQty(target) +
            '</span>'
          : '<span></span>';
        return partHtml + qtyHtml;
      }).join('');
      return '<div class="out-lines">' + cells + '</div>';
    }

    // Renders the category as a pill using calcategory.color as the
    // background. The text colour is picked dynamically — light text
    // on dark backgrounds, dark text on light backgrounds — so labels
    // stay legible regardless of which colour the admin configured.
    //
    // Fishbowl stores calcategory.color as a bare 6-char hex (e.g.
    // 'CCCCCC'), NOT a CSS-prefixed '#CCCCCC'. v3/v4 capacity-planner
    // reports do `'#' + color`. normalizeColor() handles both bare and
    // prefixed values so we don't render a transparent / fallback pill.
    function normalizeColor(raw) {
      var s = String(raw || '').trim();
      if (!s) return '';
      if (s.charAt(0) === '#') return s;
      // Bare 3- or 6-char hex → prepend #
      if (/^[0-9a-f]{3}$/i.test(s) || /^[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(s)) return '#' + s;
      // rgb()/rgba() or named colour — pass through as-is
      return s;
    }

    function renderCalCat(w) {
      if (!w.calCategoryName) return '<span class="muted">—</span>';
      var color = normalizeColor(w.calCategoryColor);
      if (!color) return '<span class="cal-cat">' + esc(w.calCategoryName) + '</span>';
      var fg = pickContrast(color);
      var bg = esc(color);
      return '<span class="cal-cat" style="background:' + bg + ';color:' + fg + ';border-color:' + bg + ';">' + esc(w.calCategoryName) + '</span>';
    }

    // Pick a readable foreground (black or white) for a given CSS
    // colour string. Handles #rgb / #rrggbb / rgb()/rgba() — anything
    // else falls back to dark text. Uses the perceived-luminance rule
    // (Y from sRGB) with the standard 0.5 cutoff.
    function pickContrast(color) {
      var r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, ok = false;
      var m = String(color).match(/^#([0-9a-f]{3}|[0-9a-f]{6})$/i);
      if (m) {
        var hex = m[1];
        if (hex.length === 3) hex = hex.split('').map(function (c) { return c + c; }).join('');
        r = parseInt(hex.slice(0, 2), 16);
        g = parseInt(hex.slice(2, 4), 16);
        b = parseInt(hex.slice(4, 6), 16);
        ok = true;
      } else {
        var rgb = String(color).match(/^rgba?\(\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)/i);
        if (rgb) { r = +rgb[1]; g = +rgb[2]; b = +rgb[3]; ok = true; }
      }
      if (!ok) return '#1e293b';
      // Perceived luminance (Rec. 709). Threshold tuned for Fishbowl
      // calcategory colours, which lean saturated rather than pastel.
      var y = (0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b) / 255;
      return y > 0.6 ? '#1e293b' : '#ffffff';
    }

    // ============================================================
    // PICK TRAFFIC-LIGHT
    // ----
    // Per the user spec — read pickitem.statusid + live availability,
    // then bucket each pending line:
    //
    //   • status 5/6                  → short        (no stock)
    //   • status 10/11/20 + avail≥qty → full         (can be picked)
    //   • status 10/11/20 + 0<avail<qty → partial    (some stock)
    //   • status 10/11/20 + avail≤0   → none         (out)
    //   • status 30                   → committed    (already on a tag)
    //   • status 40                   → finished     (done, ignored)
    //
    // WO badge state derived from those buckets:
    //
    //   all open lines committed  → 🟠 padlock
    //   all open lines fulfillable → 🟢 green
    //   any open line has stock   → 🟡 yellow
    //   no open line has stock    → 🔴 red
    //   nothing open (all done)   → 🟢 done
    // ============================================================
    function computePickState(items) {
      var full = 0, partial = 0, none = 0, committed = 0, finished = 0, short_ = 0;
      items.forEach(function (it) {
        if (it.statusId === 40)               { finished++;  return; }
        if (it.statusId === 30)               { committed++; return; }
        if (it.statusId === 5 || it.statusId === 6) { short_++; none++; return; }
        // 10 / 11 / 20 — pending, judge by availability
        if (it.available >= it.qty)            full++;
        else if (it.available > 0)             partial++;
        else                                   none++;
      });
      var openLines = items.length - finished;
      var state = 'none';
      if (items.length === 0) {
        state = 'none';
      } else if (openLines === 0) {
        state = 'done';          // all pickitems are finished
      } else if (committed === openLines) {
        state = 'committed';     // locked in — orange padlock
      } else if (full + committed === openLines) {
        state = 'green';
      } else if (full + partial + committed > 0) {
        state = 'yellow';
      } else {
        state = 'red';
      }
      return {
        state: state, items: items.length,
        full: full, partial: partial, none: none,
        committed: committed, finished: finished, short: short_,
        pickCount: 0   // overwritten by caller
      };
    }

    // SVG glyphs — sized for the table row. The padlock is filled
    // orange; the dot is a solid disc; the check is just a tick.
    var PICK_GLYPHS = {
      green:     '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="14" height="14" fill="#16a34a" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6"/></svg>',
      yellow:    '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="14" height="14" fill="#eab308" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6"/></svg>',
      red:       '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="14" height="14" fill="#dc2626" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6"/></svg>',
      done:      '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><polyline points="3,9 7,13 13,4"/></svg>',
      committed: '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="14" height="14" fill="#f97316" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4.5 7V5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 7 0v2H12a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v5a1 1 0 0 1-1 1H4a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V8a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h.5zm1.5 0h4V5a2 2 0 0 0-4 0v2z"/></svg>',
    };
    var PICK_LABELS = {
      green:     'All available',
      yellow:    'Some stock',
      red:       'No stock',
      done:      'All picked',
      committed: 'Committed',
      none:      'No picks',
    };

    function renderPickCell(w) {
      var p = w.pick || { state: 'none', items: 0, picks: [] };
      if (!p.items) return '<span class="muted" title="No picks generated for this WO yet">No picks</span>';
      var glyph = PICK_GLYPHS[p.state] || '';
      var stateLabel = PICK_LABELS[p.state] || p.state;
      // Tooltip on the dot summarises the availability state + per-
      // bucket pickitem counts. The pills carry their own per-pick
      // tooltips (status + click hint), so this stays terse.
      var dotTip = stateLabel + ' · '
        + p.items + ' line' + (p.items === 1 ? '' : 's')
        + (p.full      ? ' · ' + p.full + ' full'         : '')
        + (p.partial   ? ' · ' + p.partial + ' partial'   : '')
        + (p.none      ? ' · ' + p.none + ' none'         : '')
        + (p.committed ? ' · ' + p.committed + ' committed' : '')
        + (p.finished  ? ' · ' + p.finished + ' finished' : '');
      // One clickable badge per pick. Label = pick number; colour
      // class matches the pick.statusid (b-pick-10/20/30/40), giving
      // the same visual cue as the original implementation. Click
      // hops into the Picking module for that specific pick.
      var pills = (p.picks || []).map(function (pk) {
        var name = state.pickStatusName[pk.statusId] || ('Status ' + pk.statusId);
        return '<a class="pick-pill badge b-pick-' + pk.statusId + '" href="#" ' +
          'title="' + esc(name + ' — open pick ' + pk.num) + '" ' +
          'onclick="event.preventDefault();openPick(\'' + esc(pk.num).replace(/'/g, "\\'") + '\')">' +
          esc(pk.num || ('#' + pk.id)) + '</a>';
      }).join(' ');
      return '<span class="pick-summary">' +
        '<span class="pick-dot" title="' + esc(dotTip) + '">' + glyph + '</span>' +
        (pills ? ' ' + pills : '') +
        '</span>';
    }

    // ============================================================
    // FINISHER ENGINE — ported from Manufacturing/WO Finisher/WO Finisher.html
    // ----
    // Handles the two-step commit sequence that transitions an open WO
    // to Fulfilled (statusId = 40):
    //
    //   1. GetPickRq  → allocate stock (FIFO/LIFO by tag date) →
    //      SavePickRq (commit pick items to statusId = 40, with
    //      tracking blocks derived from source tag serials/lots).
    //   2. GetWorkOrderRq → SaveWorkOrderRq (WO.StatusID = 40; on the
    //      typeid=10 finished-good WOItem set QtyUsed and the FG
    //      tracking block: batch # / use-by / serials).
    //
    // The engine is a self-contained namespace so nothing here leaks
    // into the enclosing IIFE. Reuses `C` (FBLib.Common) for escSQL
    // and `qp` (this file's async query helper). Per-WO editable state
    // lives on `state.finishState[woId]` (rebuilt when the row is
    // expanded — see renderSubDetail below).
    //
    // Full flow + wizard step order documented in the source report:
    // Manufacturing/WO Finisher/WO Finisher.html (~700 lines of the
    // helpers below are lifted from that file with minimal changes).
    // Kept in-file per the approved plan; if a second report needs
    // this, promote to fb-lib.
    // ============================================================
    var Finisher = (function () {

      // ── Constants (mirror WO Finisher.html lines 582-593) ────────
      var ACTIONABLE_STATUSES  = new Set([5, 6, 10, 11, 20]);
      var COMMITTED_STATUSES   = new Set([30, 40]);
      var STOCK_DECIMALS       = 6;
      var EPSILON              = 1e-9;
      var FRACTION_SCALE       = 1000000;
      var INVENTORY_PART_TYPE  = 10;
      var TRACKING_TYPE_DATE   = new Set([20, 30]);
      var TRACKING_TYPE_SERIAL = 40;

      // ── Config — matches the standalone finisher's defaults;
      // hardcoded in v1 (see plan; user-editable in a later phase). ─
      var CFG = {
        mode: 'fifo',         // 'fifo' | 'lifo' — allocation order for source tags
        autoTracking: true,   // Carry batch/date forward from FIFO source
        batchRule: 'wo',      // 'wo' | 'mo' | 'date' | 'prefixwo' | 'blank'
        batchPrefix: '',
        useByRule: 'blank',   // 'blank' | 'days' (+CFG.shelfDays)
        shelfDays: 0,
        noGroupTracked: false // If true, ANY tracked WO must go to
                              // wizard mode (not v1's auto path).
      };

      // ── Utility ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
      function ensureArray(v) { return Array.isArray(v) ? v : (v == null ? [] : [v]); }
      function deepClone(v) {
        return (typeof structuredClone === 'function') ? structuredClone(v) : JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v));
      }
      function toNumber(v, f) { var n = Number(v); return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : f; }
      function roundStock(v) { return Number(Math.max(0, toNumber(v, 0)).toFixed(STOCK_DECIMALS)); }
      function sqlString(v) {
        try { return "'" + C.escSQL(v) + "'"; }
        catch (_) { return "'" + String(v == null ? '' : v).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'"; }
      }
      function toQuantityString(v) {
        var n = Number(v);
        if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return '0';
        if (Number.isInteger(n)) return String(n);
        return String(Number(n.toFixed(6)));
      }
      function pad2(n) { return String(n).padStart(2, '0'); }
      function nowFishbowl() {
        var d = new Date();
        return d.getFullYear() + '-' + pad2(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad2(d.getDate()) + 'T' +
               pad2(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad2(d.getMinutes()) + ':' + pad2(d.getSeconds());
      }
      function todayCompact() {
        var d = new Date();
        return '' + d.getFullYear() + pad2(d.getMonth() + 1) + pad2(d.getDate());
      }
      function isoDatePlusDays(days) {
        var d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() + toNumber(days, 0));
        return d.getFullYear() + '-' + pad2(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad2(d.getDate());
      }
      function errorMessage(e) {
        if (e == null) return 'Unknown error';
        if (typeof e === 'string') return e;
        if (e.message) return String(e.message);
        try { return JSON.stringify(e); } catch (x) { return String(e); }
      }
      function lc(row) {
        var out = {}; Object.keys(row || {}).forEach(function (k) { out[k.toLowerCase()] = row[k]; });
        return out;
      }
      function tryParseJsonArray(v) {
        if (Array.isArray(v)) return v;
        if (v == null) return [];
        if (typeof v === 'object') return [v];
        var t = String(v).trim();
        if (!t || t.toLowerCase() === 'null') return [];
        try { var p = JSON.parse(t); return Array.isArray(p) ? p : []; } catch (e) { return []; }
      }

      // ── Legacy REST wrapper ────────────────────────────────────
      // Fishbowl exposes the classic FbiJson request family at
      // /api/legacy/external/<Name>. We POST {<Name>: payload} and
      // pull the <Name>Rs node out of the FbiMsgsRs envelope; any
      // non-1000 statusCode throws so the caller can react (retries,
      // banner errors, etc.). Same shape used by WO Finisher.
      function responseNodeName(name) { return String(name).replace(/Rq$/, 'Rs'); }

                  serialId: toNumber(s.SerialID, 0),
                  partTrackingId: toNumber(s.PartTrackingID, 0),
                  trackingName: (s.TrackingName) || '',
                  trackingTypeId: toNumber(s.TrackingTypeID, TRACKING_TYPE_SERIAL),
                  tagDateCreated: row.tag_datecreated || null,
                });
              });
            });
          }
          out.push({
            pickitemId: pickitemId, partNum: partNum, partDesc: partDesc,
            required: required, committed: committed, readOnly: committed,
            status: status, candidates: candidates,
          });
        });
        return out;
      }

      // ── Classifiers used by renderSubDetail to decide the panel ─
      function isFinishableStatus(wo) { return wo && (wo.statusId === 10 || wo.statusId === 30); }
      // "Ready to finish" — includes 'green' (all items available but
      // not yet committed). Fishbowl's SavePickRq with StatusID=40
      // auto-commits + finishes atomically, so we don't need the pick
      // to already be at status 30. Prior behaviour required 'committed'
      // or 'done' only, which hid the Finish button from operators
      // whose picks were green-ready but not yet manually committed.
      function isPickReady(wo) {
        if (!wo || !wo.pick) return false;
        var s = wo.pick.state;
        return s === 'committed' || s === 'done' || s === 'green';
      }
      // Build the woRow shape prepareFinish expects, from the WIP
      // report's in-memory WO object. `pick_num` comes from the first
      // pick attached to the WO (Fishbowl only allows one pick per WO).
      function woRowFrom(wo) {
        var fgPart = (wo.outputs && wo.outputs[0] && wo.outputs[0].partNum) || wo.parentPartNum || '';
        var pickNum = (wo.pick && wo.pick.picks && wo.pick.picks[0]) ? wo.pick.picks[0].num : null;
        return {
          wo_num: wo.num,
          mo_num: wo.moNum,
          pick_num: pickNum,
          locationgroupid: wo.moLgId,
          location_group: wo.moLgName,
          fg_part: fgPart,
          qty_target: wo.qtyTarget,

      return {
        CFG: CFG,
        prepareFinish: prepareFinish,
        woRowFrom: woRowFrom,
        isFinishableStatus: isFinishableStatus,
        isPickReady: isPickReady,
        // Preview helper used by renderSubDetail to render allocations
        // + blockers before the user clicks Finish. Kept here so all

        previewFinish: function (woRow, opts) {

        // used by the serial-selection modal.
        serialLinesFrom: serialLinesFrom,

    })();

    // ============================================================
    // EXPAND / COLLAPSE
    // ============================================================
    window.toggleMO = function (moId) {
      var row = document.getElementById('mo-' + moId);
      if (!row) return;
      var expanded = row.classList.toggle('expanded');
      document.querySelectorAll('tr.wo-row[data-moid="' + moId + '"]').forEach(function (r) {
        r.classList.toggle('collapsed', !expanded);
        if (!expanded) {
          // collapsing the MO also collapses any open sub-detail rows
          var woId = r.dataset.woid;
          var sub = document.querySelector('tr.sub-row[data-sub-for="' + woId + '"]');
          if (sub) sub.classList.add('collapsed');
          r.classList.remove('expanded');
        }
      });
    };

    window.toggleWO = function (woId) {
      var row = document.querySelector('tr.wo-row[data-woid="' + woId + '"]');
      var sub = document.querySelector('tr.sub-row[data-sub-for="' + woId + '"]');
      if (!row || !sub) return;
      var expanded = row.classList.toggle('expanded');
      sub.classList.toggle('collapsed', !expanded);
      if (expanded) loadSubDetail(woId);
    };

    // Look up the WO object in the in-memory state so renderSubDetail
    // can gate the finish panel on wo.statusId / wo.pick.state without
    // re-walking the DOM.
    function findWoById(woId) {
      var id = String(woId);
      for (var i = 0; i < state.mos.length; i++) {
        var mo = state.mos[i];
        for (var j = 0; j < mo.wos.length; j++) {
          if (String(mo.wos[j].id) === id) return mo.wos[j];
        }
      }
      return null;
    }

    // Build (or refresh) the per-WO finishState. Called when the row
    // is expanded. Preserves prior dirty edits and FG tracking values
    // across collapse/expand within the same session — the panel
    // shouldn't wipe an operator's typed qtys just because they
    // accidentally collapsed the row. Prior state is only discarded
    // when refreshWoRow() explicitly clears state.finishState[woId]
    // after a successful finish.
    function initFinishState(woId, rows, fgTracking) {
      var wo = findWoById(woId);
      var prior = state.finishState[woId] || null;
      var priorLines = prior && prior.lines ? prior.lines : [];
      var priorFg = prior && prior.fg ? prior.fg : null;
      var lines = (rows || []).map(function (r, i) {
        var target = parseFloat(r.qtytarget) || 0;
        var used   = parseFloat(r.qtyused)   || 0;
        var scrap  = parseFloat(r.qtyscrapped) || 0;
        var partTypeId = parseInt(r.parttypeid, 10);
        // Labour / non-inventory lines (part.typeid !== 10 — service,
        // labour, overhead, charge etc.) never get picked; they're
        // auto-consumed at Finish. Pre-fill Used = Target for them so
        // the operator doesn't stare at a zero on lines they can't
        // actually pick against. Mirrors the Finisher engine's
        // `autoFulfillResult` behaviour on the API side.
        var isLabour = Number.isFinite(partTypeId) && partTypeId !== 10;
        // "Used" default:
        //   • labour → target (auto-consumed at Finish)
        //   • pick already committed / finished → the picked qty
        //     (so the operator sees what Fishbowl already recorded)
        //   • WO already has qtyused recorded (finished WOs, or a
        //     manual Fishbowl edit) → that value
        //   • otherwise → null (renders as blank + placeholder=target).
        //     effectiveUsedQty() falls back to target so Finish uses
        //     target when the operator leaves the field untouched.
        //     Prevents the "0 wipes the pick" trap the old default
        //     ("just use woi.qtyused which was 0") caused.
        var pickedQty = parseFloat(r.pickedqty) || 0;
        var usedDefault;
        if (isLabour)           usedDefault = target;
        else if (pickedQty > 0) usedDefault = pickedQty;
        else if (used > 0)      usedDefault = used;
        else                    usedDefault = null;
        var p = priorLines[i];
        return {
          idx: i, woitemId: r.id,
          partId: parseInt(r.partid, 10) || 0,
          partNum: r.partnum || '', partDesc: r.partdesc || '',
          partTypeId: partTypeId,
          isLabour: isLabour,
          uom: r.uomcode || '',
          target: target,
          usedInput:    p && p.dirty ? p.usedInput : usedDefault,
          scrappedInput: p && p.dirty ? p.scrappedInput : scrap,
          dirty: !!(p && p.dirty),
          // Pick-availability context — feeds the Pickable / Picked
          // column between UOM and Target. See loadSubDetail's linesSql
          // for the source aggregates.
          pickedQty:     parseFloat(r.pickedqty)   || 0,
          pickedStatus:  parseInt(r.pickedstatus, 10) || 0,  // 40 > 30
          pendingQty:    parseFloat(r.pendingqty)  || 0,
          availableQty:  parseFloat(r.availableqty) || 0,
          // Scrap-location context — pre-resolved default location
          // for the part in the WO's LG plus the qty available AT
          // that specific location. Empty when the part has no
          // default in this LG; Finish-click validation then falls
          // back to a "next available tag" query.
          defaultLocId:    parseInt(r.default_loc_id, 10) || 0,
          defaultLocName:  r.default_loc_name || '',
          defaultLgName:   r.default_lg_name  || '',
          defaultLocAvail: parseFloat(r.default_loc_avail) || 0,
          isSerialTracked: (parseInt(r.serial_tracked, 10) || 0) > 0,
          hasTracking:     (parseInt(r.has_tracking, 10) || 0) > 0,
          // Actual scrap qty already recorded against this WO —
          // aggregated from inventorylog rows where info='WO <num>'
          // + typeid=67 (Adj Scrap). Populated for both eligible and
          // non-eligible WOs so the Scrapped column reflects prior
          // scrap activity in the WO history even after the WO is
          // Fulfilled (when woitem.qtyScrapped stays at 0 because
          // ImportScrapData doesn't update the WO's own line).
          scrapActual:     parseFloat(r.scrap_actual) || 0,
          // Scrap-tracking selection — populated by
          // openScrapTrackingModal when the operator picks specific
          // tags/serials to scrap. When null, buildScrapPlan falls
          // back to FIFO auto-allocation. Preserved across collapse/
          // expand via priorLines copy below.
          scrapSelection:  (p && p.scrapSelection) ? p.scrapSelection : null,
        };
      });
      // Build per-def FG tracking state — one entry per active
      // parttracking row on the FG part. Each def carries its own
      // value, mandatory flag, suggestion, and confirmed flag.
      //
      // Contract per parttracking.typeid + parttotracking.nextvalue:
      //   • Has nextValue → mandatory. Fishbowl's contract says the
      //     value must be used. Auto-applied silently, non-editable,
      //     no confirm gate.
      //       - typeid 40 (Serial): sequential generator seeded from
      //         nextValue, fgQty count.
      //       - typeid 20/30 (Date / Expiration Date): today + N days
      //         where N = int(nextValue). Falsy N → today.
      //       - typeid 10 / other: verbatim string.
      //   • No nextValue → non-mandatory. A suggestion is computed:
      //       - Serial: WO-num sequence (e.g. `W1024-001`, `W1024-002`).
      //         Raw-serial picker path is reachable via the modal.
      //       - Date: today.
      //       - Batch/other: WO number.
      //     Operator must confirm the suggestion (click "Use suggestion"
      //     or edit the field) before Finish, unless the
      //     autoApplyFgDefaults setting is on — in which case the
      //     suggestion is treated as pre-confirmed.
      var fgQty = Math.round(fgSerialQty(wo));
      var woNum = wo && wo.num ? String(wo.num) : '';
      var autoApply = !!state.autoApplyFgDefaults;
      function fgTodayIso() {
        var d = new Date();
        return d.getFullYear() + '-' +
          String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' +
          String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
      }
      function fgDaysFromToday(n) {
        var d = new Date();
        d.setDate(d.getDate() + n);
        return d.getFullYear() + '-' +
          String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' +
          String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
      }
      var priorDefs = (priorFg && Array.isArray(priorFg.defs)) ? priorFg.defs : [];
      var priorByPtId = {};
      priorDefs.forEach(function (d) { priorByPtId[d.partTrackingId] = d; });
      var defs = (fgTracking || []).map(function (t) {
        var partTrackingId = parseInt(t.part_tracking_id, 10);
        var typeId = parseInt(t.type_id, 10);
        var isSerial = typeId === 40;
        var isDate   = typeId === 20 || typeId === 30;
        var rawNext  = t.next_value == null ? '' : String(t.next_value).trim();
        var hasNextValue = rawNext.length > 0;
        var displayName = t.name ||
          (isSerial ? 'Serial number'
                    : typeId === 30 ? 'Expiration date'
                    : isDate ? 'Date'

        var prior = priorByPtId[partTrackingId] || null;

        // Value driven by nextValue when mandatory.
        var mandatoryValue = null;
        if (hasNextValue) {
          if (isSerial) {
            mandatoryValue = (fgQty > 0) ? generateFgSerials(rawNext, fgQty) : [];
          } else if (isDate) {
            var days = parseInt(rawNext, 10);
            mandatoryValue = Number.isFinite(days) ? fgDaysFromToday(days) : rawNext;
          } else {
            mandatoryValue = rawNext;
          }
        }

        // Suggestion for non-mandatory defs.
        var suggestion = null;
        if (!hasNextValue) {
          if (isSerial) {
            var seed = woNum ? woNum + '-001' : '001';
            suggestion = (fgQty > 0) ? generateFgSerials(seed, fgQty) : [];
          } else if (isDate) {
