            suggestion = fgTodayIso();
          } else {
            suggestion = woNum;
          }
        }

        // Effective value + confirmed flag.
        //   - Mandatory → value = mandatoryValue; confirmed = true.
        //   - Non-mandatory:
        //       • prior state exists → carry it (respects prior edits).
        //       • else if autoApply setting → seed with suggestion,
        //         confirmed=true (silent commit).
        //       • else → leave blank/empty, confirmed=false (gate Finish).
        var value, confirmed;
        if (hasNextValue) {
          value = mandatoryValue;
          confirmed = true;
        } else if (prior) {
          value = prior.value;
          confirmed = !!prior.confirmed;
        } else if (autoApply) {
          value = suggestion;
          confirmed = true;
        } else {
          value = isSerial ? [] : '';
          confirmed = false;
        }

        // Serials also carry a textarea buffer (edit surface). Keep
        // it in sync with `value` unless prior edits already diverged.
        var serialsText = '';
        if (isSerial) {
          if (prior && typeof prior.serialsText === 'string') {
            serialsText = prior.serialsText;
          } else if (Array.isArray(value) && value.length) {
            serialsText = value.join('\n');
          }
        }

        return {
          partTrackingId: partTrackingId,
          typeId: typeId,
          name: displayName,
          isSerial: isSerial,
          isDate: isDate,
          hasNextValue: hasNextValue,
          nextValue: rawNext,
          mandatory: hasNextValue,
          value: value,
          serialsText: serialsText,
          suggestion: suggestion,
          confirmed: confirmed,
        };
      });
      var eligible = !!(wo && Finisher.isFinishableStatus(wo));
      var pickOk = !!(wo && Finisher.isPickReady(wo));
      var pickNum = (wo && wo.pick && wo.pick.picks && wo.pick.picks[0]) ? wo.pick.picks[0].num : null;
      state.finishState[woId] = {
        status: prior && prior.status === 'done' ? 'done' : 'idle',
        eligible: eligible,
        pickReady: pickOk,
        pickNum: pickNum,
        lines: lines,
        fg: {
          defs: defs,
          fgQty: fgQty,
        },
        allocations: {},
        blockers: prior && prior.blockers ? prior.blockers : [],
        steps: prior && prior.steps ? prior.steps : [],
        lastError: prior ? prior.lastError : null,
        // preflightRun flags whether we've called previewFinish once.
        // Preflight is expensive (Get pick + stock SQL) so we run it
        // lazily. Retain a prior preflight for the same session.
        preflightRun: !!(prior && prior.preflightRun),
        preview: prior ? prior.preview : null,
        // Populated by runPreflightIfEligible from the preview's
        // stockRows + pick.PickItems. Array of serial-line summaries
        // {pickitemId, partNum, required, committed, readOnly, candidates[]}
        // — one entry per serialized pickitem on the pick.
        serialLines: prior && prior.serialLines ? prior.serialLines : [],
        // Per-pickitem selection state: pickitemId -> array<serialKey>.
        // Survives across collapse/expand so the operator doesn't lose
        // their picks. Cleared only by refreshWoRow after a finish.
        serialSelection: prior && prior.serialSelection ? prior.serialSelection : {},
      };
      return state.finishState[woId];
    }

    function loadSubDetail(woId) {
      var host = document.getElementById('subDetail-' + woId);
      if (!host) return;
      if (state.subCache[woId]) {
        // Re-render from cache — but rebuild finishState from current
        // wo.statusId so the panel reflects any finish that has
        // completed since the last expand.
        var cached = state.subCache[woId];
        initFinishState(woId, cached.rows, cached.fgTracking);
        host.innerHTML = renderSubDetail(woId, cached.rows);
        runPreflightIfEligible(woId);
        return;
      }
      host.innerHTML = '<div class="sub-loading">Loading raw-material lines…</div>';
      // Raw-material lines + per-line pick / stock context. Feeds
      // the "Pickable / Picked" column between UOM and Target so the
      // operator can see at a glance which lines can be fulfilled.
      //   • pickedqty       = SUM pickitem.qty for status IN (30, 40)
      //                       (committed + finished). Also the Used
      //                       column default.
      //   • pickedstatus    = MAX(statusid) of those rows → 40 wins
      //                       over 30, so we can label "Picked" vs
      //                       "Committed".
      //   • pendingqty      = SUM pickitem.qty for status IN
      //                       (5, 6, 10, 11, 20) — the still-to-pick
      //                       requirement in pick UOM.
      //   • availableqty    = net-available on-hand for the part in
      //                       the WO's LG (tag.qty - qtycommitted)
      //                       restricted to pickable/counted locations,
      //                       matching the traffic-light query in
      //                       loadAll's availability SQL.
      // LG scope: WO's own moLgId. Falls back to 0 (no rows match)
      // if the WO has no LG so the column just shows "0 avail".
      var wo = findWoById(woId);
      var lgId = (wo && wo.moLgId) ? parseInt(wo.moLgId, 10) : 0;
      // WO-number literal for the inventorylog.info match on scrap
      // records posted by this report (postScrapImport writes the
      // note as 'WO <num>' via buildScrapPlan). Escaped for SQL.
      var scrapNote = wo && wo.num ? "WO " + escSQL(String(wo.num)) : "";
      var linesSql =
        "SELECT woi.id AS id, woi.partid AS partid, " +
        "       p.num AS partnum, p.description AS partdesc, " +
        "       p.typeid AS parttypeid, " +
        "       u.code AS uomcode, " +
        "       woi.qtytarget AS qtytarget, woi.qtyused AS qtyused, woi.qtyscrapped AS qtyscrapped, " +
        "       woi.cost AS cost, " +
        "       COALESCE(picked.qty, 0) AS pickedqty, " +
        "       COALESCE(picked.maxstat, 0) AS pickedstatus, " +
        "       COALESCE(pending.qty, 0) AS pendingqty, " +
        "       COALESCE(avail.qty, 0) AS availableqty, " +
        // Scrap-location context — pre-resolves the default scrap
        // location for each raw-material line so the operator gets
        // an inline hint under the Scrapped input, and Finish-click
        // validation can decide whether a fallback query is needed.
        //   default_loc_id/name/lg_name → part.defaultlocation for
        //     the WO's LG. Preferred scrap location per user spec.
        //   default_loc_avail → net-pickable qty AT that location
        //     (not aggregated across the LG). Used to decide whether
        //     we even need the fallback query.
        "       dl.locationid AS default_loc_id, " +
        "       dl_loc.name AS default_loc_name, " +
        "       dl_lg.name AS default_lg_name, " +
        "       COALESCE(dl_avail.qty, 0) AS default_loc_avail, " +
        // Serial-tracking flag — non-zero means the part is serialised
        // (parttracking.typeid = 40). Emits per-unit CSV rows on scrap.
        "       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parttotracking ptt " +
        "         JOIN parttracking pt ON pt.id = ptt.parttrackingid " +
        "         WHERE ptt.partid = woi.partid AND pt.typeid = 40 AND pt.activeflag = 1) AS serial_tracked, " +
        // Any-tracking flag — non-zero means the part has ANY active
        // parttracking (lot number, expiration date, batch, serial,
        // etc.). When a tracked line has a scrap qty > 0, the operator
        // is prompted via openScrapTrackingModal to pick which tag(s)
        // / serial(s) to scrap instead of FIFO auto-allocation. Falls
        // back to FIFO if the operator doesn't open the modal.
        "       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parttotracking ptt " +
        "         JOIN parttracking pt ON pt.id = ptt.parttrackingid " +
        "         WHERE ptt.partid = woi.partid AND pt.activeflag = 1) AS has_tracking, " +
        // Actual scrap qty against this WO — SUM(ABS(changeqty)) from
        // inventorylog rows where typeid=67 (Adj Scrap) and info
        // matches the WO note the scrap step posted ('WO <num>').
        // woitem.qtyscrapped isn't updated by ImportScrapData, so
        // without this the read-only Scrapped cell on a finished WO
        // shows 0 even though stock was actually scrapped against it.
        // Coalesced to 0 when nothing scrapped.
        "       COALESCE(scrap.qty, 0) AS scrap_actual " +
        "FROM woitem woi " +
        "LEFT JOIN part p ON p.id = woi.partid " +
        "LEFT JOIN uom u ON u.id = woi.uomid " +
        "LEFT JOIN (SELECT woitemid, SUM(qty) AS qty, MAX(statusid) AS maxstat FROM pickitem " +
        "           WHERE statusid IN (30, 40) GROUP BY woitemid) picked " +
        "  ON picked.woitemid = woi.id " +
        "LEFT JOIN (SELECT woitemid, SUM(qty) AS qty FROM pickitem " +
        "           WHERE statusid IN (5, 6, 10, 11, 20) GROUP BY woitemid) pending " +
        "  ON pending.woitemid = woi.id " +
        "LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.partid AS partid, " +
        "                  SUM(GREATEST(t.qty - COALESCE(t.qtycommitted, 0), 0)) AS qty " +
        "           FROM tag t JOIN location l ON l.id = t.locationid " +
        "           WHERE l.locationgroupid = " + lgId + " " +
        "             AND t.typeid IN (30, 40) " +
        "             AND l.countedasavailable = 1 " +
        "             AND l.pickable = 1 " +
        "           GROUP BY t.partid) avail " +
        "  ON avail.partid = woi.partid " +
        "LEFT JOIN defaultlocation dl ON dl.partid = woi.partid AND dl.locationgroupid = " + lgId + " " +
        "LEFT JOIN location dl_loc ON dl_loc.id = dl.locationid " +
        "LEFT JOIN locationgroup dl_lg ON dl_lg.id = dl_loc.locationgroupid " +
        "LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.partid AS partid, t.locationid AS locationid, " +
        "                  SUM(GREATEST(t.qty - COALESCE(t.qtycommitted, 0), 0)) AS qty " +
        "           FROM tag t " +
        "           WHERE t.typeid IN (30, 40) " +
        "           GROUP BY t.partid, t.locationid) dl_avail " +
        "  ON dl_avail.partid = woi.partid AND dl_avail.locationid = dl.locationid " +
        // Scrap actual per part — sums the WO's scrap transactions
        // from inventorylog. ImportScrapData writes the Note
        // verbatim into inventorylog.info, so filtering info to
        // 'WO <num>' pulls every scrap this WO caused (across any
        // location / tag / lot). Use LIKE + a trailing wildcard so
        // Fishbowl variants that append the tag/lot suffix to the
        // note still match. Drop the `typeid=67` filter — some
        // Fishbowl builds record scrap under a different type
        // (e.g. 60/62/65); the note match is specific enough on its
        // own since the operator's WO number is unique. Only include
        // inventory decreases (changeqty < 0) so a residual "adjust
        // back" row can't inflate the total.
        "LEFT JOIN (SELECT il.partid AS partid, " +
        "                  SUM(GREATEST(-il.changeqty, 0)) AS qty " +
        "           FROM inventorylog il " +
        "           WHERE il.info LIKE '" + scrapNote + "%' " +
        "             AND il.changeqty < 0 " +
        "           GROUP BY il.partid) scrap " +
        "  ON scrap.partid = woi.partid " +
        "WHERE woi.woid = " + woId + " AND woi.typeid = 20 " +
        "ORDER BY woi.sortid";
      // FG tracking definitions — via parttotracking (xref) → parttracking.
      // parttracking.typeid map:
      //   10 Text, 20 Date, 30 Expiration Date, 40 Serial,
      //   50 Money, 60 Quantity, 70 Count, 80 Checkbox
      // `ptt.nextvalue` is Fishbowl's authoritative next value for
      // the def; per-type interpretation happens in initFinishState:
      //   • typeid=40 → seed for the sequential serial generator
      //   • typeid=20/30 → integer count of days-from-today
      //   • else → verbatim string value
      // `pt.id` is captured so buildFgTrackingBlock can match each
      // def to the FG part's PartTrackingList on the SavePayload.
      var fgTrackSql =
        "SELECT DISTINCT pt.id AS part_tracking_id, pt.typeid AS type_id, " +
        "       pt.name AS name, ptt.nextvalue AS next_value " +
        "FROM woitem woi " +
        "JOIN parttotracking ptt ON ptt.partid = woi.partid " +
        "JOIN parttracking pt ON pt.id = ptt.parttrackingid " +
        "WHERE woi.woid = " + woId + " AND woi.typeid = 10 AND pt.activeflag = 1 " +
        "ORDER BY pt.id";
      Promise.all([qp(linesSql), qp(fgTrackSql)]).then(function (results) {
        var rows = results[0], fgTracking = results[1] || [];
        // Diagnostic: which lines came back with scrap_actual > 0?
        // If a finished WO's Scrapped column still reads "—", enable
        // the debug drawer and look for this line — if scrapCount is
        // zero the inventorylog match failed (info doesn't include
        // the "WO <num>" prefix, or the WO's scrap ran under a
        // different note).
        var scrapCount = 0, scrapDetail = [];
        rows.forEach(function (r) {
          var q = parseFloat(r.scrap_actual) || 0;
          if (q > 0) { scrapCount++; scrapDetail.push(r.partnum + '=' + q); }
        });
        dbg('Sub-detail load WO#' + woId + ' — ' + rows.length + ' line(s), ' +
            'scrap-actual matches: ' + scrapCount +
            (scrapDetail.length ? ' [' + scrapDetail.join(', ') + ']' : '') +
            ' (note filter: "' + scrapNote + '%")', 'info');
        state.subCache[woId] = { rows: rows, fgTracking: fgTracking };
        initFinishState(woId, rows, fgTracking);
        host.innerHTML = renderSubDetail(woId, rows);
        runPreflightIfEligible(woId);
      }).catch(function (err) {
        host.innerHTML = '<div class="sub-loading">Failed to load: ' + esc(err.message || err) + '</div>';
      });
    }

    // Fire the WO Finisher preview (GetPickRq + stock query + allocation)
    // when the row is expanded and the WO is finish-eligible. Non-blocking:
    // renders a loading state in the banner while it works, then repaints
    // the banner with the resolved status / blockers.
    function runPreflightIfEligible(woId) {
      var fs = state.finishState[woId];
      var wo = findWoById(woId);
      if (!fs || !wo) return;
      if (!fs.eligible) return;
      // Surface the reason preflight can't run so the "Check stock"
      // button always produces visible feedback. Previously, when a
      // WO had no pick (or the pick query didn't join through
      // pickitem.woItemId), preflight would silently return and the
      // button appeared to do nothing on click.
      if (!fs.pickNum) {
        fs.status = 'error';
        fs.lastError = 'No pick is attached to this WO — generate a pick in Fishbowl first, then reload the report.';
        fs.blockers = [fs.lastError];
        fs.preflightRun = true;
        updateFinishBanner(woId);
        return;
      }
      if (fs.preflightRun) return;
      fs.preflightRun = true;
      fs.status = 'preflight';
      updateFinishBanner(woId);
      var woRow = Finisher.woRowFrom(wo);
      Finisher.previewFinish(woRow, {
        mode: Finisher.CFG.mode,
        selectedSerialKeys: collectSelectedSerialKeys(fs),
      })
        .then(function (result) {
          fs.preview = result;
          fs.blockers = result.blockers || [];
          fs.lastError = result.error && !result.ok ? String(result.error) : null;
          // Rebuild the per-pickitem serial-line summary from the
          // fresh preview. For committed picks this is the read-only
          // "these are the serials Fishbowl already has" list; for
          // pending picks it's the selectable candidate pool.
          fs.serialLines = Finisher.serialLinesFrom(result) || [];
          // Reconcile stored selection with the freshly-loaded
          // candidate set — drop any keys that no longer correspond
          // to an available serial (source stock moved / consumed /
          // committed elsewhere between opens).
          reconcileSerialSelection(fs);
          fs.status = result.ok && !result.blockers.length ? 'ready' : 'error';
          // FG-tracking defaults are seeded by initFinishState into
          // fs.fg.defs[] (per parttracking row, per type, honouring
          // parttotracking.nextvalue). Nothing to do here — preflight
          // is purely about pick allocation.
          updateFinishBanner(woId);
          updateSourceSerialsPanel(woId);
        })
        .catch(function (e) {
          fs.status = 'error';
          fs.lastError = String(e && e.message || e);
          updateFinishBanner(woId);
          updateSourceSerialsPanel(woId);
        });
    }

    // Refresh the source-serials panel in place after preflight has
    // populated fs.serialLines. If a panel is already in the DOM,
    // swap it; otherwise insert one before the FG-tracking panel
    // (or at the end of the sub-detail if there's no FG panel).
    function updateSourceSerialsPanel(woId) {
      var host = document.getElementById('subDetail-' + woId);
      if (!host) return;
      var newHtml = renderSourceSerialsPanel(woId);
      var oldPanel = host.querySelector('.finish-serial-lines');
      if (!newHtml) {
        if (oldPanel) oldPanel.parentNode.removeChild(oldPanel);
        return;
      }
      var tmp = document.createElement('div');
      tmp.innerHTML = newHtml;
      var newPanel = tmp.firstElementChild;
      if (!newPanel) return;
      if (oldPanel) {
        oldPanel.parentNode.replaceChild(newPanel, oldPanel);
      } else {
        var fgPanel = host.querySelector('.finish-fg-tracking');
        if (fgPanel) host.insertBefore(newPanel, fgPanel);
        else host.appendChild(newPanel);
      }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Pickable / Picked column cell — per raw-material line.
    //   • Blue  → picked (statusid 30 committed OR 40 finished)
    //   • Green → all needed stock is available in the pick's LG
    //   • Amber → some stock available but short of what's needed
    //   • Red   → no stock in the LG
    //   • Muted → labour / non-inventory (auto-fulfilled at Finish)
    // Requirement precedence: prefer the pickitem-derived pendingQty
    // (what Fishbowl actually wants to pick) and fall back to the
    // woitem target minus what's already been used, so lines without
    // an active pick still show a sensible expectation.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function renderPickAvailCell(line, target) {
      if (!line) return '<td class="nr muted">—</td>';
      if (line.isLabour) {
        return '<td class="nr muted" title="Non-inventory line — auto-fulfilled on Finish">Auto</td>';
      }
      var picked = line.pickedQty || 0;
      if (picked > 0) {
        // Compact display — just the qty in blue. Full state
        // ("Picked" vs "Committed") stays in the tooltip so it's
        // still discoverable on hover.
        var label = line.pickedStatus === 40 ? 'Picked' : 'Committed';
        return '<td class="nr" style="color:#1d4ed8;font-weight:600;" ' +
                'title="' + label + ' via pickitem — locked in for this WO">' +
                fmtQty(picked) + '</td>';
      }
      // No pick yet — evaluate against available on-hand.
      var required = line.pendingQty > 0 ? line.pendingQty
                                         : Math.max(0, (target || 0) - (line.usedInput || 0));
      var avail = line.availableQty || 0;
      if (required <= 0) {
        return '<td class="nr muted">—</td>';
      }
      if (avail >= required) {
        return '<td class="nr" style="color:#047857;font-weight:600;" ' +
                'title="All ' + fmtQty(required) + ' available in this location group">' +
                fmtQty(avail) + '</td>';
      }
      if (avail > 0) {
        return '<td class="nr" style="color:#b45309;font-weight:600;" ' +
                'title="Partial — ' + fmtQty(avail) + ' of ' + fmtQty(required) + ' available">' +
                fmtQty(avail) + ' / ' + fmtQty(required) + '</td>';
      }
      return '<td class="nr" style="color:#b91c1c;font-weight:600;" ' +
              'title="No pickable stock in this location group — need ' + fmtQty(required) + '">' +
              '0 / ' + fmtQty(required) + '</td>';
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Scrap-hint under the Scrapped input — read on every input
    // event and surfaces where the scrap will be routed:
    //   scrapped = 0    → empty hint (nothing to route)
    //   default has qty → "→ scrap from <LG>-<Location>" (ok)
    //   default short   → "→ needs fallback at Finish" (warn)
    //   no default      → "→ resolve at Finish" (warn)
    //   labour line     → empty (scrap doesn't apply)
    // Finish-click validation runs the authoritative resolver; this
    // hint is opportunistic (only reads pre-loaded default-location
    // data, no per-keystroke query).
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function renderScrapHint(line, woId) {
      if (!line || line.isLabour) return '';
      var qty = parseFloat(line.scrappedInput) || 0;
      if (qty <= 0) return '';
      // Location strip — where the scrap will be routed. Reads the
      // pre-loaded default-location data; Finish-click validation
      // runs the authoritative resolver against live stock.
      var locHtml;
      if (line.defaultLocName && line.defaultLocAvail >= qty) {
        locHtml = '<span class="scrap-hint-inner ok">→ scrap from ' +
          esc(line.defaultLgName + '-' + line.defaultLocName) +
          '</span>';
      } else if (line.defaultLocName) {
        locHtml = '<span class="scrap-hint-inner warn">→ default ' +
          esc(line.defaultLgName + '-' + line.defaultLocName) +
          ' has only ' + fmtQty(line.defaultLocAvail) + ' — Finish will search LG for enough stock</span>';
      } else {
        locHtml = '<span class="scrap-hint-inner warn">→ no default location — Finish will pick oldest tag location with enough stock</span>';
      }
      // Tracking picker chip — for tracked parts (any parttracking
      // active). Operator opens the modal to pick specific tags /
      // serials to scrap; if they don't, buildScrapPlan falls back
      // to FIFO auto-allocation. Selection status shows next to
      // the button so the operator knows whether their choice is
      // already applied.
      var trackChip = '';
      if (line.hasTracking && woId != null) {
        var sel = line.scrapSelection || null;
        var chipCls, chipTxt;
        if (sel && sel.totalQty > 0) {
          var okQty = Math.abs(sel.totalQty - qty) < 1e-6;
          chipCls = okQty ? 'ok' : 'warn';
          chipTxt = okQty
            ? '✓ ' + fmtQty(sel.totalQty) + ' selected'
            : '⚠ ' + fmtQty(sel.totalQty) + ' of ' + fmtQty(qty) + ' selected';
        } else {
          chipCls = line.isSerialTracked ? 'warn' : '';
          chipTxt = line.isSerialTracked
            ? 'Select serials to scrap…'
            : 'FIFO (auto) — click to choose lot';
        }
        var btnBg = chipCls === 'ok'   ? '#d1fae5'
                  : chipCls === 'warn' ? '#fef3c7'
                                       : '#f1f5f9';
        var btnFg = chipCls === 'ok'   ? '#065f46'
                  : chipCls === 'warn' ? '#7c2d12'
                                       : '#334155';
        var btnBd = chipCls === 'ok'   ? '#6ee7b7'
                  : chipCls === 'warn' ? '#f59e0b'
                                       : '#cbd5e1';
        trackChip =
          '<button type="button" ' +
            'onclick="openScrapTrackingModal(' + woId + ',' + line.idx + ')" ' +
            'style="margin-top:3px;padding:2px 8px;font-size:10.5px;' +
              'background:' + btnBg + ';border:1px solid ' + btnBd + ';color:' + btnFg + ';' +
              'border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;">' +
            esc(chipTxt) +
          '</button>';
      }
      return locHtml + (trackChip ? '<br />' + trackChip : '');
    }

    // ============================================================
    // SUB-DETAIL RENDER
    // ============================================================
    // Extended to render three progressive sections beneath the
    // existing raw-material table:
    //
    //   1. Finish banner — preflight state + primary Finish button.
    //      Renders whenever the WO is in status 10/30 (finish-eligible).
    //   2. FG tracking form (Batch # / Use-by / Serials) — always
    //      visible when eligible so the operator can pre-fill values.
    //   3. Source allocation notice — a compact reminder that
    //      serialized raw parts need explicit selection. v1 uses
    //      auto-tracking so no picker; if the preview returns blockers
    //      about serials the banner surfaces them with a link to
    //      the standalone WO Finisher (which has the full wizard).
    //
    // The raw-material <table.sub> stays exactly as before, with two
    // exceptions when the WO is eligible: the Used and Scrapped
    // columns render <input type="number"> bound to
    // state.finishState[woId].lines[i].{usedInput,scrappedInput}.
    // Values only travel to Fishbowl on Finish click.
    function renderSubDetail(woId, rows) {
      var wo = findWoById(woId);
      var fs = state.finishState[woId];
      var eligible = !!(fs && fs.eligible);

      if (!rows || !rows.length) {
        // Even with no raw-material rows, a WO may still be finishable
        // (kit MO with only labour lines). Render the banner so the
        // operator can still Finish.
        var body = '<h5>Raw materials</h5><div class="sub-loading">No raw-material lines on this work order.</div>';
        return renderFinishBanner(woId) + body;
      }

      var html = [];
      html.push(renderFinishBanner(woId));
      html.push('<h5>Raw materials (woitem typeId = 20)</h5>');
      // Column header adapts to the pick state — "Picked" once every
      // line has been picked (all lines status 30 or 40 or labour),
      // otherwise "Pickable" while the operator is deciding whether
      // to commit. Labour lines don't count against the check since
      // they're auto-fulfilled at Finish.
      var allPicked = fs && fs.lines.length && fs.lines.every(function (l) {
        return l.isLabour || l.pickedStatus >= 30;
      });
      var pickColHeader = allPicked ? 'Picked' : 'Pickable';
      html.push('<table class="sub"><thead><tr>');
      html.push('<th>Part #</th><th>Description</th><th>UOM</th>');
      html.push('<th class="nr">' + pickColHeader + '</th>');
      html.push('<th class="nr">Target</th><th class="nr">Used</th><th class="nr">Scrapped</th>');
      html.push('<th class="nr">Consumed</th>');
      html.push('</tr></thead><tbody>');
      rows.forEach(function (r, i) {
        var target = parseFloat(r.qtytarget) || 0;
        var line = fs && fs.lines[i];
        // Read-only Scrapped display prefers scrap_actual from
        // inventorylog (any prior scrap posted against this WO)
        // over woitem.qtyscrapped (which ImportScrapData doesn't
        // update). The greater of the two wins so a manual WO-level
        // scrap edit in Fishbowl isn't hidden.
        var scrapWoi    = parseFloat(r.qtyscrapped)  || 0;
        var scrapActual = parseFloat(r.scrap_actual) || 0;
        var scrapRO     = Math.max(scrapWoi, scrapActual);
        // "Used" for the % calc + read-only display: falls back to
        // target when the operator has left the field blank (null).
        // usedRaw is the raw input value (may be null); usedEff is
        // the effective qty for Consumed % math.
        var usedRaw = line ? line.usedInput : (parseFloat(r.qtyused) || 0);
        var usedEff = line ? effectiveUsedQty(line) : (parseFloat(r.qtyused) || 0);
        var scrap   = line ? effectiveScrapQty(line) : scrapRO;
        var pct = target > 0 ? Math.round(100 * (usedEff + scrap) / target) : 0;
        var editable = eligible;
        var rowCls = editable ? 'finish-row-edit' : '';
        // Editable Used input renders blank when usedRaw is null so
        // the operator sees an empty field with target as the
        // placeholder — the intent is "leave blank to use target".
        var usedInputVal = (usedRaw == null || usedRaw === '') ? '' : usedRaw;
        var usedCell = editable
          ? '<td class="nr"><input type="number" step="0.001" min="0" ' +
              'class="qty-edit" data-wo-id="' + woId + '" data-idx="' + i + '" data-field="usedInput" ' +
              'value="' + usedInputVal + '" ' +
              'placeholder="' + fmtQty(target) + '" ' +
              'title="Leave blank to consume the target qty (' + fmtQty(target) + ')" ' +
              'onchange="onFinishLineChange(this)" oninput="onFinishLineDirty(this)" ' +
              'aria-label="Qty used"></td>'
          : '<td class="nr">' + fmtQty(usedEff) + '</td>';
        // Ensure `line.idx` is stable — the modal opens on click via
        // idx, and if we're rendering from stale cached rows the
        // renumbered lines could point at a stale entry. `line.idx`
        // is set at initFinishState time so it matches this loop.
        if (line && line.idx !== i) line.idx = i;
        var scrapHint = editable && line ? renderScrapHint(line, woId) : '';
        var scrapCell = editable
          ? '<td class="nr"><input type="number" step="0.001" min="0" ' +
              'class="qty-edit" data-wo-id="' + woId + '" data-idx="' + i + '" data-field="scrappedInput" ' +
              'value="' + scrap + '" ' +
              'onchange="onFinishLineChange(this)" oninput="onFinishLineDirty(this)" ' +
              'aria-label="Qty scrapped">' +
              '<div class="scrap-hint" data-scrap-hint-for="' + woId + '-' + i + '">' + scrapHint + '</div>' +
              '</td>'
          : '<td class="nr"' +
              (scrapActual > 0
                ? ' title="Scrapped against ' + esc(wo && wo.num ? 'WO ' + wo.num : 'this WO') +
                    ' — from Fishbowl part activity (inventorylog)"'
                : '') +
              '>' +
              (scrap > 0 ? fmtQty(scrap) : '<span class="muted">—</span>') +
            '</td>';
        html.push(
          '<tr class="' + rowCls + '" data-line-idx="' + i + '">' +
            '<td><strong>' + esc(r.partnum || '') + '</strong></td>' +
            '<td>' + esc(r.partdesc || '') + '</td>' +
            '<td>' + esc(r.uomcode || '') + '</td>' +
            renderPickAvailCell(line, target) +
            '<td class="nr">' + fmtQty(target) + '</td>' +
            usedCell +
            scrapCell +
            '<td class="nr" data-role="pct">' + pct + '%</td>' +
          '</tr>'
        );
      });
      html.push('</tbody></table>');
      if (eligible) html.push(renderSourceSerialsPanel(woId));
      if (eligible) html.push(renderFgTrackingPanel(woId));
      return html.join('');
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Finish banner (preflight strip + primary action button)
    // Colour cue driven by fs.status:
    //   idle/preflight → .kpi.warn
    //   ready          → .kpi.ok
    //   done           → .kpi.ok    (with "Fulfilled" label + no button)
    //   error          → .kpi.late
    // For non-eligible WOs (statusId=40 already, or no pick), we
    // return a small informational strip instead of the full banner
    // so the operator still gets context.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function renderFinishBanner(woId) {
      var wo = findWoById(woId);
      var fs = state.finishState[woId];
      if (!wo || !fs) return '';
      if (wo.statusId === 40) {
        return '<div class="finish-banner kpi ok" data-fb-for="' + woId + '">' +
                 '<span class="fb-summary">' +
                   '<span class="badge b-wo-40">Fulfilled</span>' +
                   '<span class="muted">Work order is already complete — no finish action required.</span>' +
                 '</span></div>';
      }
      if (!fs.eligible) {
        return '<div class="finish-banner kpi warn" data-fb-for="' + woId + '">' +
                 '<span class="fb-summary muted">Finish not available for this WO status.</span>' +
               '</div>';
      }
      // Preflight steps: pick → picks committed → FG default location → allocations OK
      // Pick badge reflects the actual traffic-light state rather than
      // a binary "committed / not committed". 'green' picks (all items
      // available but not yet locked in) can still be finished — the
      // SavePickRq will commit + finish atomically — so they get a
      // done badge alongside 'committed' / 'done'.
      var pickState = wo.pick && wo.pick.state || 'none';
      var pickStep;
      switch (pickState) {
        case 'committed': pickStep = '<span class="badge done">Pick committed</span>'; break;
        case 'done':      pickStep = '<span class="badge done">Pick complete</span>'; break;
        case 'green':     pickStep = '<span class="badge done">Stock available</span>'; break;
        case 'yellow':    pickStep = '<span class="badge active">Partial stock</span>'; break;
        case 'red':       pickStep = '<span class="badge fail">No stock</span>'; break;
        default:          pickStep = '<span class="badge fail">No pick</span>';
      }
      var allocStep, statusMod, actionHtml, extra = '';
      if (fs.status === 'preflight') {
        allocStep = '<span class="badge active">Checking stock…</span>';
        statusMod = 'warn';
        actionHtml = '<button type="button" class="hdr-btn primary" disabled>Finish WO</button>';
      } else if (fs.status === 'error' || (fs.blockers && fs.blockers.length)) {
        allocStep = '<span class="badge fail">Blocked</span>';
        statusMod = 'late';
        actionHtml = '<button type="button" class="hdr-btn primary" disabled title="Resolve blockers below">Finish WO</button>';
        extra = renderBlockerList(woId);
      } else if (fs.status === 'submitting') {
        allocStep = '<span class="badge active">Committing…</span>';
        statusMod = 'warn';
        actionHtml = '<button type="button" class="hdr-btn primary" disabled>Finishing…</button>';
      } else if (fs.status === 'done') {
        allocStep = '<span class="badge done">Fulfilled</span>';
        statusMod = 'ok';
        actionHtml = '';
      } else if (fs.status === 'ready') {
        allocStep = '<span class="badge done">Stock allocated</span>';
        statusMod = 'ok';
        actionHtml = '<button type="button" class="hdr-btn primary" onclick="onFinishClick(' + woId + ')">Finish WO</button>';
      } else {
        // idle — the preflight preview (GetPick + stock query +
        // allocation dry-run) hasn't finished. Normally it fires
        // automatically on expand, so this button only shows if it
        // never completed (never ran, or a network glitch dropped
        // the promise). Clicking re-runs it.
        allocStep = '<span class="badge pending">Not checked yet</span>';
        statusMod = 'warn';
        actionHtml = '<button type="button" class="hdr-btn primary" ' +
          'title="Re-run the pre-finish check: fetches the pick, queries stock, and dry-runs the allocation to verify everything is ready to commit." ' +
          'onclick="onPreflightClick(' + woId + ')">Check stock</button>';
      }
      var stepsHtml = '';
      if (fs.steps && fs.steps.length) {
        stepsHtml = '<span class="finish-steps">' +
          fs.steps.map(function (s) { return '<span class="badge done">' + esc(s) + '</span>'; }).join('') +
        '</span>';
      }
      return '<div class="finish-banner kpi ' + statusMod + '" data-fb-for="' + woId + '">' +
               '<span class="fb-summary">' +
                 '<span class="fb-step">' + pickStep + '</span>' +
                 '<span class="fb-step">' + allocStep + '</span>' +
                 (stepsHtml ? '<span class="fb-step">' + stepsHtml + '</span>' : '') +
               '</span>' +
               '<span class="fb-actions">' + actionHtml + '</span>' +
             '</div>' + extra;
    }
    function renderBlockerList(woId) {
      var fs = state.finishState[woId];
      if (!fs) return '';
      // Combine explicit blockers with a fallback lastError. A finish
      // attempt that fails inside prepareFinish (API rejection, network
      // error, etc.) sets fs.lastError but leaves fs.blockers empty —
      // without this fallback the banner shows "Blocked" with nothing
      // under it to explain what went wrong.
      var items = (fs.blockers || []).slice();
      if (!items.length && fs.lastError) items.push(fs.lastError);
      if (!items.length) return '';
      var wo = findWoById(woId);
      var pickNum = fs.pickNum;
      // Filter out per-part "short N (only X of Y)" bullets — the
      // Pickable / Picked column of the raw-material table now shows
      // that same info inline per row, so a bullet-list duplicate
      // would just be noise. Serial-selection warnings (SELECT_SERIALS
      // / PARTIAL_SERIAL_SELECTION / TOO_MANY_SERIALS) stay because
      // they steer the operator to the source-serials picker below.
      var shortagePattern = /: short \d/;
      var filtered = items.filter(function (b) { return !shortagePattern.test(String(b)); });
      var shortageCount = items.length - filtered.length;
      var lis = filtered.map(function (b) {
        // If the blocker embeds a multi-line CSV dump (from
        // postScrapImport's throw path), split the header text from
        // the CSV body and render the CSV inside a <pre> so newlines
        // survive and columns stay lined up. Everything else renders
        // as plain <li> content.
        var s = String(b);
        var cut = s.indexOf('\nCSV posted (');
        if (cut >= 0) {
          var head = s.slice(0, cut);
          var body = s.slice(cut + 1);   // drop the leading newline
          return '<li>' + esc(head) +
            '<pre style="margin:4px 0 0 0;padding:6px 8px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #fecaca;border-radius:4px;font-family:\'Menlo\',\'Consolas\',\'Courier New\',monospace;font-size:10.5px;color:#1e293b;white-space:pre;overflow-x:auto;max-height:200px;">' +
            esc(body) + '</pre></li>';
        }
        return '<li>' + esc(s) + '</li>';
      });
      if (shortageCount > 0) {
        lis.push('<li>' + shortageCount + ' raw-material line' +
          (shortageCount === 1 ? '' : 's') +
          ' short of stock — see the Pickable column below.</li>');
      }
      // If the blocker looks like a "picks not committed" case, include
      // a jump-to-pick link so the operator can pull the pick without
      // switching reports.
      if (pickNum && items.some(function (b) { return /pick|stock/i.test(String(b)); })) {
        lis.push('<li>Open pick <a class="pick-pill badge b-pick-30" href="#" onclick="event.preventDefault();openPick(\'' + esc(pickNum).replace(/'/g, "\\'") + '\')">' + esc(pickNum) + '</a> to resolve, then reload the row.</li>');
      }
      // Serialized-source cases: the inline serial modal picks them up
      // via the "Select serials" affordance below — no hand-off needed.
      return '<ul class="finish-blocker-list">' + lis.join('') + '</ul>';
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // FG tracking sub-panel — one field per parttracking def on the
    // FG part. Fields with a Fishbowl-driven `nextvalue` render
    // read-only (locked, silently applied). Fields without render
    // editable + a "Use suggestion" affordance the operator must
    // confirm before Finish (unless the autoApplyFgDefaults setting
    // is on).
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function renderFgTrackingPanel(woId) {
      var fs = state.finishState[woId];
      if (!fs) return '';
      var fg = fs.fg;
      if (!fg || !fg.defs || !fg.defs.length) return '';
      var qtyTarget = fg.fgQty || 0;
      var groups = fg.defs.map(function (def, idx) {
        return renderFgDefField(woId, def, idx, qtyTarget);
      });
      var summary = fgTrackingSummary(fg);
      var editAllBtn = summary.hasUnconfirmed || summary.serialsPresent
        ? ' <button type="button" class="ds-btn" style="padding:3px 9px;font-size:11px;" ' +
            'onclick="openFgTrackingModal(' + woId + ')">Edit tracking…</button>'
        : '';
      var header =
        '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px;">' +
          '<div class="fb-group-title" style="border:none;padding:0;margin:0;">Finished-good tracking</div>' +
          editAllBtn +
        '</div>';
      return '<div class="finish-fg-tracking">' +
        header +
        '<div class="fb-grid">' + groups.join('') + '</div>' +
      '</div>';
    }

    // Render one <div.fb-group> for a single tracking def. Serial
    // defs get a full-width column (textarea real estate); text/date
    // defs get compact columns. The confirm chip / lock note lives
    // inline on the right end of each input's container to save
    // vertical space in the tracking panel.
    function renderFgDefField(woId, def, idx, qtyTarget) {
      // rightDetail is the trailing content that sits on the right
      // end of each field's row: either the "Use suggestion" button,
      // "✓ Confirmed" muted text, or "🔒 Locked" for mandatory defs.
      var rightDetail = '';
      if (def.mandatory) {
        rightDetail =
          '<span class="ds-btn fg-right-detail" ' +
            'title="Locked — Fishbowl nextValue = ' + esc(def.nextValue) + '" ' +
            'style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:10.5px;background:#e0e7ff;border-color:#6366f1;color:#3730a3;white-space:nowrap;cursor:default;">' +
            'nextValue' +
          '</span>';
      } else if (!def.confirmed) {
        rightDetail =
          '<button type="button" class="ds-btn fg-right-detail" ' +
            'style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:10.5px;background:#fef3c7;border-color:#f59e0b;color:#7c2d12;white-space:nowrap;" ' +
            'onclick="onFinishFgUseSuggestion(' + woId + ',' + def.partTrackingId + ')" ' +
            'title="Apply the suggested value">' +
            'Use suggestion' +
          '</button>';
      } else {
        rightDetail =
          '<span class="muted fg-right-detail" ' +
            'style="font-size:10.5px;white-space:nowrap;">✓ Confirmed</span>';
      }
      if (def.isSerial) {
        return renderFgSerialField(woId, def, qtyTarget, rightDetail);
      }
      if (def.isDate) {
        return renderFgDateField(woId, def, rightDetail);
      }
      return renderFgTextField(woId, def, rightDetail);
    }

    function renderFgTextField(woId, def, rightDetail) {
      var val = def.value == null ? '' : String(def.value);
      var placeholder = def.mandatory ? '' :
        (def.suggestion ? 'Suggested: ' + def.suggestion : '');
      var attrs = def.mandatory
        ? 'readonly disabled style="background:#f1f5f9;color:#334155;"'
        : 'oninput="onFinishFgTextInput(' + woId + ',' + def.partTrackingId + ', this.value)"';
      return '<div class="fb-group">' +
        '<div class="fb-group-title">' + esc(def.name) + '</div>' +
        '<div class="fb-field">' +
          '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;">' +
            '<input type="text" style="flex:1;min-width:0;" ' +
              'value="' + esc(val) + '" ' +
              'placeholder="' + esc(placeholder) + '" ' +
              attrs + ' />' +
            rightDetail +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';
    }

    function renderFgDateField(woId, def, rightDetail) {
      var val = def.value == null ? '' : String(def.value);
      var attrs = def.mandatory
        ? 'readonly disabled style="background:#f1f5f9;color:#334155;"'
        : 'oninput="onFinishFgTextInput(' + woId + ',' + def.partTrackingId + ', this.value)"';
      return '<div class="fb-group">' +
        '<div class="fb-group-title">' + esc(def.name) + '</div>' +
        '<div class="fb-field">' +
          '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;">' +
            '<input type="date" style="flex:1;min-width:0;" value="' + esc(val) + '" ' + attrs + ' />' +
            rightDetail +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';
    }

    function renderFgSerialField(woId, def, qtyTarget, rightDetail) {
      // For serial defs, the value is an array; textarea shows one
      // per line. Mandatory defs render the value read-only. Non-
      // mandatory show what the operator has confirmed (empty until
      // they click Use suggestion or open the modal).
      var textarea;
      if (def.mandatory) {
        var display = Array.isArray(def.value) ? def.value.join('\n') : '';
        textarea =
          '<textarea class="finish-serial-textarea" readonly disabled ' +
            'style="background:#f1f5f9;color:#334155;" ' +
            'id="fg-serials-' + woId + '-' + def.partTrackingId + '">' +
            esc(display) +
          '</textarea>';
      } else {
        textarea =
          '<textarea class="finish-serial-textarea" ' +
            'id="fg-serials-' + woId + '-' + def.partTrackingId + '" ' +
            'oninput="onFinishFgSerialsInput(' + woId + ',' + def.partTrackingId + ', this.value)" ' +
            'placeholder="One serial per line — count must match qty">' +
            esc(def.serialsText || '') +
          '</textarea>';
      }
      var needN = Math.round(qtyTarget || 0);
      var haveN = def.mandatory
        ? (Array.isArray(def.value) ? def.value.length : 0)
        : parseFgSerials(def.serialsText || '').length;
      var countCls = (needN && haveN === needN) ? '' : 'error';
      var countHtml =
        '<div class="serial-count' + (countCls ? ' ' + countCls : '') + '" ' +
          'id="serial-count-' + woId + '-' + def.partTrackingId + '">' +
          renderSerialCountText(def.mandatory ? (Array.isArray(def.value) ? def.value.join('\n') : '') : (def.serialsText || ''), qtyTarget) +
        '</div>';
      // Serial fields put the right-side chip alongside the title
      // (compact) since the textarea is full-width and the chip would
      // otherwise waste a whole row underneath.
      return '<div class="fb-group" style="flex:1 1 320px;min-width:320px;">' +
        '<div class="fb-group-title" style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;">' +
          '<span>' + esc(def.name) +
            ' <span class="muted" style="font-weight:400;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;">· ' +
            fmtQty(qtyTarget) + ' required</span>' +
          '</span>' +
          rightDetail +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="fb-field">' +
          textarea +
          countHtml +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';
    }

    // High-level summary of the current fg state, used by the banner
    // + panel header to decide whether Finish is gated on the FG
    // tracking. Serial defs also flag `serialsPresent` so the panel
    // shows the Edit tracking button even when everything is
    // confirmed (operators still want to review generated serials).
    function fgTrackingSummary(fg) {
      var out = { hasUnconfirmed: false, unconfirmedNames: [], serialsPresent: false };
      if (!fg || !fg.defs) return out;
      fg.defs.forEach(function (d) {
        if (d.isSerial) out.serialsPresent = true;
        if (!d.mandatory && !d.confirmed) {
          out.hasUnconfirmed = true;
          out.unconfirmedNames.push(d.name);
        }
      });
      return out;
    }

    function renderSerialCountText(text, qtyTarget) {
      // parseFgSerials accepts newline OR comma separators — pasted
      // CSV counts correctly instead of collapsing to 1 serial.
      var n = parseFgSerials(text).length;
      var need = qtyTarget ? Math.round(qtyTarget) : 0;
      if (n === 0 && need > 0) {
        return '<span class="error">Empty — Fishbowl needs ' + fmtQty(qtyTarget) + '. Click Edit tracking.</span>';
      }
      if (need && n !== need) {
        return '<span class="error">' + n + ' entered · need ' + fmtQty(qtyTarget) + '</span>';
      }
      return n + ' serial' + (n === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' ready';
    }

    // ============================================================
    // SOURCE-SERIAL SELECTION — panel + modal
    // ============================================================
    // Displays one row per serialized pickitem underneath the raw-
    // material table. For pending pickitems (status 5/6/10/11/20) the
    // operator clicks "Select serials" and picks from candidates
    // available in the pick's LG. For committed / finished pickitems
    // (status 30/40) the modal opens read-only so the operator can
    // verify the serials Fishbowl already has assigned.

    function renderSourceSerialsPanel(woId) {
      var fs = state.finishState[woId];
      if (!fs || !fs.serialLines || !fs.serialLines.length) return '';
      // When every serialized pickitem is already committed / finished,
      // there's nothing to SELECT — the panel just confirms what's
      // locked in. One summary row + one "View all" modal keeps the
      // sub-detail compact even when the WO consumes 50+ serials.
      // When any line is still pending, drop back to one row per
      // pickitem so the operator can select per-part.
      var allReadOnly = fs.serialLines.every(function (l) { return l.readOnly; });
      var totalSerials = fs.serialLines.reduce(function (s, l) { return s + l.candidates.length; }, 0);
      var partCount = fs.serialLines.length;
      if (allReadOnly) {
        return '<div class="finish-serial-lines">' +
          '<div class="fsl-title">Source serial numbers</div>' +
          '<div class="fsl-row">' +
            '<div class="fsl-part">' +
              '<strong>' + partCount + ' serialised part' + (partCount === 1 ? '' : 's') + '</strong>' +
              ' <span class="muted">· ' + totalSerials + ' serial' + (totalSerials === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' committed by Fishbowl</span>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<span class="fsl-count ok">Ready</span>' +
            '<button type="button" class="ds-btn" onclick="openSerialModalAll(' + woId + ')">View all serials</button>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>';
      }
      // Mixed / pending — per-pickitem rows so each part can be
      // selected independently.
      var rows = fs.serialLines.map(function (line) {
        var sel = fs.serialSelection[line.pickitemId] || [];
        var selCount = line.readOnly ? line.candidates.length : sel.length;
        var required = line.required || 0;
        var countCls = selCount === 0 ? 'fail'
                     : (required && selCount === required) ? 'ok'
                     : 'warn';
        var countText = line.readOnly
          ? selCount + ' committed'
          : selCount + ' of ' + required + ' selected';
        var btnLabel = line.readOnly ? 'View serials' : 'Select serials';
        return '<div class="fsl-row">' +
          '<div class="fsl-part">' +
            '<strong>' + esc(line.partNum) + '</strong>' +
            (line.partDesc ? ' <span class="muted">· ' + esc(line.partDesc) + '</span>' : '') +
          '</div>' +
          '<span class="fsl-count ' + countCls + '">' + countText + '</span>' +
          '<button type="button" class="ds-btn" ' +
            'onclick="openSerialModal(' + woId + ',' + line.pickitemId + ')">' +
            btnLabel +
          '</button>' +
        '</div>';
      }).join('');
      return '<div class="finish-serial-lines">' +
        '<div class="fsl-title">Source serial numbers</div>' +
        rows +
      '</div>';
    }

    // Flattens fs.serialSelection (per-pickitem arrays) into one Set
    // of serialKey strings, which is what Finisher.prepareFinish +
    // allocateSerialized both consume.
    function collectSelectedSerialKeys(fs) {
      var out = new Set();
      var sel = fs && fs.serialSelection || {};
      Object.keys(sel).forEach(function (pid) {
        (sel[pid] || []).forEach(function (k) { out.add(k); });
      });
      return out;
    }

    // Called after a fresh preview: prune serial selections whose
    // keys are no longer in the candidate pool (source stock moved,
    // committed elsewhere, or otherwise changed). Skips read-only
    // lines — those are always kept in sync with the pick's tracking.
    function reconcileSerialSelection(fs) {
      if (!fs || !fs.serialLines) return;
      var next = {};
      fs.serialLines.forEach(function (line) {
        if (line.readOnly) {
          // For committed / finished pickitems, "selection" mirrors
          // the pick's already-assigned serials — we keep them as
          // display only and never touch fs.serialSelection.
          return;
        }
        var candKeys = new Set(line.candidates.map(function (c) { return c.key; }));
        var prior = fs.serialSelection[line.pickitemId] || [];
        var pruned = prior.filter(function (k) { return candKeys.has(k); });
        if (pruned.length) next[line.pickitemId] = pruned;
      });
      fs.serialSelection = next;
    }

    // ============================================================
    // SERIAL-SELECTION MODAL
    // ============================================================
    // Supports four selection gestures:
    //   • Plain click       → toggle just that serial
    //   • Ctrl / ⌘ + click  → toggle without disturbing others
    //   • Shift + click     → range-select from the last-clicked idx
    //   • Mouse drag        → apply "add" or "remove" (based on the
    //                         first item's post-click state) to every
    //                         serial the pointer sweeps across
    // Read-only mode (committed pickitem) disables all of the above.
    var _serialDrag = null;

    window.openSerialModal = function (woId, pickitemId) {
      var fs = state.finishState[woId];
      if (!fs) return;
      var line = (fs.serialLines || []).find(function (l) {
        return l.pickitemId === Number(pickitemId);
      });
      if (!line) return;
      var readOnly = !!line.readOnly;
      var candidates = (line.candidates || []).slice();
      // Preserve the incoming order — for pending items this is FIFO
      // by tag_datecreated (from the stock query); for committed
      // items it's the order Fishbowl returned them.
      var filter = '';
      var lastClickIdx = -1;
      // Selection state: for read-only, everything is "selected" for
      // display. For editable, start with what's stored in fs.
      var selected = new Set(
        readOnly
          ? candidates.map(function (c) { return c.key; })
          : (fs.serialSelection[pickitemId] || [])
      );

      // Build DOM
      var backdrop = document.createElement('div');
      backdrop.className = 'serial-modal-backdrop';
      backdrop.innerHTML =
        '<div class="serial-modal">' +
          '<div class="serial-modal-head">' +
            '<div>' +
              '<h3>' + (readOnly ? 'Committed serials' : 'Select serials') + ' — ' + esc(line.partNum) + '</h3>' +
              '<div class="sm-sub">' +
                (readOnly
                  ? candidates.length + ' serial' + (candidates.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' committed by Fishbowl'
                  : 'Need ' + line.required + ' serial' + (line.required === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' — available in this location group') +
              '</div>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<button type="button" class="serial-modal-close" aria-label="Close">×</button>' +
          '</div>' +
          (readOnly
            ? ''
            : '<div class="serial-modal-toolbar">' +
                '<input type="text" placeholder="Filter serial number…" />' +
                '<a data-act="all">Select all</a>' +
                '<span class="sep">·</span>' +
                '<a data-act="clear">Clear</a>' +
                '<span class="sep">·</span>' +
                '<a data-act="first-n">Select first ' + line.required + '</a>' +
              '</div>') +
          '<div class="serial-modal-list"></div>' +
          '<div class="serial-modal-foot">' +
            '<span class="sm-count"></span>' +
            '<div class="sm-actions">' +
              (readOnly
                ? '<button type="button" class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary" data-act="close">Close</button>'
                : '<button type="button" class="ds-btn" data-act="cancel">Cancel</button>' +
                  '<button type="button" class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary" data-act="apply">Apply</button>') +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>';
      document.body.appendChild(backdrop);

      var listEl = backdrop.querySelector('.serial-modal-list');
      var countEl = backdrop.querySelector('.sm-count');
      var filterEl = backdrop.querySelector('input[type=text]');

      function filteredIdxMap() {
        // Map from display-position (idx in filtered list) to
        // absolute candidate index — needed for shift-range logic
        // that spans across filter changes.
        var f = filter.trim().toLowerCase();
        var out = [];
        candidates.forEach(function (c, i) {
          if (!f || c.serialNum.toLowerCase().indexOf(f) !== -1) out.push(i);
        });
        return out;
      }

      function updateCount() {
        if (readOnly) {
          countEl.textContent = candidates.length + ' committed';
          countEl.className = 'sm-count ok';
          return;
        }
        var n = selected.size, need = line.required || 0;
        countEl.textContent = n + ' / ' + need + ' selected';
        countEl.className = 'sm-count ' + (n === 0 ? 'fail' : (n === need ? 'ok' : 'warn'));
      }

      function renderList() {
        var idxs = filteredIdxMap();
        if (!idxs.length) {
          listEl.innerHTML = '<div class="serial-modal-empty">No serials match.</div>';
          updateCount();
          return;
        }
        listEl.innerHTML = idxs.map(function (absIdx) {
          var c = candidates[absIdx];
          var isSel = selected.has(c.key);
          var meta = [];
          if (c.tagNum) meta.push('Tag ' + c.tagNum);
          else if (c.tagId) meta.push('Tag #' + c.tagId);
          if (c.tagDateCreated) meta.push(esc(fmtDate(c.tagDateCreated)));
          return '<div class="serial-modal-item' +
                    (isSel ? ' selected' : '') +
                    (readOnly ? ' readonly' : '') +
                  '" data-abs-idx="' + absIdx + '" data-key="' + esc(c.key) + '">' +
                    '<input type="checkbox"' + (isSel ? ' checked' : '') + (readOnly ? ' disabled' : '') + '>' +
                    '<span class="sn">' + esc(c.serialNum) + '</span>' +
                    '<span class="sn-meta">' + meta.join(' · ') + '</span>' +
                  '</div>';
        }).join('');
        updateCount();
      }

      function close() {
        if (backdrop.parentNode) backdrop.parentNode.removeChild(backdrop);
        document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
        document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
        _serialDrag = null;
      }
      function apply() {
        if (readOnly) { close(); return; }
        fs.serialSelection[pickitemId] = Array.from(selected);
        close();
        // Re-run preflight so allocateSerialized picks up the new
        // selection — banner + fsl-row counts refresh through that.
        fs.preflightRun = false;
        runPreflightIfEligible(woId);
        // Also refresh the source-serials panel in place so the
        // "N of M selected" count updates before preflight settles.
        var host = document.getElementById('subDetail-' + woId);
        if (host) {
          var oldPanel = host.querySelector('.finish-serial-lines');
          if (oldPanel) {
            var tmp = document.createElement('div');
            tmp.innerHTML = renderSourceSerialsPanel(woId);
            var newPanel = tmp.firstElementChild;
            if (newPanel) oldPanel.parentNode.replaceChild(newPanel, oldPanel);
          }
        }
      }

      // Selection handlers ---------------------------------------
      function toggleKey(key) {
        if (selected.has(key)) selected.delete(key); else selected.add(key);
      }
      function setRange(fromAbsIdx, toAbsIdx, add) {
        var lo = Math.min(fromAbsIdx, toAbsIdx), hi = Math.max(fromAbsIdx, toAbsIdx);
        // Range applies to the FILTERED view — walk absolute indices
        // that are also in the current filter.
        var idxs = filteredIdxMap();
        idxs.forEach(function (absIdx) {
          if (absIdx < lo || absIdx > hi) return;
          if (add) selected.add(candidates[absIdx].key);
          else selected.delete(candidates[absIdx].key);
        });
      }

      listEl.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) {
        if (readOnly) return;
        var item = e.target.closest('.serial-modal-item');
        if (!item) return;
        e.preventDefault();  // don't start a text selection
        var absIdx = parseInt(item.dataset.absIdx, 10);
        var key = item.dataset.key;
        if (e.shiftKey && lastClickIdx >= 0) {
          // Shift-range — add every serial between lastClickIdx and
          // absIdx (inclusive) to the selection.
          setRange(lastClickIdx, absIdx, true);
          lastClickIdx = absIdx;
          renderList();
          return;
        }
        if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) {
          toggleKey(key);
          lastClickIdx = absIdx;
          renderList();
          return;
        }
        // Plain click — toggle just this one AND arm the drag so
        // subsequent mouseover events extend the same operation.
        var willBeSelected = !selected.has(key);
        toggleKey(key);
        lastClickIdx = absIdx;
        _serialDrag = {
          listEl: listEl,
          mode: willBeSelected ? 'add' : 'remove',
          touched: new Set([key]),
          startAbsIdx: absIdx,
        };
        renderList();
      });

      listEl.addEventListener('mouseover', function (e) {
        if (!_serialDrag || _serialDrag.listEl !== listEl) return;
        var item = e.target.closest('.serial-modal-item');
        if (!item) return;
        var absIdx = parseInt(item.dataset.absIdx, 10);
        // Sweep everything between the drag's start and the current
        // pointer — set them all to the drag mode. Un-touching a
        // previous one (via reverse drag) reverts it. This mirrors
        // desktop-app drag-select behaviour.
        var lo = Math.min(_serialDrag.startAbsIdx, absIdx);
        var hi = Math.max(_serialDrag.startAbsIdx, absIdx);
        var idxs = filteredIdxMap();
        var inRange = new Set();
        idxs.forEach(function (i) { if (i >= lo && i <= hi) inRange.add(i); });
        // For items in range: apply mode. For items previously touched
        // but no longer in range: revert.
        var mode = _serialDrag.mode;
        candidates.forEach(function (c, i) {
          if (_serialDrag.touched.has(c.key) && !inRange.has(i)) {
            // Revert (opposite of mode)
            if (mode === 'add') selected.delete(c.key);
            else selected.add(c.key);
            _serialDrag.touched.delete(c.key);
          }
        });
        idxs.forEach(function (i) {
          if (i < lo || i > hi) return;
          var c = candidates[i];
          if (_serialDrag.touched.has(c.key)) return;
          _serialDrag.touched.add(c.key);
          if (mode === 'add') selected.add(c.key);
          else selected.delete(c.key);
        });
        renderList();
      });

      // End the drag on ANY mouseup, wherever it lands.
      var onMouseUp = function () { _serialDrag = null; };
      document.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp, { once: false });

      // Toolbar
      backdrop.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        var a = e.target.closest('[data-act]');
        if (!a) return;
        var act = a.dataset.act;
        if (act === 'close' || act === 'cancel') { close(); return; }
        if (act === 'apply')  { apply(); return; }
        if (readOnly) return;
        if (act === 'all')    { candidates.forEach(function (c) { selected.add(c.key); }); renderList(); return; }
        if (act === 'clear')  { selected.clear(); renderList(); return; }
        if (act === 'first-n') {
          selected.clear();
          for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length && selected.size < line.required; i++) {
            selected.add(candidates[i].key);
          }
          renderList();
          return;
        }
      });
      backdrop.querySelector('.serial-modal-close').addEventListener('click', close);
      backdrop.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target === backdrop) close();  // click on backdrop
      });

      if (filterEl) {
        filterEl.addEventListener('input', function () {
          filter = filterEl.value || '';
          renderList();
        });
      }

      function onKey(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') close();
        if ((e.key === 'Enter') && !readOnly && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) apply();
      }
      document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);

      renderList();
    };

    // Combined viewer — opens a single modal listing every committed
    // serial across the WO's serialized pickitems, with a Part column
    // so the operator can see which serial belongs to which part.
    // Purely read-only; no selection UI, no drag handlers. Used when
    // ALL serialLines are readOnly (fully-committed pick) to keep the
    // sub-detail compact instead of rendering N per-part rows.
    window.openSerialModalAll = function (woId) {
      var fs = state.finishState[woId];
      if (!fs || !fs.serialLines || !fs.serialLines.length) return;
      // Flatten every candidate + tag its source part so the modal
      // row can show Part / Serial / Tag columns in one list.
      var all = [];
      fs.serialLines.forEach(function (line) {
        line.candidates.forEach(function (c) {
          all.push({
            partNum: line.partNum, partDesc: line.partDesc,
            serialNum: c.serialNum,
            tagId: c.tagId, tagNum: c.tagNum,
            tagDateCreated: c.tagDateCreated,
          });
        });
      });
      var partCount = fs.serialLines.length;
      var filter = '';

      var backdrop = document.createElement('div');
      backdrop.className = 'serial-modal-backdrop';
      backdrop.innerHTML =
        '<div class="serial-modal">' +
          '<div class="serial-modal-head">' +
            '<div>' +
              '<h3>Committed source serials</h3>' +
              '<div class="sm-sub">' +
                all.length + ' serial' + (all.length === 1 ? '' : 's') +
                ' across ' + partCount + ' part' + (partCount === 1 ? '' : 's') +
              '</div>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<button type="button" class="serial-modal-close" aria-label="Close">×</button>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="serial-modal-toolbar">' +
            '<input type="text" placeholder="Filter by serial or part…" />' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="serial-modal-list"></div>' +
          '<div class="serial-modal-foot">' +
            '<span class="sm-count ok">' + all.length + ' committed</span>' +
            '<div class="sm-actions">' +
              '<button type="button" class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary" data-act="close">Close</button>' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>';
      document.body.appendChild(backdrop);

      var listEl = backdrop.querySelector('.serial-modal-list');
      var filterEl = backdrop.querySelector('input[type=text]');

      function renderList() {
        var f = filter.trim().toLowerCase();
        var filtered = f
          ? all.filter(function (c) {
              return c.serialNum.toLowerCase().indexOf(f) !== -1 ||
                     c.partNum.toLowerCase().indexOf(f) !== -1;
            })
          : all;
        if (!filtered.length) {
          listEl.innerHTML = '<div class="serial-modal-empty">No serials match.</div>';
          return;
        }
        // Group by part so multi-part views stay readable.
        var byPart = {};
        var partOrder = [];
        filtered.forEach(function (c) {
          if (!byPart[c.partNum]) { byPart[c.partNum] = []; partOrder.push(c.partNum); }
          byPart[c.partNum].push(c);
        });
        listEl.innerHTML = partOrder.map(function (pn) {
          var items = byPart[pn];
          var head = '<div class="serial-modal-group-head">' +
                       '<strong>' + esc(pn) + '</strong>' +
                       ' <span class="muted">· ' + items.length + ' serial' + (items.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + '</span>' +
                     '</div>';
          var rows = items.map(function (c) {
            var meta = [];
            if (c.tagNum) meta.push('Tag ' + c.tagNum);
            else if (c.tagId) meta.push('Tag #' + c.tagId);
            return '<div class="serial-modal-item readonly selected">' +
              '<input type="checkbox" checked disabled>' +
              '<span class="sn">' + esc(c.serialNum) + '</span>' +
              '<span class="sn-meta">' + meta.join(' · ') + '</span>' +
            '</div>';
          }).join('');
          return head + rows;
        }).join('');
      }

      function close() {
        if (backdrop.parentNode) backdrop.parentNode.removeChild(backdrop);
        document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      }
      backdrop.querySelector('.serial-modal-close').addEventListener('click', close);
      backdrop.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target === backdrop) close();
        var a = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-act]');
        if (a && a.dataset.act === 'close') close();
      });
      filterEl.addEventListener('input', function () {
        filter = filterEl.value || '';
        renderList();
      });
      function onKey(e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') close(); }
      document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);

      renderList();
    };

    // ============================================================
    // SCRAP-TRACKING SELECTION MODAL
    // ============================================================
    // For lot-tracked raw materials, the operator picks which
    // tags (and how much per tag) to scrap. For serial-tracked
    // raw materials, they pick specific serial numbers. Selection
    // is stored on line.scrapSelection; buildScrapPlan reads it
    // and skips FIFO auto-allocation when present.
    //
    // Shape stored on line.scrapSelection:
    //   Lot-tracked:
    //     { kind: 'lot',
    //       locId, lgName, locName,
    //       totalQty,
    //       tags: [{tagId, tagNum, qty, fields:[{name,abbr,info,ptid}]}, ...] }
    //   Serial-tracked:
    //     { kind: 'serial',
    //       locId, lgName, locName,
    //       totalQty,
    //       tagsBySig: [{ sig, qty, fields:[...], serialFields:[...],
    //                     serials:[{sid, vals:[{ptid,name,abbr,value}]}] }, ...] }
    // ============================================================
    window.openScrapTrackingModal = function (woId, idx) {
      var fs = state.finishState[woId];
      var wo = findWoById(woId);
      if (!fs || !wo) return;
      var line = fs.lines[idx];
      if (!line || !line.hasTracking) return;
      var scrapQty = parseFloat(line.scrappedInput) || 0;
      if (scrapQty <= 0) return;

      var backdrop = document.createElement('div');
      backdrop.className = 'serial-modal-backdrop';
      backdrop.innerHTML =
        '<div class="serial-modal" style="width:min(720px,96vw);max-height:88vh;">' +
          '<div class="serial-modal-head">' +
            '<div>' +
              '<h3>Select scrap tracking — ' + esc(line.partNum) + '</h3>' +
              '<div class="sm-sub">' +
                'Scrapping ' + fmtQty(scrapQty) + ' ' + esc(line.uom || '') +
                (line.isSerialTracked ? ' (' + Math.round(scrapQty) + ' serial' + (Math.round(scrapQty) === 1 ? '' : 's') + ')' : '') +
              '</div>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<button type="button" class="serial-modal-close" aria-label="Close">×</button>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="serial-modal-list" style="user-select:auto;padding:0;" id="stm-body"></div>' +
          '<div class="serial-modal-foot">' +
            '<span class="sm-count" id="stm-count">Loading…</span>' +
            '<div class="sm-actions">' +
              '<button type="button" class="ds-btn" data-act="cancel">Cancel</button>' +
              '<button type="button" class="ds-btn" data-act="fifo" title="Auto-allocate FIFO by tag age">Use FIFO</button>' +
              '<button type="button" class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary" data-act="apply">Apply</button>' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>';
      document.body.appendChild(backdrop);
      var body = backdrop.querySelector('#stm-body');
      var countEl = backdrop.querySelector('#stm-count');

      // Runtime state — populated once the location + tags load.
      var loc = null;
      var tagRows = [];    // per-tag: {tagId, tagNum, avail, fields}
      var serialRows = []; // per-serial (serial mode only): {sid, tagId, vals, lotFields, lotSig}
      var serialFields = [];
      var selectedTagQty = {};   // lot mode: tagId → qty
      var selectedSerials = new Set(); // serial mode: sid strings
      var filter = '';

      function totalSelected() {
        if (line.isSerialTracked) return selectedSerials.size;
        var t = 0;
        Object.keys(selectedTagQty).forEach(function (k) {
          t += parseFloat(selectedTagQty[k]) || 0;
        });
        return Number(t.toFixed(6));
      }

      function updateFoot() {
        var t = totalSelected();
        var target = line.isSerialTracked ? Math.round(scrapQty) : scrapQty;
        var cls = Math.abs(t - target) < 1e-6 ? 'ok'
                : t === 0                     ? 'fail'
                                              : 'warn';
        countEl.className = 'sm-count ' + cls;
        countEl.textContent = fmtQty(t) + ' / ' + fmtQty(target) + ' selected';
      }

      // ── Load location + tags/serials ──────────────────────────
      body.innerHTML = '<div class="serial-modal-empty">Resolving scrap location…</div>';
      var lgId = wo && wo.moLgId ? parseInt(wo.moLgId, 10) : 0;
      resolveScrapLocation(line, lgId, scrapQty).then(function (resolved) {
        if (!resolved || !resolved.locId) {
          body.innerHTML = '<div class="serial-modal-empty">' +
            'No location in ' + esc(wo && wo.moLgName || 'this LG') +
            ' has ' + fmtQty(scrapQty) + ' available to scrap.' +
          '</div>';
          countEl.textContent = 'No location';
          countEl.className = 'sm-count fail';
          return;
        }
        loc = resolved;
        // Reuse the existing allocator to get the same shape data,
        // but with the FULL location's stock (not just what covers
        // qtyNeeded) — pass a very large qtyNeeded so it returns
        // everything available and lets the operator choose.
        var lookupQty = Math.max(scrapQty * 1000, 1e6);
        return allocateScrapTags(line.partId, loc.locId, lookupQty, !!line.isSerialTracked)
          .then(function (alloc) {
            if (line.isSerialTracked) buildSerialRows(alloc);
            else                       buildLotRows(alloc);
            // Restore prior selection if the operator had made one
            // for the same location + qty.
            var prior = line.scrapSelection;
            if (prior && prior.locId === loc.locId) restorePriorSelection(prior);
            renderBody();
          });
      }).catch(function (e) {
        body.innerHTML = '<div class="serial-modal-empty" style="color:#b91c1c;">' +
          esc('Failed to load scrap options: ' + (e && e.message || e)) +
        '</div>';
        countEl.textContent = 'Error';
        countEl.className = 'sm-count fail';
      });

      function buildLotRows(alloc) {
        // alloc.allocations = [{kind:'lot', tagId, tagNum, qty, fields}]
        tagRows = (alloc.allocations || []).map(function (a) {
          return {
            tagId: a.tagId,
            tagNum: a.tagNum || '',
            avail: parseFloat(a.qty) || 0,   // note: allocator caps at qtyNeeded
            fields: (a.fields || []).slice(),
          };
        });
        // Since we passed an inflated lookupQty, allocator's per-tag
        // qty already equals each tag's full available qty (it never
        // hit the "remaining" break). Good enough.
      }

      function buildSerialRows(alloc) {
        // alloc.allocations = [{kind:'serial-group', qty, fields, serialFields, serials}]
        var sf = null;
        (alloc.allocations || []).forEach(function (g) {
          if (!sf && g.serialFields && g.serialFields.length) sf = g.serialFields;
          (g.serials || []).forEach(function (u) {
            serialRows.push({
              sid: u.sid,
              vals: u.vals || [],
              lotFields: g.fields || [],
              lotSig: (g.fields || []).map(function (f) { return f.ptid + '=' + (f.info || ''); }).join('|'),
            });
          });
        });
        serialFields = sf || [];
      }

      function restorePriorSelection(prior) {
        if (prior.kind === 'lot' && !line.isSerialTracked) {
          (prior.tags || []).forEach(function (t) {
            selectedTagQty[t.tagId] = t.qty;
          });
        } else if (prior.kind === 'serial' && line.isSerialTracked) {
          (prior.tagsBySig || []).forEach(function (g) {
            (g.serials || []).forEach(function (u) {
