              selectedSerials.add(String(u.sid));
            });
          });
        }
      }

      // ── DOM renderers ────────────────────────────────────────
      function renderBody() {
        if (line.isSerialTracked) renderSerialBody();
        else                       renderLotBody();
        updateFoot();
      }

      function fieldsHtml(fields) {
        if (!fields || !fields.length) return '';
        return '<span class="sn-meta">' +
          fields.map(function (f) {
            return esc((f.abbr || f.name) + ': ' + (f.info == null ? '' : f.info));
          }).join(' · ') +
        '</span>';
      }

      function renderLotBody() {
        if (!tagRows.length) {
          body.innerHTML = '<div class="serial-modal-empty">' +
            'No stock at ' + esc(loc.lgName + '-' + loc.locName) + '.' +
          '</div>';
          return;
        }
        var head =
          '<div class="serial-modal-toolbar" style="border-top:1px solid #f1f5f9;">' +
            '<span class="muted" style="font-size:11px;">' +
              esc(loc.source === 'default' ? 'Default location: ' : 'Fallback: ') +
              esc(loc.lgName + '-' + loc.locName) +
              ' · ' + tagRows.length + ' tag' + (tagRows.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' available' +
            '</span>' +
            '<a data-act="autofill">Auto-fill FIFO ' + fmtQty(scrapQty) + '</a>' +
            '<span class="sep">·</span>' +
            '<a data-act="clear">Clear</a>' +
          '</div>';
        var rows = tagRows.map(function (t) {
          var cur = selectedTagQty[t.tagId] != null ? selectedTagQty[t.tagId] : 0;
          return '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:6px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid #f3f4f6;">' +
            '<div style="flex:1;min-width:0;">' +
              '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#1e293b;">' +
                (t.tagNum ? '<strong>Tag ' + esc(t.tagNum) + '</strong>' :
                            '<strong>Tag #' + t.tagId + '</strong>') +
                ' <span class="muted">· ' + fmtQty(t.avail) + ' available</span>' +
              '</div>' +
              '<div style="margin-top:2px;">' + fieldsHtml(t.fields) + '</div>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<input type="number" step="0.001" min="0" max="' + t.avail + '" ' +
              'data-tag-id="' + t.tagId + '" ' +
              'value="' + (cur || '') + '" ' +
              'placeholder="0" ' +
              'style="width:90px;height:28px;padding:2px 6px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:5px;' +
                'font-family:inherit;font-size:12px;text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;" />' +
          '</div>';
        }).join('');
        body.innerHTML = head + rows;
      }

      function renderSerialBody() {
        if (!serialRows.length) {
          body.innerHTML = '<div class="serial-modal-empty">' +
            'No uncommitted serials at ' + esc(loc.lgName + '-' + loc.locName) + '.' +
          '</div>';
          return;
        }
        var f = filter.trim().toLowerCase();
        var rows = serialRows.filter(function (r) {
          if (!f) return true;
          var hay = (r.vals || []).map(function (v) { return v.value || ''; }).join(' ').toLowerCase();
          return hay.indexOf(f) !== -1;
        });
        var head =
          '<div class="serial-modal-toolbar" style="border-top:1px solid #f1f5f9;">' +
            '<input type="text" id="stm-filter" placeholder="Filter serial…" ' +
              'value="' + esc(filter) + '" />' +
            '<a data-act="first-n">First ' + Math.round(scrapQty) + '</a>' +
            '<span class="sep">·</span>' +
            '<a data-act="clear">Clear</a>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="muted" style="padding:4px 16px;font-size:11px;">' +
            esc(loc.source === 'default' ? 'Default location: ' : 'Fallback: ') +
            esc(loc.lgName + '-' + loc.locName) +
            ' · ' + serialRows.length + ' serial' + (serialRows.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' available' +
          '</div>';
        if (!rows.length) {
          body.innerHTML = head + '<div class="serial-modal-empty">No serials match.</div>';
          return;
        }
        var items = rows.map(function (r) {
          var isSel = selectedSerials.has(String(r.sid));
          var serialText = (r.vals || []).map(function (v) { return v.value; }).filter(Boolean).join(' / ');
          return '<div class="serial-modal-item' + (isSel ? ' selected' : '') +
            '" data-sid="' + r.sid + '">' +
            '<input type="checkbox"' + (isSel ? ' checked' : '') + '>' +
            '<span class="sn">' + esc(serialText) + '</span>' +
            fieldsHtml(r.lotFields) +
          '</div>';
        }).join('');
        body.innerHTML = head + items;
      }

      // ── Event delegation ─────────────────────────────────────
      backdrop.addEventListener('input', function (e) {
        var el = e.target;
        // Lot mode: qty inputs per tag.
        if (el.tagName === 'INPUT' && el.dataset && el.dataset.tagId) {
          var v = parseFloat(el.value);
          if (!Number.isFinite(v) || v < 0) v = 0;
          var max = parseFloat(el.max) || 0;
          if (v > max) { v = max; el.value = v; }
          selectedTagQty[el.dataset.tagId] = v;
          updateFoot();
          return;
        }
        // Serial mode: filter input.
        if (el.id === 'stm-filter') {
          filter = el.value || '';
          renderSerialBody();
          // Restore focus + caret to the filter input.
          var f2 = document.getElementById('stm-filter');
          if (f2) { f2.focus(); f2.setSelectionRange(filter.length, filter.length); }
        }
      });
      backdrop.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        // Serial-item toggle.
        var item = e.target.closest('.serial-modal-item');
        if (item && line.isSerialTracked) {
          var sid = item.dataset.sid;
          if (selectedSerials.has(sid)) selectedSerials.delete(sid);
          else selectedSerials.add(sid);
          item.classList.toggle('selected');
          var cb = item.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]');
          if (cb) cb.checked = selectedSerials.has(sid);
          updateFoot();
          return;
        }
        // Toolbar actions.
        var a = e.target.closest('[data-act]');
        if (!a) {
          if (e.target === backdrop) close();
          return;
        }
        var act = a.dataset.act;
        if (act === 'cancel') { close(); return; }
        if (act === 'apply')  { apply();  return; }
        if (act === 'fifo')   { applyFifo(); return; }
        if (act === 'clear') {
          if (line.isSerialTracked) { selectedSerials.clear(); renderSerialBody(); }
          else                       { selectedTagQty = {}; renderLotBody(); }
          updateFoot();
          return;
        }
        if (act === 'first-n' && line.isSerialTracked) {
          selectedSerials.clear();
          var need = Math.round(scrapQty);
          for (var i = 0; i < serialRows.length && selectedSerials.size < need; i++) {
            selectedSerials.add(String(serialRows[i].sid));
          }
          renderSerialBody();
          updateFoot();
          return;
        }
        if (act === 'autofill' && !line.isSerialTracked) {
          // FIFO across tags — allocator returned tagRows already
          // in FIFO order (tag date created ascending).
          selectedTagQty = {};
          var remaining = scrapQty;
          for (var j = 0; j < tagRows.length && remaining > 1e-9; j++) {
            var t = tagRows[j];
            var take = Math.min(t.avail, remaining);
            if (take > 1e-9) {
              selectedTagQty[t.tagId] = Number(take.toFixed(6));
              remaining -= take;
            }
          }
          renderLotBody();
          updateFoot();
          return;
        }
      });

      function applyFifo() {
        // Clear the manual selection so buildScrapPlan falls back to
        // its FIFO auto-allocation. Same as clicking Cancel except we
        // also blow away the prior stored selection.
        line.scrapSelection = null;
        close();
        refreshScrapHint(woId, idx);
        recheckFinishReadiness(woId);
      }
      function apply() {
        var t = totalSelected();
        var target = line.isSerialTracked ? Math.round(scrapQty) : scrapQty;
        if (Math.abs(t - target) > 1e-6) {
          alert('Selected total (' + fmtQty(t) + ') must equal scrap qty (' + fmtQty(target) + ').');
          return;
        }
        if (line.isSerialTracked) {
          // Group by lot signature so buildScrapPlan can emit one CSV
          // row per lot group + its serial rows.
          var groupsBySig = {};
          var sigOrder = [];
          serialRows.forEach(function (r) {
            if (!selectedSerials.has(String(r.sid))) return;
            if (!groupsBySig[r.lotSig]) {
              groupsBySig[r.lotSig] = {
                sig: r.lotSig,
                qty: 0,
                fields: r.lotFields.slice(),
                serialFields: serialFields.slice(),
                serials: [],
              };
              sigOrder.push(r.lotSig);
            }
            groupsBySig[r.lotSig].serials.push({ sid: r.sid, vals: r.vals });
            groupsBySig[r.lotSig].qty++;
          });
          line.scrapSelection = {
            kind: 'serial',
            locId: loc.locId, lgName: loc.lgName, locName: loc.locName,
            totalQty: t,
            tagsBySig: sigOrder.map(function (s) { return groupsBySig[s]; }),
          };
        } else {
          var tags = [];
          tagRows.forEach(function (tr) {
            var q = selectedTagQty[tr.tagId];
            if (!q || q <= 1e-9) return;
            tags.push({
              tagId: tr.tagId, tagNum: tr.tagNum,
              qty: Number(q),
              fields: tr.fields.slice(),
            });
          });
          line.scrapSelection = {
            kind: 'lot',
            locId: loc.locId, lgName: loc.lgName, locName: loc.locName,
            totalQty: t,
            tags: tags,
          };
        }
        close();
        refreshScrapHint(woId, idx);
        recheckFinishReadiness(woId);
      }
      function close() {
        if (backdrop.parentNode) backdrop.parentNode.removeChild(backdrop);
        document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      }
      function onKey(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') close();
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) apply();
      }
      document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      backdrop.querySelector('.serial-modal-close').addEventListener('click', close);
    };

    // ============================================================
    // FG-TRACKING EDITOR MODAL — legacy openFgSerialModal alias
    // ============================================================
    // Kept as an alias so any residual UI reference (older cached
    // renders, external callers) still opens the new consolidated
    // modal below.
    window.openFgSerialModal = function (woId) { window.openFgTrackingModal(woId); };

    // Consolidated FG-tracking editor. One modal, one Apply. Renders
    // one section per parttracking def on the FG part:
    //   • Mandatory (nextValue-driven) — value shown read-only with
    //     a lock note explaining why. Cannot be edited.
    //   • Serial def without nextValue — three input paths inside
    //     one section: raws picker (when picked source serials exist),
    //     auto-generate seed + count, and a freeform textarea that
    //     also accepts pasted CSV and dropped .txt/.csv files.
    //   • Text / date def without nextValue — simple input plus a
    //     "Use suggestion" button showing the derived default.
    //
    // Apply commits every section back to fs.fg.defs[] and re-runs
    // preflight so allocations pick up any raw-serial choices.
    window.openFgTrackingModal = function (woId) {
      var fs = state.finishState[woId];
      var wo = findWoById(woId);
      if (!fs || !wo || !fs.fg || !fs.fg.defs || !fs.fg.defs.length) return;
      var fgQty = fs.fg.fgQty || 0;
      var needN = Math.round(fgQty);
      var partNum = (wo.outputs && wo.outputs[0] && wo.outputs[0].partNum) || wo.parentPartNum || '';

      // Flatten every source serial across every serial-tracked raw
      // that's been committed/picked. Shared across FG serial defs
      // so operators can pull the same raw serial into multiple FG
      // defs if that's genuinely what's wanted (rare, but possible).
      var rawCandidates = [];
      (fs.serialLines || []).forEach(function (line) {
        (line.candidates || []).forEach(function (c) {
          rawCandidates.push({
            partNum: line.partNum,
            partDesc: line.partDesc,
            serialNum: c.serialNum,
            key: line.pickitemId + '::' + c.serialNum,
          });
        });
      });

      // Per-section local editing state, keyed by partTrackingId.
      //   - Text/date defs: { value }
      //   - Serial defs:    { serialsText, rawSelected, rawFilter,
      //                       rawLastIdx, rawDrag, showRaws }
      //   - Mandatory defs: nothing to edit, but we still key them
      //                     so the sections render.
      var editors = {};
      fs.fg.defs.forEach(function (def) {
        if (def.mandatory) { editors[def.partTrackingId] = {}; return; }
        if (def.isSerial) {
          editors[def.partTrackingId] = {
            serialsText: def.serialsText || (Array.isArray(def.value) ? def.value.join('\n') : ''),
            rawSelected: new Set(),
            rawFilter: '',
            rawLastIdx: -1,
            rawDrag: null,
            showRaws: false,
          };
        } else {
          editors[def.partTrackingId] = {
            value: def.value == null ? '' : String(def.value),
          };
        }
      });

      var backdrop = document.createElement('div');
      backdrop.className = 'serial-modal-backdrop';
      backdrop.innerHTML =
        '<div class="serial-modal" style="width:min(760px,96vw);max-height:90vh;">' +
          '<div class="serial-modal-head">' +
            '<div>' +
              '<h3>Finished-good tracking — ' + esc(partNum) + '</h3>' +
              '<div class="sm-sub">' + fs.fg.defs.length + ' tracking field' +
                (fs.fg.defs.length === 1 ? '' : 's') +
                ' · WO ' + esc(wo.num) + ' · qty ' + fmtQty(fgQty) + '</div>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<button type="button" class="serial-modal-close" aria-label="Close">×</button>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="serial-modal-list" style="user-select:auto;padding:12px 16px;" id="fg-tm-body"></div>' +
          '<div class="serial-modal-foot">' +
            '<span class="sm-count"></span>' +
            '<div class="sm-actions">' +
              '<button type="button" class="ds-btn" data-act="cancel">Cancel</button>' +
              '<button type="button" class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary" data-act="apply">Apply all</button>' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>';
      document.body.appendChild(backdrop);
      var body    = backdrop.querySelector('#fg-tm-body');
      var footCount = backdrop.querySelector('.sm-count');

      // ── Section renderers ────────────────────────────────────
      function sectionHead(def, extra) {
        var status;
        if (def.mandatory) status = '<span class="muted">Locked · Fishbowl nextValue</span>';
        else if (def.isSerial) status = '<span class="muted">Editable</span>';
        else status = '<span class="muted">Editable</span>';
        return '<div class="fg-tm-head" style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px;">' +
          '<strong>' + esc(def.name) + '</strong> ' + status +
          (extra || '') +
        '</div>';
      }

      function renderTextSection(def) {
        var ed = editors[def.partTrackingId];
        var val = def.mandatory ? (def.value == null ? '' : String(def.value)) : ed.value;
        var placeholder = def.mandatory ? '' :
          (def.suggestion ? 'Suggested: ' + def.suggestion : '');
        var attrs = def.mandatory
          ? 'readonly disabled style="background:#f1f5f9;color:#334155;"'
          : 'class="fg-tm-input" data-pt-id="' + def.partTrackingId + '"';
        var suggBtn = def.mandatory ? '' :
          '<button type="button" class="ds-btn" style="padding:3px 9px;font-size:11px;margin-left:6px;" ' +
            'data-act="use-sugg" data-pt-id="' + def.partTrackingId + '">Use suggestion</button>';
        var lock = def.mandatory
          ? '<div class="muted" style="font-size:10.5px;margin-top:4px;">nextValue = <code>' + esc(def.nextValue) + '</code></div>'
          : '';
        return '<div class="fg-tm-section" style="padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed #e2e8f0;" data-pt-id="' + def.partTrackingId + '">' +
          sectionHead(def) +
          '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;">' +
            '<input type="text" style="flex:1;height:30px;padding:4px 8px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:6px;font-family:inherit;font-size:12px;" ' +
              'value="' + esc(val) + '" placeholder="' + esc(placeholder) + '" ' + attrs + ' />' +
            suggBtn +
          '</div>' +
          lock +
        '</div>';
      }

      function renderDateSection(def) {
        var ed = editors[def.partTrackingId];
        var val = def.mandatory ? (def.value == null ? '' : String(def.value)) : ed.value;
        var attrs = def.mandatory
          ? 'readonly disabled style="background:#f1f5f9;color:#334155;"'
          : 'class="fg-tm-input" data-pt-id="' + def.partTrackingId + '"';
        var suggBtn = def.mandatory ? '' :
          '<button type="button" class="ds-btn" style="padding:3px 9px;font-size:11px;margin-left:6px;" ' +
            'data-act="use-sugg" data-pt-id="' + def.partTrackingId + '">Use suggestion (' + esc(def.suggestion || '') + ')</button>';
        var lock = def.mandatory
          ? '<div class="muted" style="font-size:10.5px;margin-top:4px;">nextValue = <code>' + esc(def.nextValue) + '</code> days from today</div>'
          : '';
        return '<div class="fg-tm-section" style="padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed #e2e8f0;" data-pt-id="' + def.partTrackingId + '">' +
          sectionHead(def) +
          '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;">' +
            '<input type="date" style="height:30px;padding:4px 8px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:6px;font-family:inherit;font-size:12px;" ' +
              'value="' + esc(val) + '" ' + attrs + ' />' +
            suggBtn +
          '</div>' +
          lock +
        '</div>';
      }

      function renderSerialSection(def) {
        var ed = editors[def.partTrackingId];
        var ptId = def.partTrackingId;
        if (def.mandatory) {
          var display = Array.isArray(def.value) ? def.value.join('\n') : '';
          return '<div class="fg-tm-section" style="padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed #e2e8f0;">' +
            sectionHead(def) +
            '<textarea class="finish-serial-textarea" readonly disabled style="background:#f1f5f9;color:#334155;">' +
              esc(display) +
            '</textarea>' +
            '<div class="muted" style="font-size:10.5px;margin-top:4px;">' +
              'Sequential serials from nextValue <code>' + esc(def.nextValue) + '</code>' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>';
        }
        var haveN = parseFgSerials(ed.serialsText).length;
        var countCls = (needN && haveN === needN) ? 'ok' : (haveN === 0 ? 'fail' : 'warn');
        var toolbar =
          '<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:6px;font-size:11px;">' +
            (rawCandidates.length
              ? '<button type="button" class="ds-btn" style="padding:3px 9px;font-size:11px;" data-act="toggle-raws" data-pt-id="' + ptId + '">' +
                  (ed.showRaws ? '▾ Hide picked raws' : '▸ Pick from raws (' + rawCandidates.length + ' available)') +
                '</button>'
              : '') +
            '<button type="button" class="ds-btn" style="padding:3px 9px;font-size:11px;" data-act="fill-wo" data-pt-id="' + ptId + '">' +
              'Fill from WO-num sequence' +
            '</button>' +
            '<button type="button" class="ds-btn" style="padding:3px 9px;font-size:11px;" data-act="clear-serial" data-pt-id="' + ptId + '">' +
              'Clear' +
            '</button>' +
            '<span style="margin-left:auto;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:' +
              (countCls === 'ok' ? '#047857' : countCls === 'fail' ? '#b91c1c' : '#b45309') + ';">' +
              haveN + ' / ' + needN + ' ready' +
            '</span>' +
          '</div>';
        var rawsHtml = '';
        if (ed.showRaws && rawCandidates.length) {
          rawsHtml =
            '<div class="fg-tm-raws" data-pt-id="' + ptId + '" style="border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;margin-bottom:6px;">' +
              '<div class="serial-modal-toolbar" style="padding:6px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9;">' +
                '<input type="text" placeholder="Filter serial or part…" class="fg-tm-rawfilter" data-pt-id="' + ptId + '" value="' + esc(ed.rawFilter) + '" style="flex:1;padding:4px 8px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;height:28px;" />' +
                '<a data-act="raw-first-n" data-pt-id="' + ptId + '">First ' + needN + '</a>' +
                '<span class="sep">·</span>' +
                '<a data-act="raw-all" data-pt-id="' + ptId + '">Select all</a>' +
                '<span class="sep">·</span>' +
                '<a data-act="raw-clear" data-pt-id="' + ptId + '">Clear</a>' +
              '</div>' +
              '<div class="fg-tm-rawlist" data-pt-id="' + ptId + '" style="max-height:200px;overflow-y:auto;user-select:none;"></div>' +
              '<div style="padding:6px 10px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;border-top:1px solid #f1f5f9;">' +
                '<span class="muted" style="font-size:11px;" id="fg-raw-selcount-' + ptId + '">' +
                  ed.rawSelected.size + ' of ' + rawCandidates.length + ' selected' +
                '</span>' +
                '<button type="button" class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary" style="padding:3px 10px;font-size:11px;" data-act="raw-use" data-pt-id="' + ptId + '">' +
                  'Use selected → textarea' +
                '</button>' +
              '</div>' +
            '</div>';
        }
        return '<div class="fg-tm-section" style="padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed #e2e8f0;">' +
          sectionHead(def) +
          toolbar +
          rawsHtml +
          '<textarea class="finish-serial-textarea fg-tm-serials" data-pt-id="' + ptId + '" ' +
            'placeholder="One serial per line — count must match qty">' +
            esc(ed.serialsText) +
          '</textarea>' +
          '<div class="drop-hint" style="font-size:10.5px;color:#64748b;margin-top:2px;">' +
            'Type, paste (newline- or comma-separated), or drop a .txt / .csv file.' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>';
      }

      function renderSection(def) {
        if (def.isSerial) return renderSerialSection(def);
        if (def.isDate)   return renderDateSection(def);
        return renderTextSection(def);
      }

      function renderAll() {
        body.innerHTML = fs.fg.defs.map(renderSection).join('');
        fs.fg.defs.forEach(function (def) {
          if (def.isSerial && !def.mandatory && editors[def.partTrackingId].showRaws) {
            renderRawList(def.partTrackingId);
          }
        });
        updateFootCount();
      }

      function updateFootCount() {
        // Aggregate confirmation status across all non-mandatory defs.
        var pending = 0, total = 0;
        fs.fg.defs.forEach(function (def) {
          if (def.mandatory) return;
          total++;
          var ed = editors[def.partTrackingId];
          var haveValue = def.isSerial
            ? parseFgSerials(ed.serialsText).length === needN
            : String(ed.value || '').length > 0;
          if (!haveValue) pending++;
        });
        if (total === 0) {
          footCount.textContent = 'All fields locked by Fishbowl';
          footCount.className = 'sm-count ok';
        } else if (pending === 0) {
          footCount.textContent = 'Ready to apply · ' + total + ' field' + (total === 1 ? '' : 's');
          footCount.className = 'sm-count ok';
        } else {
          footCount.textContent = pending + ' of ' + total + ' still pending';
          footCount.className = 'sm-count warn';
        }
      }

      // ── Raws picker per serial def ───────────────────────────
      function filteredRawIdxs(ed) {
        var f = ed.rawFilter.trim().toLowerCase();
        var out = [];
        rawCandidates.forEach(function (c, i) {
          if (!f ||
              c.serialNum.toLowerCase().indexOf(f) !== -1 ||
              (c.partNum || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(f) !== -1) out.push(i);
        });
        return out;
      }
      function renderRawList(ptId) {
        var ed = editors[ptId];
        var listEl = body.querySelector('.fg-tm-rawlist[data-pt-id="' + ptId + '"]');
        if (!listEl) return;
        var idxs = filteredRawIdxs(ed);
        if (idxs.length) {
          listEl.innerHTML = idxs.map(function (i) {
            var c = rawCandidates[i];
            var isSel = ed.rawSelected.has(c.key);
            return '<div class="serial-modal-item' + (isSel ? ' selected' : '') +
                   '" data-pt-id="' + ptId + '" data-idx="' + i + '">' +
                      '<input type="checkbox"' + (isSel ? ' checked' : '') + '>' +
                      '<span class="sn">' + esc(c.serialNum) + '</span>' +
                      '<span class="sn-meta">' + esc(c.partNum) + '</span>' +
                    '</div>';
          }).join('');
        } else {
          listEl.innerHTML = '<div class="serial-modal-empty">No serials match.</div>';
        }
        var selEl = body.querySelector('#fg-raw-selcount-' + ptId);
        if (selEl) selEl.textContent = ed.rawSelected.size + ' of ' + rawCandidates.length + ' selected';
      }
      function handleRawClick(ptId, idx, e) {
        var ed = editors[ptId];
        var key = rawCandidates[idx].key;
        if (e.shiftKey && ed.rawLastIdx >= 0) {
          var lo = Math.min(ed.rawLastIdx, idx), hi = Math.max(ed.rawLastIdx, idx);
          filteredRawIdxs(ed).forEach(function (i) {
            if (i >= lo && i <= hi) ed.rawSelected.add(rawCandidates[i].key);
          });
          ed.rawLastIdx = idx;
          renderRawList(ptId);
          return;
        }
        if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) {
          if (ed.rawSelected.has(key)) ed.rawSelected.delete(key); else ed.rawSelected.add(key);
          ed.rawLastIdx = idx;
          renderRawList(ptId);
          return;
        }
        var willBe = !ed.rawSelected.has(key);
        if (willBe) ed.rawSelected.add(key); else ed.rawSelected.delete(key);
        ed.rawLastIdx = idx;
        ed.rawDrag = { mode: willBe ? 'add' : 'remove', startIdx: idx, touched: new Set([key]) };
        renderRawList(ptId);
      }
      function applyRawDragTo(ptId, idx) {
        var ed = editors[ptId];
        if (!ed.rawDrag) return;
        var lo = Math.min(ed.rawDrag.startIdx, idx), hi = Math.max(ed.rawDrag.startIdx, idx);
        var inRange = new Set();
        filteredRawIdxs(ed).forEach(function (i) { if (i >= lo && i <= hi) inRange.add(i); });
        rawCandidates.forEach(function (c, i) {
          if (ed.rawDrag.touched.has(c.key) && !inRange.has(i)) {
            if (ed.rawDrag.mode === 'add') ed.rawSelected.delete(c.key);
            else ed.rawSelected.add(c.key);
            ed.rawDrag.touched.delete(c.key);
          }
        });
        filteredRawIdxs(ed).forEach(function (i) {
          if (i < lo || i > hi) return;
          var c = rawCandidates[i];
          if (ed.rawDrag.touched.has(c.key)) return;
          ed.rawDrag.touched.add(c.key);
          if (ed.rawDrag.mode === 'add') ed.rawSelected.add(c.key);
          else ed.rawSelected.delete(c.key);
        });
        renderRawList(ptId);
      }

      // ── Delegated event listeners ────────────────────────────
      // Input into text/date fields.
      backdrop.addEventListener('input', function (e) {
        var el = e.target;
        if (el.classList.contains('fg-tm-input')) {
          var ptId = Number(el.dataset.ptId);
          editors[ptId].value = el.value;
          updateFootCount();
          return;
        }
        if (el.classList.contains('fg-tm-serials')) {
          var ptId2 = Number(el.dataset.ptId);
          editors[ptId2].serialsText = el.value;
          updateFootCount();
          return;
        }
        if (el.classList.contains('fg-tm-rawfilter')) {
          var ptId3 = Number(el.dataset.ptId);
          editors[ptId3].rawFilter = el.value;
          renderRawList(ptId3);
          return;
        }
      });
      // Drag/drop for serial textareas.
      backdrop.addEventListener('dragover', function (e) {
        if (e.target.classList && e.target.classList.contains('fg-tm-serials')) {
          e.preventDefault(); e.target.classList.add('dragover');
        }
      });
      backdrop.addEventListener('dragleave', function (e) {
        if (e.target.classList && e.target.classList.contains('fg-tm-serials')) {
          e.target.classList.remove('dragover');
        }
      });
      backdrop.addEventListener('drop', function (e) {
        var el = e.target;
        if (!el.classList || !el.classList.contains('fg-tm-serials')) return;
        e.preventDefault(); el.classList.remove('dragover');
        var file = e.dataTransfer && e.dataTransfer.files && e.dataTransfer.files[0];
        if (!file) return;
        var ptId = Number(el.dataset.ptId);
        var reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = function () {
          var cleaned = parseFgSerials(String(reader.result || '')).join('\n');
          editors[ptId].serialsText = cleaned;
          el.value = cleaned;
          updateFootCount();
        };
        reader.readAsText(file);
      });
      // Raws-list click + drag.
      backdrop.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) {
        // Click-outside-to-close.
        if (e.target === backdrop) { close(); return; }
        var item = e.target.closest('.serial-modal-item');
        if (!item || !body.contains(item)) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        var ptId = Number(item.dataset.ptId);
        var idx = parseInt(item.dataset.idx, 10);
        handleRawClick(ptId, idx, e);
      });
      backdrop.addEventListener('mouseover', function (e) {
        var item = e.target.closest('.serial-modal-item');
        if (!item || !body.contains(item)) return;
        var ptId = Number(item.dataset.ptId);
        if (!editors[ptId] || !editors[ptId].rawDrag) return;
        var idx = parseInt(item.dataset.idx, 10);
        applyRawDragTo(ptId, idx);
      });
      // Toolbar / action buttons.
      backdrop.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        var a = e.target.closest('[data-act]');
        if (!a) return;
        var act = a.dataset.act;
        if (act === 'cancel') { close(); return; }
        if (act === 'apply')  { apply();  return; }
        var ptId = Number(a.dataset.ptId);
        var def = fs.fg.defs.filter(function (d) { return d.partTrackingId === ptId; })[0];
        var ed = editors[ptId];
        if (!def || !ed || def.mandatory) return;
        if (act === 'use-sugg') {
          if (def.isSerial) {
            ed.serialsText = Array.isArray(def.suggestion) ? def.suggestion.join('\n') : '';
          } else {
            ed.value = def.suggestion == null ? '' : String(def.suggestion);
          }
          renderAll();
          return;
        }
        if (act === 'toggle-raws') { ed.showRaws = !ed.showRaws; renderAll(); return; }
        if (act === 'fill-wo') {
          var woNumSeed = wo.num ? String(wo.num) + '-001' : '001';
          ed.serialsText = (needN > 0) ? generateFgSerials(woNumSeed, needN).join('\n') : '';
          renderAll();
          return;
        }
        if (act === 'clear-serial') { ed.serialsText = ''; renderAll(); return; }
        if (act === 'raw-all')      { rawCandidates.forEach(function (c) { ed.rawSelected.add(c.key); }); renderRawList(ptId); return; }
        if (act === 'raw-clear')    { ed.rawSelected.clear(); renderRawList(ptId); return; }
        if (act === 'raw-first-n')  {
          ed.rawSelected.clear();
          for (var i = 0; i < rawCandidates.length && ed.rawSelected.size < needN; i++) {
            ed.rawSelected.add(rawCandidates[i].key);
          }
          renderRawList(ptId); return;
        }
        if (act === 'raw-use') {
          var picked = rawCandidates
            .filter(function (c) { return ed.rawSelected.has(c.key); })
            .map(function (c) { return c.serialNum; });
          ed.serialsText = picked.join('\n');
          renderAll();
          return;
        }
      });

      var onMouseUp = function () {
        // End any in-progress drag across every section.
        fs.fg.defs.forEach(function (def) {
          var ed = editors[def.partTrackingId];
          if (ed) ed.rawDrag = null;
        });
      };
      document.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);

      function close() {
        if (backdrop.parentNode) backdrop.parentNode.removeChild(backdrop);
        document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
        document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
      }
      function apply() {
        // Commit each editor's local state back to its def, then
        // repaint the sub-detail panel and re-run preflight.
        fs.fg.defs.forEach(function (def) {
          if (def.mandatory) return;
          var ed = editors[def.partTrackingId];
          if (def.isSerial) {
            var arr = parseFgSerials(ed.serialsText);
            def.value = arr;
            def.serialsText = arr.join('\n');
            def.confirmed = arr.length > 0;
          } else {
            def.value = ed.value || '';
            def.confirmed = String(def.value).length > 0;
          }
        });
        close();
        // Repaint the FG panel in place so the readonly flags and
        // confirm chips reflect the new state.
        var host = document.getElementById('subDetail-' + woId);
        if (host) {
          var oldPanel = host.querySelector('.finish-fg-tracking');
          if (oldPanel) {
            var tmp = document.createElement('div');
            tmp.innerHTML = renderFgTrackingPanel(woId);
            var newPanel = tmp.firstElementChild;
            if (newPanel) oldPanel.parentNode.replaceChild(newPanel, oldPanel);
          }
        }
        recheckFinishReadiness(woId);
      }
      backdrop.querySelector('.serial-modal-close').addEventListener('click', close);

      function onKey(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') close();
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) apply();
      }
      document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);

      renderAll();
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // In-place banner updater — replaces the current .finish-banner
    // + trailing .finish-blocker-list without touching the raw-
    // material table (so editable inputs keep their focus / value).
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function updateFinishBanner(woId) {
      var host = document.getElementById('subDetail-' + woId);
      if (!host) return;
      var oldBanner = host.querySelector('.finish-banner');
      var oldList = host.querySelector('.finish-blocker-list');
      var tmp = document.createElement('div');
      tmp.innerHTML = renderFinishBanner(woId);
      var newNodes = Array.prototype.slice.call(tmp.childNodes);
      if (!oldBanner) {
        host.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', renderFinishBanner(woId));
        return;
      }
      // Replace banner (and any adjacent blocker list) with the new
      // node set. The blocker list, if present, is always the sibling
      // immediately after the banner.
      var anchor = oldBanner;
      newNodes.forEach(function (n) { host.insertBefore(n, anchor); });
      if (oldList && oldList.parentNode === host) host.removeChild(oldList);
      host.removeChild(oldBanner);
    }

    // ============================================================
    // FINISH — line edit handlers
    // ============================================================
    // onchange (blur) is the authoritative update; oninput is only
    // used to flag the input as dirty (amber border) so the operator
    // gets immediate feedback while typing.
    window.onFinishLineChange = function (input) {
      var woId = input.dataset.woId, idx = parseInt(input.dataset.idx, 10), field = input.dataset.field;
      var fs = state.finishState[woId]; if (!fs) return;
      var line = fs.lines[idx]; if (!line) return;
      // Blank inputs are meaningful: usedInput=null means "no override,
      // use target". Only parse when a value is actually typed.
      var raw = String(input.value == null ? '' : input.value).trim();
      var prevScrap = effectiveScrapQty(line);
      if (raw === '') {
        line[field] = null;
      } else {
        var n = parseFloat(raw);
        if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0) n = 0;
        line[field] = n;
      }
      line.dirty = true;
      input.classList.add('qty-dirty');
      // If the operator changed the Scrapped qty on a tracked line
      // and there was a prior manual selection, invalidate it — the
      // selection's totalQty no longer matches the new scrap qty

      // updates the chip in renderScrapHint back to "FIFO / select"

      if (field === 'scrappedInput' && line.scrapSelection &&
          Math.abs(prevScrap - effectiveScrapQty(line)) > 1e-6) {
        line.scrapSelection = null;

      // Recompute Consumed % in place — use the effective qty
      // helpers so a blank Used input falls back to target.
      var effUsed  = effectiveUsedQty(line);

      var pct = line.target > 0 ? Math.round(100 * (effUsed + effScrap) / line.target) : 0;
      var tr = input.closest('tr');
      if (tr) {
        var pctCell = tr.querySelector('[data-role="pct"]');

      refreshScrapHint(woId, idx);
      // If a prior Finish attempt failed on scrap validation or a
      // Used-qty override, the operator's edit here may have fixed

      recheckFinishReadiness(woId);
    };
    window.onFinishLineDirty = function (input) {
      input.classList.add('qty-dirty');
      // Live-update the scrap-hint for the Scrapped column as the
      // operator types. Cheap — reads pre-loaded default-location
      // data, no query per keystroke.
      if (input.dataset.field === 'scrappedInput') {
        var fs = state.finishState[input.dataset.woId];
        var idx = parseInt(input.dataset.idx, 10);
        if (fs && fs.lines[idx]) {
          var raw = String(input.value == null ? '' : input.value).trim();
          fs.lines[idx].scrappedInput = raw === '' ? null : (parseFloat(raw) || 0);
          refreshScrapHint(input.dataset.woId, idx);
        }
      }
    };
    // Repaint one row's scrap-hint span in place — used by both the
    // onchange (blur) handler and the oninput (live) handler.
    function refreshScrapHint(woId, idx) {
      var fs = state.finishState[woId];
      if (!fs || !fs.lines[idx]) return;
      var hintEl = document.querySelector('[data-scrap-hint-for="' + woId + '-' + idx + '"]');
      if (!hintEl) return;

    }
    // Re-check readiness after an operator action that might have
    // resolved a blocker. Without this, `fs.status` stays 'error' +
    // Finish stays disabled after the operator confirms FG tracking,
    // selects source serials, or fixes a scrap qty — forcing a page
    // refresh to proceed.
    //
    // Contract: no-op unless currently in error state. When in error:
    //   1. Rebuild FG-tracking validation from current def state. If
    //      any def is still unconfirmed / has a bad serial count,
    //      keep the error but refresh its message so it reflects the
    //      CURRENT state (not stale text from the prior Finish attempt).
    //   2. FG clean + preflight preview was OK → transition to 'ready',
    //      clear blockers, unlock the Finish button.
    //   3. FG clean but preflight had blockers → re-run preflight so
    //      the async allocation dry-run picks up any source-serial /
    //      stock changes.
    // Scrap-plan errors (from the async buildScrapPlan step at Finish
    // click) can be optimistically cleared to 'ready' when FG + preflight
    // are otherwise fine — if the scrap is still invalid, the next
    // Finish click re-validates and shows the fresh error.
    function recheckFinishReadiness(woId) {
      var fs = state.finishState[woId];
      if (!fs) return;
      if (fs.status !== 'error') { updateFinishBanner(woId); return; }
      var fgQty = (fs.fg && fs.fg.fgQty) || 0;
      var needN = Math.round(fgQty);
      var unconfirmed = [];
      var badCount = [];
      ((fs.fg && fs.fg.defs) || []).forEach(function (def) {
        if (def.mandatory) return;
        if (!def.confirmed) { unconfirmed.push(def.name); return; }
        if (def.isSerial) {
          var arr = Array.isArray(def.value) ? def.value : parseFgSerials(def.serialsText || '');
          if (needN && arr.length !== needN) {
            badCount.push(def.name + ' (' + arr.length + '/' + needN + ')');
          }
        } else {
          if (!def.value || !String(def.value).length) unconfirmed.push(def.name);
        }
      });
      if (unconfirmed.length) {
        fs.lastError = 'Confirm the following FG tracking field' +
          (unconfirmed.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' first: ' + unconfirmed.join(', ') + '.';
        fs.blockers = [fs.lastError];
        updateFinishBanner(woId);
        return;
      }
      if (badCount.length) {
        fs.lastError = 'Serial count mismatch: ' + badCount.join('; ') + '.';
        fs.blockers = [fs.lastError];
        updateFinishBanner(woId);
        return;
      }
      if (fs.preview && fs.preview.ok && !(fs.preview.blockers && fs.preview.blockers.length)) {
        fs.status = 'ready';
        fs.blockers = [];
        fs.lastError = null;
        updateFinishBanner(woId);
        return;
      }
      fs.preflightRun = false;
      runPreflightIfEligible(woId);
    }
    // Locate a def by partTrackingId — used by the per-def input
    // handlers and the "Use suggestion" chip.
    function findFgDef(fs, partTrackingId) {
      if (!fs || !fs.fg || !fs.fg.defs) return null;
      var id = Number(partTrackingId);
      for (var i = 0; i < fs.fg.defs.length; i++) {
        if (fs.fg.defs[i].partTrackingId === id) return fs.fg.defs[i];
      }
      return null;
    }
    // Text / date fields — any edit implicitly confirms the def.
    window.onFinishFgTextInput = function (woId, partTrackingId, value) {
      var fs = state.finishState[woId];
      var def = findFgDef(fs, partTrackingId);
      if (!def || def.mandatory) return;
      def.value = value;
      def.confirmed = value != null && String(value).length > 0;
      // Recheck readiness — if this edit resolved a "confirm FG"
      // blocker, the Finish button unlocks; otherwise the banner
      // repaints in place with an updated error message.
      recheckFinishReadiness(woId);
    };
    // Serial textarea — mirrors typed text into serialsText and
    // derives .value from it. The def is considered confirmed once
    // the count matches the expected qty (or the operator has typed
    // anything and later clicked Use suggestion to bless the field).
    window.onFinishFgSerialsInput = function (woId, partTrackingId, value) {
      var fs = state.finishState[woId];
      var def = findFgDef(fs, partTrackingId);
      if (!def || def.mandatory || !def.isSerial) return;
      def.serialsText = value;
      def.value = parseFgSerials(value);
      def.confirmed = def.value.length > 0;
      var qty = fs.fg.fgQty || 0;
      var countEl = document.getElementById('serial-count-' + woId + '-' + partTrackingId);
      if (countEl) countEl.innerHTML = renderSerialCountText(value, qty);
      recheckFinishReadiness(woId);
    };
    // Operator-explicit "Use suggestion" click.
    window.onFinishFgUseSuggestion = function (woId, partTrackingId) {
      var fs = state.finishState[woId];
      var def = findFgDef(fs, partTrackingId);
      if (!def || def.mandatory) return;
      if (def.isSerial) {
        var arr = Array.isArray(def.suggestion) ? def.suggestion.slice() : [];
        def.value = arr;
        def.serialsText = arr.join('\n');
      } else {
        def.value = def.suggestion == null ? '' : def.suggestion;
      }
      def.confirmed = true;
      // Repaint the whole FG panel — the field's readonly bit, the
      // confirm chip, the serial textarea + count all need refreshing.
      var host = document.getElementById('subDetail-' + woId);
      if (host) {
        var oldPanel = host.querySelector('.finish-fg-tracking');
        if (oldPanel) {
          var tmp = document.createElement('div');
          tmp.innerHTML = renderFgTrackingPanel(woId);

    window.onPreflightClick = function (woId) {

    // ============================================================
    // FINISH — commit action
    // ============================================================
    // Runs the full SavePickRq → SaveWorkOrderRq sequence for one WO.
    // Uses the preview cached by runPreflightIfEligible when possible
    // (Finisher.prepareFinish will re-fetch the pick anyway — the
    // preview is only used here to build the fgValues before we hand
    // control over). Any qty edits the operator made in the raw-
    // material table apply as woitem overrides in a follow-up (see
    // "Applied qty overrides" note below).
    window.onFinishClick = function (woId) {
      var wo = findWoById(woId);
      var fs = state.finishState[woId];
      if (!wo || !fs) return;
      if (fs.status === 'submitting') return;

      // Validate every FG tracking def before POST. Two failure modes:
      //   1. Non-mandatory def that hasn't been confirmed by the
      //      operator (unless the autoApplyFgDefaults setting is on).
      //      Blocks — Fishbowl requires a value for every active def
      //      and silently defaulting is what caused the "batch set,
      //      date missing" data-integrity bug this refactor fixes.
      //   2. Serial def whose count doesn't match FG woitem qty
      //      (Fishbowl error 4224). Blocks — same as before.
      var fgQty = fs.fg.fgQty || 0;
      var needN = Math.round(fgQty);
      var unconfirmed = [];
      var badCount = [];
      (fs.fg.defs || []).forEach(function (def) {
        if (def.mandatory) return;
        if (!def.confirmed) {
          unconfirmed.push(def.name);
          return;
        }
        if (def.isSerial) {
          var arr = Array.isArray(def.value) ? def.value : parseFgSerials(def.serialsText || '');
          if (needN && arr.length !== needN) {
            badCount.push(def.name + ' (' + arr.length + ' entered, need ' + needN + ')');
          }
        } else {
          if (!def.value || !String(def.value).length) unconfirmed.push(def.name);
        }
      });
      if (unconfirmed.length) {
        fs.status = 'error';
        fs.lastError = 'Confirm the following FG tracking field' +
          (unconfirmed.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' first: ' + unconfirmed.join(', ') +
          '. Click "Use suggestion" beside each, or open Edit tracking to fill in.';
        fs.blockers = [fs.lastError];
        updateFinishBanner(woId);
        return;
      }
      if (badCount.length) {
        fs.status = 'error';
        fs.lastError = 'Serial count mismatch: ' + badCount.join('; ') + '.';
        fs.blockers = [fs.lastError];
        updateFinishBanner(woId);
        return;
      }
      // Resolve every scrapped line's target location + validate
      // stock BEFORE we start writing. Any resolution failure blocks
      // Finish — safer than committing the pick and then discovering
      // the scrap step can't run.
      fs.status = 'preflight';
      updateFinishBanner(woId);
      buildScrapPlan(fs, wo).then(function (plan) {
        if (plan.blockers.length) {
          fs.status = 'error';
          fs.lastError = 'Cannot scrap: ' + plan.blockers.join('; ');
          fs.blockers = plan.blockers.slice();
          updateFinishBanner(woId);
          return;
        }
        var scrapSummary = plan.rows.length
          ? plan.rows.map(function (r) { return r.partNum + ' ×' + fmtQty(r.qty) + ' @ ' + r.location; }).join('\n')
          : '';
        var prompt = 'Finish WO ' + wo.num + '?\n\n' +
          'This commits the pick and marks the WO Fulfilled. Cannot be undone from this report.' +
          (scrapSummary
            ? '\n\nAdditionally, the following will be scrapped:\n' + scrapSummary
            : '');
        // Confirmation guard — this is a Fishbowl-side irreversible
        // write. Native confirm() is fine in JxBrowser here (no toast
        // required).
        if (!confirm(prompt)) {
          fs.status = 'ready';   // let the operator try again
          updateFinishBanner(woId);
          return;
        }
        _scrapImp = null;          // fresh header per Finish
        // Used-qty overrides — where the operator's Used input diverges
        // from what the pick would consume by default, we send the
        // override into the pick payload so SavePickRq commits the
        // operator's value. See Finisher.applyUsedOverrides. Committed
        // items throw during apply — surfaced as a blocker.
        var usedOverrides = [];
        fs.lines.forEach(function (line) {
          if (line.isLabour || !line.woitemId) return;
          // Blank Used input → no override, Finish uses the pick's
          // current qty (which almost always equals target). Only
          // push an override when the operator actually typed a
          // value that differs from what the pick would consume.
          var raw = line.usedInput;
          if (raw == null || raw === '') return;
          var used = parseFloat(raw);
          if (!Number.isFinite(used) || used < 0) return;
          // Compare against what the pick would consume as-is:
          //   - pendingQty when the pick line is still open
          //   - pickedQty when it's already committed / finished
          var expected = line.pendingQty > 0 ? line.pendingQty : line.pickedQty;
          if (Math.abs(used - expected) > 1e-6) {
            usedOverrides.push({
              woItemId: line.woitemId,
              partNum: line.partNum,
              qty: used,
            });
          }
        });
        fs.status = 'submitting';
        fs.steps = [];
        fs.lastError = null;
        fs.blockers = [];
        updateFinishBanner(woId);
        var woRow = Finisher.woRowFrom(wo);
        Finisher.prepareFinish(woRow, {
          mode: Finisher.CFG.mode,
          fgDefs: fs.fg.defs,
          selectedSerialKeys: collectSelectedSerialKeys(fs),
          scrapRows: plan.rows,
          scrapImporter: postScrapImport,
          usedOverrides: usedOverrides,
          post: true,
          onStep: function (label) { fs.steps.push(label); updateFinishBanner(woId); },
        }).then(function (result) {
        if (result.ok && result.posted) {
          fs.status = 'done';
          fs.blockers = [];
          fs.lastError = null;
          updateFinishBanner(woId);
          setStatus('WO ' + wo.num + ' fulfilled.');
          // Applied qty overrides — v1 caveat:
          //   Fishbowl's SavePick + SaveWorkOrder API commits raw-
          //   material consumption based on the pick's allocated qty,
          //   NOT on manually adjusted woitem.qtyUsed values entered
          //   in the raw-material table above. Any qty edits show as
          //   dirty in the input but do not (yet) round-trip to
          //   Fishbowl. The standalone WO Finisher has the same
          //   limitation. Adjusting qtyUsed / qtyScrapped after the
          //   fact is a manual step in the Work Order module for now
          //   — see plan.md "Out of scope" note.
          refreshWoRow(woId);
        } else {
          fs.status = 'error';
          fs.blockers = result.blockers || [];
          fs.lastError = result.error ? String(result.error) : 'Finish did not complete.';
          updateFinishBanner(woId);
        }
        }).catch(function (e) {
          fs.status = 'error';
          fs.lastError = String(e && e.message || e);
          fs.blockers = [fs.lastError];
          updateFinishBanner(woId);
        });
      }).catch(function (e) {
        // buildScrapPlan itself failed (defaultlocation query error,
        // etc.) — surface it and don't attempt Finish.
        fs.status = 'error';
        fs.lastError = 'Scrap plan build failed: ' + String(e && e.message || e);
        fs.blockers = [fs.lastError];
        updateFinishBanner(woId);
      });
    };

    // ============================================================
    // ROW REFRESH — after a successful finish
    // ============================================================
    // Re-runs the pick / step / wip subqueries for THIS WO only and
    // re-renders the affected MO row + WO row + sub-detail. Cheaper
    // than a full loadAll() and preserves the operator's scroll +
    // expand/collapse state elsewhere on the page.
    //
    // NB: we don't re-query the main `moSql` — the WO's status /
    // qtyOrdered / qtyTarget after finish are what we know locally
    // (statusId=40, qtyOrdered=qtyTarget). We patch them in memory.
    function refreshWoRow(woId) {
      var wo = findWoById(woId);
      if (!wo) return;
      // Patch in-memory state to reflect the completed finish.
      wo.statusId = 40;
      wo.qtyOrdered = wo.qtyTarget;
      // The pick has moved to Finished — mark it done so the pick
      // traffic-light shows the green check.
      if (wo.pick) {
        wo.pick.state = 'done';
        wo.pick.finished = wo.pick.items;
        wo.pick.committed = 0;
        (wo.pick.picks || []).forEach(function (pk) { pk.statusId = 40; });
      }
      // Bust the sub-detail cache so the next expand re-queries.
      // The finished pick means qtyUsed / qtyScrapped on woitem have
      // been updated by Fishbowl (consumed values); re-fetch fresh.
      delete state.subCache[woId];
      // Wipe the finishState too — the WO is now statusId=40, so any
      // prior dirty edits / preflight results are meaningless. The
      // next expand will build a fresh state that skips the banner.
      delete state.finishState[woId];
      // Recompute KPIs (Late WOs / Picks pending / Avg completion).
      // We can't call computeKpis() directly from here without a
      // full render, so re-render the whole main table — it's fast
      // enough (JS-side loop over state.mos) and keeps everything
      // consistent.
      computeKpis();
      render();
      // After render(), the sub-detail DOM has been thrown away, so
      // re-expand this WO's row so the operator can see the result.
      var row = document.querySelector('tr.wo-row[data-woid="' + woId + '"]');
      var moRow = row ? document.getElementById('mo-' + row.dataset.moid) : null;
      if (moRow && !moRow.classList.contains('expanded')) moRow.classList.add('expanded');
      // WO rows under the MO are collapsed by state.defaultExpanded;
      // force this one open so the fulfilled state is visible.
      if (row) {
        row.classList.remove('collapsed');
        row.classList.add('expanded');
        var sub = document.querySelector('tr.sub-row[data-sub-for="' + woId + '"]');
        if (sub) {
          sub.classList.remove('collapsed');
          loadSubDetail(woId);
        }
      }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // CSV EXPORT

    function exportCSV() {
      if (!state.mos.length) { alert('Nothing to export.'); return; }
      var q = function (v) { return '"' + String(v == null ? '' : v).replace(/"/g, '""') + '"'; };
      var lines = ['MO #,MO status,MO finished good,LG,WO #,WO status,WO output(s),Cal category,Pick state,Pick lines,Full,Partial,None,Committed,Finished,Qty ordered,Qty target,Steps done,Steps total,Step %,WIP value,Consumed value,Total cost,Open req value,Scheduled,Started'];

                      p.items || 0, p.full || 0, p.partial || 0, p.none || 0, p.committed || 0, p.finished || 0,
                      w.qtyOrdered, w.qtyTarget, w.steps.done, w.steps.total, woPct(w),

    // ============================================================
    // DATE-RANGE FILTER
    // ----
    // Resolves the chip-strip selector into ISO YYYY-MM-DD bounds for
    // the SQL filter. Uses moment so the bounds are honest to local
    // tz (datetimes in the DB are server-local). Returns nulls when
    // the range is unbounded on that side.
    // ============================================================
    function resolveDateRange() {
      var v = state.dateRange || 'all';
      if (v === 'all') return { start: null, end: null };
      var now = moment();
      switch (v) {
        case 'overdue':
          return { start: null, end: now.clone().subtract(1, 'day').format('YYYY-MM-DD') };
        case 'today':
          return { start: now.clone().format('YYYY-MM-DD'), end: now.clone().format('YYYY-MM-DD') };
        case 'next7':
          return { start: now.clone().format('YYYY-MM-DD'), end: now.clone().add(7, 'days').format('YYYY-MM-DD') };
        case 'next30':
          return { start: now.clone().format('YYYY-MM-DD'), end: now.clone().add(30, 'days').format('YYYY-MM-DD') };
        case 'thisMonth':
          return { start: now.clone().startOf('month').format('YYYY-MM-DD'), end: now.clone().endOf('month').format('YYYY-MM-DD') };
        case 'custom':
          return { start: state.dateStart || null, end: state.dateEnd || null };
      }
      return { start: null, end: null };
    }

    window.onDateRangeChange = function () {
      var sel = document.getElementById('dateRangeSel');
      state.dateRange = sel.value || 'all';
      // Show / hide the custom-range inputs.
      var custom = document.getElementById('customDateInputs');
      if (custom) custom.style.display = (state.dateRange === 'custom') ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
      // For non-custom selections, reset stored dates so a future
      // switch back to "Custom range…" starts clean.
      if (state.dateRange !== 'custom') { state.dateStart = ''; state.dateEnd = ''; }
      persistFilterState();
      if (state.dateRange !== 'custom') loadAll();
      // Custom case waits for the user to actually pick dates — see
      // onCustomDateChange().
    };

    window.onCustomDateChange = function () {
      state.dateStart = document.getElementById('dateStart').value || '';
      state.dateEnd   = document.getElementById('dateEnd').value   || '';
      persistFilterState();
      // Only run when BOTH dates are set — partial ranges produce
      // confusing results.
      if (state.dateStart && state.dateEnd) loadAll();
    };

    // "Ready to finish" chip — pure client-side filter, so no re-query

    function persistFilterState() {
      try {
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('dateRange', state.dateRange);
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('dateStart', state.dateStart);
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('dateEnd',   state.dateEnd);
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('sortKey',   state.sortKey);
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('sortDir',   state.sortDir);
        FBLib.Settings.saveUser();
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    // ============================================================
    // SORT
    // ----
    // Headers in the table thead are marked `class="sortable"
    // data-sort="date|num"`. Clicking the same key flips direction;
    // a different key resets to that key's natural default direction
    // (date = desc / latest first; num = asc / lowest first).
    // ============================================================
    window.onSortClick = function (key) {
      if (key !== 'date' && key !== 'num') return;
      if (state.sortKey === key) {
        state.sortDir = state.sortDir === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
      } else {
        state.sortKey = key;
        state.sortDir = (key === 'date') ? 'desc' : 'asc';
      }
      persistFilterState();
      updateSortArrows();
      // Re-query so the SQL ORDER BY does the work; cheaper than a
      // client-side resort because we'd otherwise need to sort all
      // mo + wo rows in JS.
      loadAll();
    };

    function updateSortArrows() {
      var dEl = document.getElementById('sortArrowDate');
      var nEl = document.getElementById('sortArrowNum');
      if (!dEl || !nEl) return;
      var glyph = state.sortDir === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓';
      dEl.textContent = state.sortKey === 'date' ? glyph : '↕';
      nEl.textContent = state.sortKey === 'num'  ? glyph : '↕';
      dEl.classList.toggle('active', state.sortKey === 'date');
      nEl.classList.toggle('active', state.sortKey === 'num');
    }

    // ============================================================
    // SETTINGS — flat handlers (no custom drawer plumbing; fb-lib's
    // registerDrawer + toggleDrawer handle open/close/ESC.)
    // ============================================================
    function hydrateSettings() {
      document.getElementById('dsExpanded').checked      = !!state.defaultExpanded;
      document.getElementById('dsShowFulfilled').checked = !!state.showFulfilled;
      document.getElementById('dsDebug').checked         = !!C.DEBUG_MODE;
      var autoEl = document.getElementById('dsAutoApplyFgDefaults');
      if (autoEl) autoEl.checked = !!state.autoApplyFgDefaults;
    }
    function onSettingsChange() {
      var expanded      = document.getElementById('dsExpanded').checked;
      var showFulfilled = document.getElementById('dsShowFulfilled').checked;
      var showDebug     = document.getElementById('dsDebug').checked;
      var autoEl        = document.getElementById('dsAutoApplyFgDefaults');
      var autoApply     = autoEl ? !!autoEl.checked : !!state.autoApplyFgDefaults;
      FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('expanded',      expanded);
      FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('showFulfilled', showFulfilled);
      FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('showDebug',     showDebug);
      FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('autoApplyFgDefaults', autoApply);
      FBLib.Settings.saveUser();
      state.defaultExpanded    = expanded;
      state.showFulfilled      = showFulfilled;
      state.autoApplyFgDefaults = autoApply;
      applyDebugDrawer(showDebug);
      // If fulfilled toggle changed AND user hasn't set their own WO
      // status filter, widen/narrow the default scope.
      if (state.woStat.size === 0 || (state.woStat.size && state.woStat.has('40') !== showFulfilled)) {
        // No-op when user has an explicit filter; only re-load when the
        // implicit default just changed.
      }
      loadAll();
    }
    function resetSettings() {
      if (!confirm('Reset your personal settings to defaults?')) return;
      try { FBLib.Settings.clearUser(); } catch (_) {}
      state.defaultExpanded = false;
      state.showFulfilled   = false;
      // Mirror the in-memory state to the cleared defaults so the
      // next loadAll uses the same baseline a fresh-session user
      // would get.
      state.sortKey   = 'date';
      state.sortDir   = 'desc';
      state.dateRange = 'all';
      state.dateStart = '';
      state.dateEnd   = '';
      state.finishReadyOnly = false;
      hydrateSettings();
      // Repaint the chip strip / sort arrows so the UI reflects
      // the reset before the data reloads.
      var drSel = document.getElementById('dateRangeSel');
      if (drSel) drSel.value = 'all';
      var custom = document.getElementById('customDateInputs');
      if (custom) custom.style.display = 'none';
      var dsEl = document.getElementById('dateStart'); if (dsEl) dsEl.value = '';
      var deEl = document.getElementById('dateEnd');   if (deEl) deEl.value = '';
      var frEl = document.getElementById('finishReadyOnly');
      if (frEl) frEl.checked = false;
      updateSortArrows();
      applyDebugDrawer(false);
      loadAll();
    }
    function publishMaster() {
      if (!FBLib.Settings.isAdmin()) return;
      if (!confirm('Publish current settings as the default for all users?')) return;
      try {
        FBLib.Settings.publishMaster({
          expanded:      document.getElementById('dsExpanded').checked,
          showFulfilled: document.getElementById('dsShowFulfilled').checked
        });
        alert('Defaults published.');
      } catch (e) { dbg('publishMaster: ' + e.message, 'error'); }
    }
    function toggleUserEditing() {
      if (!FBLib.Settings.isAdmin()) return;
      try {
        var allowed = FBLib.Settings.userEditingAllowed();
        FBLib.Settings.setLock(allowed);
        refreshAdminUi();
      } catch (e) { dbg('toggleUserEditing: ' + e.message, 'error'); }
    }
    function refreshAdminUi() {
      var isAdmin = FBLib.Settings.isAdmin();
      var sec = document.getElementById('dsAdminSection');
      if (sec) sec.style.display = isAdmin ? 'block' : 'none';
      var allowed = FBLib.Settings.userEditingAllowed();
      var badge = document.getElementById('dsLockBadge');
      if (badge) badge.style.display = (!allowed && !isAdmin) ? 'block' : 'none';
      var lockBtn = document.getElementById('dsLockBtn');
      if (lockBtn) lockBtn.textContent = allowed ? 'Lock user editing' : 'Unlock user editing';
    }
    window.onSettingsChange   = onSettingsChange;
    window.resetSettings      = resetSettings;
    window.publishMaster      = publishMaster;
    window.toggleUserEditing  = toggleUserEditing;

    // ============================================================
    // DEBUG DRAWER (fb-lib mountDebugDrawer + body-padding observer,
    // mirrors Core_Dashboard_Template)
    // ============================================================
    var _debugApi = null;
    function applyDebugDrawer(showIt) {
      if (!_debugApi) _debugApi = FBLib.Common.mountDebugDrawer();
      if (!_debugApi) return;
      if (showIt) { _debugApi.show(); _debugApi.expand(); }
      else _debugApi.hide();
      if (_debugApi.element) observeDebugDrawer(_debugApi.element);
    }
    function observeDebugDrawer(el) {
      if (!el || el._observed) return;
      el._observed = true;
      var apply = function () {
        var visible = el.classList.contains('is-visible');
        var open    = el.classList.contains('is-open');
        var h = (visible && open) ? Math.ceil(el.getBoundingClientRect().height) : (visible ? 40 : 0);
        document.body.style.setProperty('--debug-drawer-h', h + 'px');
      };
      apply();
      if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'function') {
        try { new ResizeObserver(apply).observe(el); } catch (_) {}
      }
      try { new MutationObserver(apply).observe(el, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] }); } catch (_) {}
    }

    // ============================================================
    // SEARCH (debounced)
    // ============================================================
    var searchTimer = null;
    document.getElementById('searchInput').addEventListener('input', function (e) {
      state.search = e.target.value || '';
      clearTimeout(searchTimer);
      searchTimer = setTimeout(function () { render(); }, 200);
    });

    // ESC closes any open multi-select dropdown. fb-lib's registerDrawer
    // already wires ESC to close the active drawer; we just need to
    // also close MS dropdowns so they don't trap focus.
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') MS.closeAll();
    });

    // ============================================================
    // INIT
    // ============================================================
    window.loadAll   = loadAll;
    window.exportCSV = exportCSV;

    // Register Settings + Help drawers with fb-lib (mutual-exclusion,
    // ESC-to-close, trigger-button .active state).
    FBLib.Common.registerDrawer({ id: 'setOverlay',  triggerId: 'setBtn'  });
    FBLib.Common.registerDrawer({ id: 'helpOverlay', triggerId: 'helpBtn' });

    // Hydrate Settings panel + bring up the debug drawer if it was on.
    hydrateSettings();
    applyDebugDrawer(!!FBLib.Settings.resolve('showDebug'));
    refreshAdminUi();

    // Hydrate the date-range selector + custom-date inputs from saved
    // state. Show the custom inputs only when the saved selection is
    // 'custom'. Also paint the sort arrows so the active sort is
    // visible before the first data load completes.
    var drSel = document.getElementById('dateRangeSel');
    if (drSel) drSel.value = state.dateRange || 'all';
    var customInputs = document.getElementById('customDateInputs');
    if (customInputs) customInputs.style.display = (state.dateRange === 'custom') ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
    var dsEl = document.getElementById('dateStart');
    var deEl = document.getElementById('dateEnd');
    if (dsEl) dsEl.value = state.dateStart || '';
    if (deEl) deEl.value = state.dateEnd   || '';
    var frEl = document.getElementById('finishReadyOnly');
    if (frEl) frEl.checked = !!state.finishReadyOnly;
    updateSortArrows();

    setStatus('Loading reference data…');
    showSpinner(true, 'Loading reference data…');
    loadReferenceData().then(function () {
      MS.renderAll();
      return loadAll();
    }).catch(function (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setStatus('Reference load failed: ' + (err.message || err));
      showSpinner(false);
    });

  })();
  </script>

</body>
